Korean Winter Brightening Combo is a complete four-step Korean skincare routine designed to combine gentle cleansing, tone-evening care, nourishing moisturization and daily UV protection. The combo includes COSRX Low pH Good Morning Gel Cleanser 50 ml, SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Capsule Ampoule 30 ml, DABO Pink Collagen PDRN Hydra Capsule Cream 55 ml and Nature Skin Brightening UV Protection Multi Sun Cream SPF50+ PA+++ 72 ml.

The routine begins with a mildly acidic COSRX gel cleanser that removes everyday impurities without intentionally stripping away essential moisture. SKIN1004 Tone Brightening Capsule Ampoule follows with Niacinamide, Tranexamic Acid, Centella Asiatica, encapsulated Madewhite™ and a stable Vitamin C derivative for tone-evening, radiance and soothing care.

DABO Pink Collagen PDRN Hydra Capsule Cream provides the dedicated moisturizing step with 300Da low-molecular collagen, peptides, salmon-derived PDRN and gently bursting oil capsules. During the daytime, Nature Skin Brightening UV Protection Multi Sun Cream completes the routine with SPF50+ PA+++ protection and a non-comedogenic hybrid sunscreen formula.

This combination is particularly practical during cooler and drier weather because it pairs gentle cleansing and hydrating brightening care with a dedicated moisturizing cream before sunscreen.

Important: “Brightening” in this routine refers to cosmetic radiance, clarity and improvement in the appearance of uneven skin tone. These products should not be described as medical treatments for melasma, hyperpigmentation disorders, acne scars or other diagnosed skin conditions.

Korean Winter Brightening Combo Overview

During cooler weather, reduced humidity and environmental exposure can leave the skin feeling dry, tight or less comfortable. At the same time, dullness and uneven-looking skin tone can remain visible, while UV protection is still necessary throughout the year.

The COSRX cleanser provides a mild cleansing foundation. The SKIN1004 ampoule supplies the main tone-evening treatment step. DABO Pink Collagen PDRN Hydra Capsule Cream adds richer moisture and vitality-focused care, while Nature Skin SPF50+ PA+++ sunscreen protects the skin during the daytime.

products.name: Iunik Centella Calming Gel Cream 60 ml
products.description:
iUNIK Centella Calming Gel Cream: A Comprehensive Review

Introduction

The iUNIK Centella Calming Gel Cream is a lightweight, soothing moisturizer designed to calm and hydrate sensitive, oily, and acne-prone skin. Infused with 70% Centella Asiatica leaf water and enriched with tea tree leaf water, this gel cream aims to provide relief from irritation and redness while maintaining skin hydration. Its formulation is tailored for individuals seeking a calming effect without the heaviness of traditional creams.

Key Ingredients and Their Benefits

  1. Centella Asiatica Leaf Water (70%): Known for its healing properties, Centella Asiatica helps to soothe irritated skin, promote collagen production, and improve the skin’s barrier function.
  2. Tea Tree Leaf Water: Renowned for its antibacterial and anti-inflammatory properties, tea tree leaf water assists in reducing acne-causing bacteria and calming inflamed skin.
  3. Niacinamide (Vitamin B3): This ingredient helps to strengthen the skin’s barrier, even out skin tone, and reduce the appearance of enlarged pores.
  4. Adenosine: A naturally occurring compound that aids in reducing the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, promoting smoother skin.
  5. Citrus Aurantium Dulcis (Orange) Peel Oil: Provides a subtle fragrance and offers antioxidant benefits, contributing to overall skin health.

Texture and Application

The iUNIK Centella Calming Gel Cream boasts a translucent, gel-like texture that absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving a sticky residue. Its lightweight consistency makes it suitable for layering with other skincare products, and it is particularly beneficial for use in hot and humid climates. Users have reported that it provides a semi-matte finish, making it ideal for those with oily or combination skin types.

Packaging

The product is housed in a 60ml green and white tube, which is both hygienic and travel-friendly. The tube design allows for easy dispensing of the product, ensuring minimal wastage. Additionally, the packaging is designed to protect the integrity of the product, maintaining its efficacy over time.

Usage Recommendations

To incorporate the iUNIK Centella Calming Gel Cream into your skincare routine:

  1. Cleanse: Begin with a gentle cleanser suitable for your skin type to remove impurities.
  2. Tone: Apply a toner to balance the skin’s pH levels.
  3. Serum: Use a serum that addresses specific skin concerns, such as acne or pigmentation.
  4. Moisturize: Apply a thin layer of the Centella Calming Gel Cream to the face, gently patting it in for optimal absorption.

This gel cream can be used both morning and night, depending on individual skincare needs.

Suitability for Skin Types

The iUNIK Centella Calming Gel Cream is particularly beneficial for:

  • Oily Skin: Its lightweight formula helps to hydrate without adding excess oil.
  • Acne-Prone Skin: The soothing properties of Centella Asiatica and tea tree leaf water assist in calming inflamed areas.
  • Sensitive Skin: The gentle formulation minimizes the risk of irritation.

However, individuals with dry or very dry skin may find this product less moisturizing and might need to layer it with a richer moisturizer.

Potential Drawbacks

While the iUNIK Centella Calming Gel Cream offers numerous benefits, some users have reported:

  • Dryness: A few individuals with oily skin have experienced a tight or dry feeling after application, particularly in cooler climates.
  • Sensitivity: Some users with sensitive skin have noted a slight burning sensation upon application, possibly due to the presence of essential oils.
  • Allergic Reactions: A small number of individuals have reported developing bumps or irritation after using the product, suggesting a potential sensitivity to Centella Asiatica or other ingredients.

It’s advisable to perform a patch test before full application to ensure compatibility with your skin.

Conclusion

The iUNIK Centella Calming Gel Cream stands out as a soothing, lightweight moisturizer suitable for oily, acne-prone, and sensitive skin types. Its formulation, enriched with Centella Asiatica and tea tree leaf water, provides calming and hydrating benefits without the heaviness of traditional creams. While it may not offer sufficient moisture for dry skin, it serves as an excellent option for those seeking a gentle, non-comedogenic product to incorporate into their daily skincare routine.

Note: Individual reactions to skincare products can vary. It’s essential to consider personal skin sensitivities and consult with a dermatologist if uncertain about product suitability.

products.name: PURITO Pure Vitamin C Serum 60 ml
products.description:
PURITO Pure Vitamin C Serum: A Comprehensive Guide to Radiant, Healthy Skin

In the ever-evolving world of skincare, Vitamin C remains one of the most celebrated ingredients, praised for its brightening, anti-aging, and skin-rejuvenating properties. Among the many Vitamin C serums available today, PURITO Pure Vitamin C Serum has garnered attention for its thoughtful formulation, gentle yet effective approach, and suitability for all skin types. Whether you’re struggling with dark spots, dullness, or signs of aging, PURITO Pure Vitamin C Serum is designed to tackle multiple skin concerns while providing nourishment and protection to the skin.

What is PURITO Pure Vitamin C Serum?

PURITO Pure Vitamin C Serum is a skincare product formulated with 5% pure, stabilized Vitamin C (ascorbic acid), which has been carefully chosen to deliver the maximum benefits without causing irritation. Vitamin C is a well-known antioxidant that helps protect the skin from environmental stressors like UV rays, pollution, and free radicals. This serum’s formulation includes a host of additional ingredients that work synergistically to brighten the skin, improve skin texture, and provide deep hydration.

Key Benefits of PURITO Pure Vitamin C Serum

  1. Brightens the Skin: One of the most popular reasons to use Vitamin C in skincare is its ability to brighten and even out the skin tone. PURITO Pure Vitamin C Serum is designed to combat dullness and give the complexion a healthy glow. Vitamin C inhibits melanin production, the pigment responsible for dark spots and hyperpigmentation, resulting in a more radiant and even skin tone over time.
  2. Reduces Dark Spots and Hyperpigmentation: Dark spots, acne scars, and hyperpigmentation can be a significant concern for many people. PURITO’s Vitamin C Serum helps reduce the appearance of these skin discolorations by targeting the source of pigmentation. By inhibiting melanin production and promoting skin cell turnover, this serum gradually lightens the appearance of dark spots, leaving the skin clearer and more uniform in tone.
  3. Boosts Collagen Production: Vitamin C is known for its ability to stimulate collagen synthesis. Collagen is a key protein in the skin that helps maintain its firmness and elasticity. As we age, collagen production naturally decreases, which can lead to wrinkles, sagging, and loss of skin elasticity. PURITO Pure Vitamin C Serum helps stimulate collagen production, which supports skin structure and helps reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles.
  4. Fights Free Radicals and Protects Against Environmental Stressors: Environmental factors like UV rays, pollution, and smoke release free radicals that can cause oxidative damage to the skin, accelerating the signs of aging and damaging skin cells. Vitamin C is a potent antioxidant that helps neutralize free radicals, protecting the skin from premature aging and promoting overall skin health. This serum provides an added layer of protection against these harmful elements, keeping your skin looking youthful and vibrant.
  5. Hydrates and Soothes the Skin: In addition to its brightening and anti-aging benefits, PURITO Pure Vitamin C Serum is also formulated with hydrating ingredients like glycerin and panthenol. These ingredients help to lock in moisture, keeping the skin soft, smooth, and well-moisturized. The serum has a lightweight, non-greasy texture that makes it suitable for all skin types, including dry or sensitive skin.
  6. Gentle on Sensitive Skin: Unlike many other Vitamin C serums that contain higher concentrations of ascorbic acid, which can sometimes lead to irritation or redness, PURITO Pure Vitamin C Serum uses a mild 5% concentration of Vitamin C. This lower concentration is particularly beneficial for individuals with sensitive skin who may have trouble tolerating more potent Vitamin C formulas. Despite the gentle concentration, the serum is still highly effective at brightening and improving skin texture without causing irritation.

Key Ingredients in PURITO Pure Vitamin C Serum

  1. 5% Pure Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid): The star ingredient, ascorbic acid, is a powerful antioxidant known for its ability to brighten the skin, reduce hyperpigmentation, and protect the skin from environmental damage. At a 5% concentration, Vitamin C is effective at delivering visible results while being gentle enough for sensitive skin. It helps to stimulate collagen production, reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, and protect against oxidative damage.
  2. Hyaluronic Acid: Hyaluronic acid is a hydrating powerhouse known for its ability to hold water molecules and keep the skin moisturized. This ingredient helps the skin stay plump and hydrated while preventing dryness and irritation. Hyaluronic acid also enhances the absorption of other ingredients, ensuring that the serum is deeply penetrative.
  3. Panthenol (Provitamin B5): Panthenol is a soothing and moisturizing ingredient that helps to calm the skin and improve its barrier function. It aids in skin regeneration and reduces the likelihood of irritation from other active ingredients like Vitamin C. Panthenol also helps to keep the skin soft, smooth, and nourished, making it a perfect complement to Vitamin C.
  4. Glycerin: Glycerin is a humectant that draws moisture from the air into the skin, helping to keep the skin hydrated and soft. It helps to balance the skin’s moisture levels, making it a great ingredient for anyone with dry or dehydrated skin.
  5. Centella Asiatica Extract: Centella Asiatica, or ” Cica,” is a well-known plant extract that has anti-inflammatory properties. It helps to calm the skin, promote healing, and soothe irritation. This makes the serum suitable for those with sensitive or reactive skin types, as it reduces redness and discomfort.

How to Use PURITO Pure Vitamin C Serum

For optimal results, use PURITO Pure Vitamin C Serum as part of your morning skincare routine after cleansing and toning. Apply a small amount (2-3 drops) to your face and gently massage it in. Follow with a moisturizer to lock in hydration, and always apply sunscreen afterward to protect the skin from UV damage. Since Vitamin C can increase your skin’s sensitivity to sunlight, daily sunscreen use is essential when using this serum.

PURITO Pure Vitamin C Serum – 60ml

স্কিন ব্রাইটেনিং + দাগ হালকা + গ্লাস-স্কিন মতো গ্লো—এক বোতলে সম্পূর্ণ কেয়ার

যাদের স্কিনে দাগ–ছোপ, সান ড্যামেজ, ডালনেস বা আনইভেন টোন—এই সমস্যাগুলো একসাথে ঠিক করে এমন একটি সিরাম খুঁজছেন, PURITO Pure Vitamin C Serum হতে পারে তাদের জন্য পারফেক্ট চয়েস। এতে আছে 5% Ascorbic Acid (Pure Vitamin C)—যা স্কিন ব্রাইট করার জন্য সবচেয়ে কার্যকর ফর্ম। এর সাথে Niacinamide, Glutathione এবং Hydrating Base (Butylene Glycol) মিলে স্কিনকে দেয় ব্রাইট, প্লাম্প এবং গ্লাস-স্কিন ফিনিশ।

🔍 পণ্যের পরিচিতি

products.name: Dr.Althea Pure Grinding Cleansing Balm 50 ml
products.description:
Dr.Althea Pure Grinding Cleansing Balm 50 ml is a Korean oil-based facial cleanser formulated with only 14 ingredients. Dr.Althea positions this concise formula as providing a gentle cleansing experience for sensitive skin while effectively dissolving sunscreen, long-wear makeup and oil-soluble buildup.

The solid balm melts into a smooth cleansing oil during massage and turns into a milky emulsion when water is added. Its low-friction texture helps remove stubborn products without requiring excessive rubbing or tugging.

The formula contains Green Tea Seed Oil, Grape Seed Oil, Madecassoside, Centella Asiatica Extract and Asiaticoside for emollient, soothing and skin-conditioning support. Synthetic Wax helps maintain the balm’s solid structure so that it can be shaved and dispensed through the grinding mechanism.

The innovative twist-grinding container releases a fresh, controlled portion without repeatedly placing fingers or a spatula inside the main balm reservoir. This makes the cleansing process cleaner, more convenient and less messy.

Important: Although Dr.Althea positions the 14-ingredient formula as a gentle option for sensitive skin, individual compatibility can vary. The current official information also does not identify the product as non-comedogenic tested. Sensitive, acne-prone or easily clogged skin should patch-test and monitor its response.

Table of Contents

  • Product Overview
  • Why the 14-Ingredient Formula Matters
  • Grinding Dispenser Design
  • Key Benefits
  • Selected Formula Highlights
  • Texture and Cleansing Experience
  • Suitable Skin Types
  • How to Use
  • Double-Cleansing Routine
  • Product Details
  • Packaging and Version Information
  • Important Precautions
  • Frequently Asked Questions

Dr.Althea Pure Grinding Cleansing Balm Overview

Dr.Althea Pure Grinding Cleansing Balm is designed to remove stubborn sunscreen, daily makeup, waterproof formulas and accumulated oil-based residue. The balm melts smoothly across dry skin, reducing the need for aggressive rubbing or repeated wiping.

One of the product’s principal selling points is its concise 14-ingredient formula. Dr.Althea presents this minimalist formulation as offering gentle cleansing for sensitive skin without compromising the product’s ability to dissolve sunscreen and makeup.

Its oil-based cleansing ingredients loosen makeup, sunscreen, excess sebum and other lipophilic impurities. After water is added, three emulsifying ingredients help the melted balm combine with water so that the dissolved residue can be rinsed away more easily.

The formula is designed to leave the skin feeling soft and comfortable rather than intentionally tight or heavily stripped. However, the final experience may vary according to skin type, the amount used, the products being removed and how thoroughly the balm is emulsified and rinsed.

As an oil-based first cleanser, it may be used alone when appropriate or followed with a water-based facial cleanser as part of an evening double-cleansing routine.

Why the 14-Ingredient Formula Matters

The complete formula contains only 14 ingredients, and the full declaration is printed on the front of the green container. This makes the composition comparatively easy to review for customers who prefer concise or minimalist skincare formulas.

A shorter ingredient declaration does not automatically mean that a product will suit every skin type. However, it can make identifying personal sensitivities or ingredients a customer wishes to avoid more straightforward.

The 14 ingredients collectively perform several essential functions:

  • Oil-based ingredients dissolve sunscreen, makeup and oily residue
  • Synthetic Wax maintains the solid balm structure
  • Three emulsifiers help the balm mix with water and rinse away
  • Green Tea Seed Oil and Grape Seed Oil provide emollient conditioning
  • Madecassoside, Centella Asiatica Extract and Asiaticoside provide soothing and skin-conditioning support
  • Supporting ingredients help maintain formula stability and usability

The presence of only 14 ingredients should not be interpreted as a guarantee that irritation, breakouts or allergic reactions cannot occur. Individual tolerance remains important, particularly for highly reactive skin.

How Does the Grinding Dispenser Work?

The container uses a twist-grinding mechanism instead of a conventional open cleansing-balm jar. Turning the upper section clockwise releases a freshly shaved portion of balm through the dispensing surface.

More Hygienic Dispensing

The design reduces the need to repeatedly dip fingers or a spatula into the main balm reservoir. This can make dispensing cleaner and more convenient, especially when skincare is performed quickly or while travelling.

The packaging should still be handled with clean, dry hands. “Hygienic” does not mean that the product or dispenser is sterile.

Controlled Amount

The grinding mechanism allows the user to dispense only the amount required for each cleansing session. Twist gradually because releasing more balm than needed may cause unnecessary product waste.

No Separate Spatula Required

A separate cosmetic scoop or spatula is not normally required. The freshly ground balm appears on the upper surface and can be collected directly with clean, dry fingers.

How Synthetic Wax Supports the Grinding Format

Synthetic Wax gives the formula enough firmness and structural stability to remain in a solid balm form inside the container. This allows the upper mechanism to shave and dispense a controlled portion instead of releasing a loose liquid cleansing oil.

Once the dispensed balm is warmed between the fingers or massaged over the face, the firm structure softens and transforms into a smooth oil-like texture.

Do not pour water into the dispenser or collect the balm with wet fingers. Keeping the container dry helps preserve the intended texture and grinding performance.

Key Benefits of Dr.Althea Pure Grinding Cleansing Balm

  • Features a concise formula containing only 14 ingredients
  • Positioned by Dr.Althea for gentle cleansing of sensitive skin
  • Dissolves sunscreen, daily makeup and long-wear formulas
  • Helps remove waterproof makeup with less rubbing
  • Melts smoothly over dry skin to reduce unnecessary tugging
  • Emulsifies with water for easier rinsing
  • Removes oil-soluble residue as the first cleansing step
  • Leaves the skin feeling soft and comfortable after cleansing
  • Features a hygienic twist-grinding dispenser
  • Provides a controlled portion without dipping into an open jar
  • Does not require a separate cosmetic spatula
  • Contains Green Tea Seed Oil and Grape Seed Oil
  • Includes Madecassoside, Centella Asiatica Extract and Asiaticoside
  • Can be incorporated into an evening double-cleansing routine
  • Comes in a compact 50 ml container

Selected Formula Highlights

Dr.Althea Pure Grinding Cleansing Balm contains a total of 14 ingredients. The following sections explain the principal roles of the cleansing, structural, emulsifying and conditioning components without presenting the formula as a medical treatment.

Cetyl Ethylhexanoate and Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride

These lightweight emollient ingredients help dissolve oil-based makeup, sunscreen and surface residue while allowing the balm to spread smoothly across the skin.

They contribute to makeup removal and reduce friction during massage. They should not be interpreted as ingredients that medically detoxify the skin, treat acne or permanently reduce sebum production.

Synthetic Wax

Synthetic Wax provides the structure that keeps the formula in a firm balm state inside the container. This firmness is essential to the product’s grinding format because it allows the mechanism to shave off a controlled portion.

After the balm is dispensed, body heat and massage soften the wax-supported structure so that the product can spread like a cleansing oil.

PEG-20 Glyceryl Triisostearate

PEG-20 Glyceryl Triisostearate is an emulsifying cleansing ingredient commonly used in cleansing oils and balms. It helps oil-based makeup, sunscreen and residue disperse when water is added.

PEG-10 Isostearate

PEG-10 Isostearate provides additional emulsifying support. It helps the melted balm mix with water, contributing to the milky texture produced during the emulsification stage.

Sorbitan Sesquioleate

Sorbitan Sesquioleate functions as another emulsifying and formula-supporting ingredient. It helps stabilise the oil-rich balm and supports cleaner rinsing when the product is used correctly.

The formula therefore contains PEG-derived emulsifiers. Customers who personally avoid PEG-based cosmetic ingredients should consider PEG-20 Glyceryl Triisostearate and PEG-10 Isostearate before purchase.

Green Tea Seed Oil

Camellia Sinensis Seed Oil provides emollient and skin-conditioning support. It helps soften the skin and contributes to a more comfortable after-cleansing feel.

Green Tea Seed Oil should not be confused with a strong exfoliating or acne-treatment ingredient. Its role in this rinse-off product is primarily conditioning.

Grape Seed Oil

Vitis Vinifera or Grape Seed Oil helps condition and soften the skin during cleansing. It also supports the balm’s smooth, oil-like slip, helping reduce friction while makeup and sunscreen are dissolved.

Madecassoside

Madecassoside is a Centella-derived component associated with soothing and skin-conditioning care. Within this rinse-off cleanser, it complements the formula’s gentle-cleansing positioning.

Centella Asiatica Extract

Centella Asiatica Extract provides additional soothing and conditioning support. It complements the product’s positioning for sensitive skin, although a rinse-off cleansing balm cannot treat medical inflammation or active skin disease.

Asiaticoside

Asiaticoside is another Centella-related component included for skin-conditioning support. It works alongside Madecassoside and Centella Asiatica Extract within the concise 14-ingredient formula.

Caprylyl Glycol and Ethylhexylglycerin

These multifunctional ingredients provide conditioning and formula-supporting benefits. They also help maintain the usability and stability of the cleansing balm.

Product formulas may be updated. Always check the container received for the latest ingredient declaration.

Texture and Cleansing Experience

The product begins as a firm balm inside the grinder. Once dispensed and warmed between dry fingers or massaged over dry skin, it melts into a silky oil-like texture.

The melted balm provides enough slip to loosen makeup and sunscreen without excessive pulling. Adding a small amount of water changes the oily texture into a lighter, milky emulsion.

Thorough emulsification is an important part of the cleansing process. Rinsing the balm without adding water first may leave some users with a heavier or oilier after-feel.

The current 14-ingredient declaration does not list added fragrance or parfum. It also does not list essential oils or artificial colourants. However, botanical seed oils and extracts may have their own mild natural odour.

Which Skin Types Can Use It?

Dr.Althea specifically positions the concise 14-ingredient formula as offering a gentle cleansing experience for sensitive skin. The balm may also be considered for:

  • Sensitive skin requiring a low-friction cleansing step
  • Normal skin
  • Dry skin
  • Dehydrated-looking skin
  • Combination skin
  • Oily skin using sunscreen or makeup
  • Skin that feels uncomfortable after harsh cleansing
  • Users who prefer balm cleansers over liquid cleansing oils
  • Users seeking a concise or minimalist cleansing formula

Dry skin may appreciate the balm’s soft and comfortable finish. Combination or oily skin should emulsify and rinse it thoroughly and may follow with a suitable water-based cleanser.

Sensitive skin may consider the brand’s gentle-cleansing positioning, 14-ingredient formula and absence of listed added fragrance. However, this does not guarantee compatibility for every sensitive-skin user. Patch testing remains recommended.

The current official information does not confirm a non-comedogenic test. Acne-prone or easily clogged skin should begin cautiously, rinse thoroughly and monitor for new congestion or irritation.

People with known sensitivities to cleansing oils, esters, PEG-based emulsifiers, Green Tea Seed Oil, Grape Seed Oil or Centella-derived ingredients should review the formula before use.

How to Use Dr.Althea Pure Grinding Cleansing Balm

  1. Begin with completely dry hands and a dry face.
  2. Turn the upper part of the container clockwise to dispense an appropriate amount.
  3. Collect the freshly dispensed balm with clean, dry fingers.
  4. Apply it evenly over the dry face.
  5. Massage gently in circular motions to dissolve sunscreen, makeup and surface residue.
  6. Avoid aggressively rubbing or pulling the skin.
  7. Add a small amount of lukewarm water to the hands.
  8. Continue massaging until the balm turns into a milky emulsion.
  9. Rinse the face thoroughly with lukewarm water.
  10. Follow with a water-based cleanser when double cleansing is required.

Use enough balm to create comfortable slip. Using too little may increase friction, while using an excessive amount may make emulsification and rinsing more difficult.

For Eye Makeup

Keep the eyes closed and massage gently without pulling the eyelids. Waterproof mascara may require additional time or a dedicated eye-makeup remover.

Avoid allowing the balm to enter the eyes. If temporary cloudiness, stinging or discomfort occurs, rinse immediately with plenty of clean water.

For Heavy or Waterproof Makeup

Massage the balm over heavily made-up areas first, allowing the formula time to loosen the product. Do not scrub aggressively. Repeat cleansing only when necessary.

Recommended Double-Cleansing Routine

Evening routine: Dr.Althea Pure Grinding Cleansing Balm → Water-Based Facial Cleanser → Toner → Serum → Moisturizer

The cleansing balm functions as the oil-based first step, helping dissolve sunscreen, makeup and sebum-based residue. A water-based cleanser can then remove remaining sweat, water-soluble debris and residual cleansing balm.

Double cleansing may be particularly useful after wearing water-resistant sunscreen, foundation, concealer or other long-wear makeup. It is not automatically necessary twice a day or after every cleansing session.

Over-cleansing can cause dryness, tightness or irritation. Adjust the second cleanser and cleansing frequency according to the skin’s condition and the products worn during the day.

Anua Heartleaf Pore Control Cleansing Oil 200 ml is a lightweight Korean oil cleanser that removes makeup, sunscreen, excess sebum and daily impurities in one cleansing step. Its non-comedogenic, low-irritation formula emulsifies easily with water and rinses clean without leaving a heavy or greasy residue. Suitable for all skin types, it is especially gentle for sensitive and breakout-prone skin.

Why Choose Anua Heartleaf Pore Control Cleansing Oil?

Water-based cleansers may not completely remove oil-based impurities such as long-wearing makeup, water-resistant sunscreen and excess sebum. Anua Heartleaf Pore Control Cleansing Oil works as the first step of a double-cleansing routine, helping dissolve these impurities before they are rinsed away with water.

The lightweight texture spreads comfortably across dry skin, allowing it to lift away buildup without harsh rubbing. After adding water, the oil turns milky and washes off easily, leaving the skin feeling clean, smooth and refreshed rather than oily.

7 Key Benefits

  • Removes makeup effectively: Helps dissolve foundation, base makeup and other oil-soluble cosmetic residue.
  • Melts away sunscreen: Removes daily sunscreen that may not wash away completely with a water-based cleanser alone.
  • Cleans excess sebum: Helps lift unwanted oil and impurities from the skin for a cleaner-looking complexion.
  • Supports pore care: Regular and thorough cleansing helps prevent makeup, sunscreen and sebum from building up around the pores.
  • Leaves a lightweight finish: Emulsifies with water and rinses away without an uncomfortable greasy film.
  • Suitable for sensitive skin: The manufacturer has completed hypoallergenic and low-irritation testing on the formula.
  • Non-comedogenic: Designed for all skin types, including sensitive and breakout-prone complexions.

How Anua Heartleaf Pore Control Cleansing Oil Works

Oil attracts oil-based buildup. When massaged onto a dry face, the cleansing oil helps loosen makeup, sunscreen, sebum and environmental impurities. Adding a small amount of water begins the emulsification process, turning the oil into a light, milky texture that can be rinsed away.

Proper emulsification is essential. It helps the oil and dissolved residue wash off cleanly instead of remaining on the skin. Following with a water-based cleanser completes the double-cleansing routine by removing any remaining water-soluble dirt and residue.

Key Ingredients

Heartleaf Extract

Houttuynia cordata, commonly known as Heartleaf, is included to support a calm and comfortable skin feel. It makes the formula particularly appealing for skin that is sensitive or easily stressed by cleansing.

Plant-Derived Cleansing Oils

The formula contains sunflower seed oil, macadamia seed oil, olive fruit oil, jojoba seed oil, grape seed oil and moringa seed oil. These ingredients give Anua Heartleaf Pore Control Cleansing Oil its smooth, spreadable texture while helping dissolve oil-based impurities.

Butyl Avocadate

Butyl avocadate is included in the formula to support sebum care. According to the manufacturer, clinical testing showed a 22.8% change in sebum amount, supporting a clearer-looking complexion and improved-looking skin texture over time.

Turmeric and Botanical Extracts

Turmeric root, neem flower, neem leaf, holy basil and other botanical extracts complement the cleansing formula and help support a refreshed skin feel.

Skin Types and Concerns

Anua Heartleaf Pore Control Cleansing Oil is suitable for normal, dry, oily, combination and sensitive skin. It may be especially helpful for people who regularly wear makeup or sunscreen or experience excess sebum, visible pore buildup and a congested-looking complexion.

The formula is non-comedogenic and has completed hypoallergenic and low-irritation testing. However, individual sensitivities can vary. Patch-test before regular use, particularly if your skin is highly reactive or sensitive to fragranced skincare products.

How to Use Anua Heartleaf Pore Control Cleansing Oil

  1. Begin with completely dry hands and a dry face.
  2. Dispense 2–3 pumps of cleansing oil into your palms.
  3. Gently massage the oil over the face in circular motions, focusing on areas with makeup, sunscreen or excess sebum.
  4. Add a small amount of water and continue massaging until the oil turns milky.
  5. Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.
  6. Follow with a water-based facial cleanser to complete your double-cleansing routine.

Avoid rubbing the skin aggressively. Gentle massage and thorough emulsification are more important than applying extra pressure. If the product comes into contact with the eyes, rinse carefully with clean water.

When Should You Use It?

Anua Heartleaf Pore Control Cleansing Oil can be used as the first step of your evening routine whenever you have applied sunscreen, makeup or other oil-based products. It may also be used when excess sebum and daily buildup need to be removed thoroughly.

After double cleansing, continue with toner, serum and moisturizer according to your skin’s needs. There is usually no need to use an oil cleanser in the morning unless your skincare routine or skin condition specifically requires it.

Anua Heartleaf Pore Control Cleansing Oil has a fluid, lightweight texture that glides across dry skin without requiring harsh rubbing. It emulsifies quickly and rinses clean, helping the skin feel soft, fresh and comfortable rather than coated in oily residue.

The Joseon Dynasty, one of Korea’s longest and most prosperous periods, is known not only for its advancements in culture, politics, and technology but also for its refined beauty traditions. During this era, skincare was an essential part of daily life, and the aristocracy maintained intricate beauty routines that utilized natural ingredients found in their environment. Traditional herbal remedies, such as  ginseng, rice, and various plant extracts, were highly prized for their purported benefits in enhancing skin health and promoting a youthful appearance.

The Beauty of Joseon brand pays homage to these ancient practices by incorporating key ingredients that were used by the royalty and nobility of the Joseon era. In doing so, it bridges the gap between the old and the new, giving modern skincare enthusiasts a taste of time-tested beauty secrets.

These ingredients are combined with advanced skincare science to deliver impressive results. Whether you have dry, aging, or sensitive skin, this cream promises to be a game-changer in your skincare routine.

The cream’s key ingredients, such as ginseng, rice, and various herbal extracts, are carefully chosen to provide multiple skin benefits. The product is lightweight yet deeply nourishing, making it suitable for all skin types, especially those with dry or dehydrated skin.

Key Ingredients and Their Benefits

  1. Ginseng: Known as a powerhouse in Korean skincare, ginseng has been used for centuries for its anti-aging and skin-soothing properties. Rich in antioxidants, ginseng helps to fight oxidative stress, reduce inflammation, and improve circulation. This ingredient is often celebrated for its ability to rejuvenate and regenerate skin, helping to reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles over time. It also aids in boosting skin elasticity, making it an essential component in maintaining a youthful look.
  2. Rice: Rice has long been a staple in traditional Korean skincare due to its rich content of vitamins, minerals, and amino acids. It helps to brighten the complexion, repair damaged skin, and improve skin texture. Rice extract is also known for its ability to lock in moisture and promote a smooth, soft feel. It provides a subtle glow, making the skin appear healthy and radiant. For those with dull or uneven skin tone, rice extract can help enhance the skin’s natural luminosity.
  3. Honey: Honey is a natural humectant, meaning it attracts and retains moisture in the skin. Its antimicrobial properties also help protect the skin from bacteria, making it ideal for sensitive or acne-prone skin. Honey helps to maintain hydration, leaving the skin soft, smooth, and plump.
  4. Herbal Extracts: In addition to ginseng and rice, the Dynasty Cream contains a variety of other herbal extracts, each with its own unique benefits. These ingredients, including green tea and licorice root, are rich in antioxidants and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to calm irritated skin, reduce redness, and provide overall skin protection. They work synergistically to improve the skin’s health and appearance, ensuring that the skin feels nourished and balanced.

The Texture and Application

One of the standout features of Beauty of Joseon Dynasty Cream is its rich yet lightweight texture. Upon application, the cream glides smoothly onto the skin, absorbing quickly without leaving a greasy residue. It provides an immediate feeling of hydration and comfort, making it ideal for both day and night use. The formula is designed to provide deep nourishment, yet it feels light enough for daily use, making it perfect for those with oily or combination skin who still require intense moisture.

Product Overview

Grincelllabs Melazero Daily Whitening Cream is a 50 ml daily moisturizing cream formulated for uneven skin tone, visible dark spots, dullness and early signs of ageing.

Rather than relying on a single brightening ingredient, it combines two of Korea’s approved brightening actives with a high-concentration botanical base, peptides, a multi-type Hyaluronic Acid complex and moisturizing ingredients.

Grincelllabs describes the formula as using the nutrients of Vitamin Tree fruit to keep skin healthy while easing the appearance of melasma and pigmentation, turning dull, tired skin into a more elastic and luminous complexion.

Korean Dual-Functional Status

Both the carton and the jar carry the declaration 미백, 주름개선 이중 기능성 화장품 — a Korean dual-function cosmetic registered for brightening and wrinkle improvement.

Its two officially stated claims are printed on the box: it helps brighten the skin and helps improve the appearance of wrinkles.

The jar additionally carries the mark 피부 저자극 테스트 완료 — skin low-irritation testing completed.

Key Benefits

  • Registered Korean dual-function cosmetic for brightening and wrinkle improvement.
  • Niacinamide at 5% — the top of Korea’s approved range for the brightening claim.
  • Vitamin Tree Water at 65.8%, forming the base of the formula.
  • Alpha-Bisabolol, a second approved brightening ingredient.
  • Glutathione for antioxidant and radiance support.
  • Adenosine, Korea’s approved wrinkle-improvement active.
  • A complex of 6 peptides for elasticity and conditioning support.
  • A 12-type Hyaluronic Acid complex for multi-level moisture.
  • Panthenol and Glycerin support hydration and comfort.
  • Helps dull, dry skin look smoother and more luminous.
  • Skin low-irritation test completed.
  • Light, refreshing texture that sits well under makeup.

Niacinamide 5% — The Main Brightening Active

Niacinamide — 50,000 ppm (5%)

Niacinamide, a form of Vitamin B3, is declared on the packaging at 50,000 ppm, which is 5%.

That figure is the most important one on the box. In Korea, Niacinamide is an approved active for the 미백 brightening claim at 2% to 5% — so this cream is formulated at the maximum permitted level, not a token amount included for the label.

Niacinamide works on uneven tone by interfering with the transfer of pigment to the skin’s surface cells, which is why it is the most widely used brightening active in Korean functional cosmetics. It also supports the skin barrier and helps improve the look of dullness and enlarged-looking pores.

Alpha-Bisabolol

Alpha-Bisabolol is the formula’s second approved brightening ingredient. It is also recognised in Korea as an active for the 미백 claim, which means the cream’s brightening side rests on two approved actives rather than one.

Alpha-Bisabolol is also a well-known soothing ingredient, which makes it a sensible partner for Niacinamide at 5% — brightening care benefits from something that keeps the skin calm alongside it.

Vitamin Tree Water 65.8%

Hippophae Rhamnoides Water — 658,197 ppm (65.8%)

Hippophae Rhamnoides Water — Sea Buckthorn, known in Korea as Vitamin Tree — is declared at 658,197 ppm, which is 65.8%.

This is not a botanical extract added near the end of a formula. At roughly two-thirds of the cream, it replaces most of what would ordinarily just be water, so the base itself carries the fruit’s naturally vitamin- and antioxidant-rich composition.

Vitamin Tree provides antioxidant, moisturizing and skin-conditioning support, and Grincelllabs builds the product’s whole concept around it.

Glutathione — What It Does Here

Glutathione is included in the formula as an antioxidant, supporting a healthier, more radiant-looking complexion alongside the Vitamin Tree base.

It is worth being precise about its role. Glutathione is not one of Korea’s approved actives for the brightening claim — that claim rests on the Niacinamide and Alpha-Bisabolol in this formula. Glutathione works here as a supporting antioxidant ingredient, not as the brightening active, and topical glutathione in a cream should not be confused with glutathione taken for skin-lightening purposes by other routes.

Adenosine & Wrinkle Care

Adenosine is the ingredient behind the second half of the product’s dual-function registration. It is Korea’s approved active for the 주름개선 wrinkle-improvement claim and supports the appearance of smoother, more elastic-looking skin.

Pairing it with the brightening actives is the reason this is a dual-function cream rather than a brightening-only one.

6-Peptide Complex

The packaging declares a complex of 6 peptides for elasticity and conditioning support.

The peptides include:

  • Copper Tripeptide-1
  • Acetyl Tetrapeptide-5
  • Palmitoyl Oligopeptide
  • Palmitoyl Pentapeptide-4
  • Palmitoyl Tripeptide-5
  • Hexapeptide-3

Peptides in a cosmetic cream are supportive conditioning ingredients. They complement the Adenosine rather than replacing it, and they do not reverse structural skin ageing.

12 Hyaluronic Acid Complex

The packaging declares a 12-type Hyaluronic Acid complex, bringing together forms that differ in molecular size and in how they bind water.

The complex includes:

  • Sodium Hyaluronate
  • Hyaluronic Acid
  • Hydrolyzed Sodium Hyaluronate
  • Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid
  • Sodium Hyaluronate Crosspolymer
  • Sodium Acetylated Hyaluronate
  • Dimethylsilanol Hyaluronate
  • Hydroxypropyltrimonium Hyaluronate
  • Potassium Hyaluronate

Together they help attract and hold moisture at different depths, supporting a smoother, plumper-looking skin surface. Hydration matters for a brightening cream: dry skin reflects light poorly and reads as duller than it is.

Moisture & Soothing Care

Panthenol

Panthenol, also known as Pro-Vitamin B5, provides moisturizing, soothing and barrier-supporting care.

Glycerin

Glycerin is a humectant that attracts moisture and helps keep the skin soft.

Allantoin

Allantoin helps soothe and condition the skin, supporting the cream’s daily-use positioning.

What to Realistically Expect

Brightening care works gradually and unevenly, so it is worth setting expectations honestly.

Niacinamide at 5% is a genuinely effective level for improving the look of uneven tone, post-blemish marks and dullness, but changes build over weeks to months of consistent use, not days.

This is a cosmetic product, not a medical one. It is not a treatment for melasma or any other pigmentation disorder, and deeper or hormonal pigmentation generally needs a dermatologist rather than a cream.

The single most important factor is sunscreen. Without daily UV protection, new pigment forms faster than any brightening cream can improve the old — sunscreen is not optional alongside this product, it is what makes it work.

What does Grincelllabs Melazero Daily Whitening Cream do?

It brightens and hydrates while supporting wrinkle care, helping improve the look of dullness, dark spots and uneven skin tone.

Is it an approved functional cosmetic in Korea?

Yes. Both the box and the jar carry the 미백, 주름개선 이중 기능성 화장품 declaration — a dual-function cosmetic for brightening and wrinkle improvement.

How much Niacinamide does it contain?

5%, declared as 50,000 ppm. Korea permits Niacinamide at 2–5% for the brightening claim, so this is formulated at the maximum level.

65.8%, declared as 658,197 ppm — roughly two-thirds of the cream, forming its base rather than being a small added extract.

Which ingredients actually carry the brightening claim?

products.name: Dabo Pink Collagen PDRN Brightening UV Sunscreen SPF 50+ PA+++ 50 ml
products.description:
Introduction

Dabo Pink Collagen PDRN Sunscreen, officially named Dabo Pink Collagen PDRN Brightening UV Sunscreen SPF50+ PA+++, is a daily Korean sunscreen designed to protect the skin from harmful UVA and UVB rays while providing additional brightening, moisturizing, and skin-conditioning care.

With SPF50+ PA+++, the formula provides high daily UV protection, making it suitable as the final step of a morning skincare routine.

Unlike sunscreen products focused only on UV defense, this formula highlights PDRN and Collagen to support smoother, hydrated, and more radiant-looking skin.

Its lightweight texture is designed for comfortable everyday application and can be used on the face before makeup or as the final layer of a simple skincare routine.

For anyone looking for everyday UV protection with additional skincare benefits, Dabo Pink Collagen PDRN Sunscreen provides a convenient combination of sun protection, hydration, and brightening-focused care.

Key Ingredients

PDRN

PDRN is one of the hero ingredients highlighted in the formula.

In topical skincare, PDRN is used as a skin-conditioning ingredient and is increasingly found in Korean skincare products focused on hydration, smoothness, elasticity, and healthier-looking skin.

In Dabo Pink Collagen PDRN Sunscreen, PDRN complements the sunscreen’s moisturizing and brightening-focused formula.

Rather than replacing dedicated treatment products, it provides additional skincare support while the sunscreen performs its primary role of protecting the skin from UV exposure.

Collagen

Collagen is another key ingredient highlighted in this sunscreen.

Topical collagen primarily provides moisturizing and skin-conditioning benefits, helping the skin feel smoother, softer, and more supple.

It can also support a plumper and more hydrated-looking finish, which complements the formula’s overall radiant-skin concept.

The combination of Collagen and PDRN makes this sunscreen especially appealing to people who prefer sun protection with additional moisturizing skincare benefits.

Key Benefits

  • Provides high SPF50+ PA+++ sun protection.
  • Helps protect skin against UVA and UVB rays.
  • Supports everyday protection from sun exposure.
  • Contains PDRN for skin-conditioning care.
  • Contains Collagen to support a soft and moisturized skin feel.
  • Helps maintain skin hydration throughout the day.
  • Supports smoother-looking skin.
  • Helps improve the appearance of dull and tired-looking skin.
  • Supports a fresh and naturally radiant-looking complexion.
  • Lightweight formula is comfortable for everyday use.
  • Can be used as the final step of a morning skincare routine.
  • Works conveniently before daytime makeup.
  • Combines sun protection with moisturizing skincare benefits.

How It Works

The primary function of Dabo Pink Collagen PDRN Sunscreen is to create effective daily protection against ultraviolet radiation.

The SPF50+ rating represents a high level of protection against UVB radiation, which is strongly associated with sunburn and direct UV-related skin damage.

The PA+++ rating indicates a high level of UVA protection. UVA rays penetrate more deeply into the skin and are associated with visible photoaging, uneven-looking pigmentation, and long-term sun-related skin changes.

By applying the sunscreen evenly before sun exposure, it helps reduce the amount of harmful UV radiation affecting the skin.

At the same time, PDRN and Collagen provide complementary skin-conditioning and moisturizing care.

Collagen helps support a softer and more hydrated skin feel, while PDRN contributes to the formula’s smoothness and healthy-looking skin focus.

This makes the sunscreen useful for people who want their daytime sun care to provide more than UV protection alone.

Regular sunscreen use is also one of the most important steps in protecting the appearance of an even skin tone because repeated UV exposure can contribute to dullness and the appearance of dark spots.

Skin Type

Dabo Pink Collagen PDRN Brightening UV Sunscreen can fit a variety of daily skincare routines.

It may be particularly useful for:

  • Normal skin
  • Dry skin
  • Combination skin
  • Dehydrated-feeling skin
  • Dull-looking skin
  • Skin concerned with uneven-looking tone
  • Skin that prefers moisturizing sunscreen
  • Skin concerned with visible signs of sun exposure

People with very sensitive or reactive skin should always check the complete ingredient list on the packaging before use.

Individual skin response may vary, so patch testing is recommended when trying a new sunscreen.

How to Use

Use Dabo Pink Collagen PDRN Sunscreen as the final step of your morning skincare routine.

After applying moisturizer, take an adequate amount of sunscreen and spread it evenly over the face and neck.

Do not forget commonly missed areas such as:

  • Ears
  • Jawline
  • Hairline
  • Sides of the face
  • Front and sides of the neck

Apply sunscreen before going outdoors and allow it to settle properly on the skin.

For continued UV protection, reapply during prolonged sun exposure, particularly after heavy sweating, wiping the face, or spending extended periods outdoors.

If you wear makeup, allow the sunscreen to settle before applying foundation or other complexion products.

Sunscreen should be used every day, including on cloudy days, because UVA radiation can still reach the skin even when direct sunlight appears less intense.

For stronger overall sun protection, combine sunscreen with protective clothing, sunglasses, hats, and shade whenever appropriate.

Why Choose It?

One of the main advantages of Dabo Pink Collagen PDRN Sunscreen is that it combines daily UV protection with moisturizing and skin-conditioning care.

For many people, sunscreen is a product that needs to be worn every day. Therefore, texture, comfort, and additional skincare benefits can make a significant difference in maintaining consistent use.

The SPF50+ PA+++ rating provides strong daily protection, while Collagen helps support softness and hydration.

PDRN adds another skin-conditioning element, making the formula particularly appealing within modern Korean skincare routines focused on healthy-looking, radiant skin.

The sunscreen is also suitable for people who want a single daytime step that combines UV defense with hydration and a brighter-looking finish.

For skin concerned with dullness, dehydration, or daily sun exposure, it can be a practical addition to a regular morning skincare routine.

FAQ

What is Dabo Pink Collagen PDRN Sunscreen used for?

It is primarily designed to protect skin from UVA and UVB rays while providing additional hydration, brightening, and skin-conditioning benefits.

What SPF does it have?

The sunscreen provides SPF50+ PA+++ protection.

What does SPF50+ mean?

SPF primarily measures protection against UVB radiation. SPF50+ indicates a high level of UVB protection when the sunscreen is applied correctly.

What does PA+++ mean?

PA measures UVA protection. PA+++ indicates a high level of UVA protection.

Does it contain PDRN?

Yes. PDRN is one of the key skincare ingredients highlighted in Dabo Pink Collagen PDRN Sunscreen.

Does it contain Collagen?

Yes. Collagen is highlighted as a key moisturizing and skin-conditioning ingredient.

Does it help brighten the skin?

The product is marketed as a brightening UV sunscreen and supports a fresh and radiant-looking complexion. Sunscreen itself also helps protect against UV exposure that can contribute to uneven-looking pigmentation.

Can I use it every day?

Yes. Sunscreen is intended for regular daytime use and should be applied as the final step of your morning skincare routine.

Can it be used under makeup?

Yes. Allow the sunscreen to settle after application before applying foundation or other makeup products.

Do I need to reapply it?

Yes. Reapplication is important during prolonged sun exposure, especially after sweating, wiping the face, or activities that may reduce sunscreen coverage.

products.name: Beaute Glutathione Brightening Tone Up Cream 45 ml
products.description:
Beaute Glutathione Brightening Tone Up Cream 45 ml is a lightweight Korean tone-up moisturizer designed to give dull and uneven-looking skin an instantly brighter, smoother and more radiant appearance. The formula combines 1,000 ppm glutathione, niacinamide, sodium hyaluronate, three types of ceramide and multiple botanical extracts to support both immediate tone-up and everyday moisturizing care.

The creamy texture blends across the skin to create a fresh, even-looking finish without requiring a separate foundation. Along with its visible tone-up effect, the formula helps maintain hydration, soften rough-looking texture and support a healthy-looking complexion.

Table of Contents

  • What Is a Tone-Up Cream?
  • Why Choose This Beaute Cream?
  • 7 Key Skin Benefits
  • Key Ingredients
  • Skin Types and Concerns
  • How to Use
  • Complete Ingredients
  • Frequently Asked Questions

What Is a Tone-Up Cream?

A tone-up cream is a skincare and cosmetic hybrid that creates an immediately brighter and more even-looking finish. Unlike a foundation, it generally provides light coverage and a natural-looking radiance rather than concealing every mark or imperfection.

The immediate tone-up result is mainly cosmetic and washes away during cleansing. However, ingredients such as niacinamide, glutathione, sodium hyaluronate and ceramides provide additional skincare support when the product is used consistently.

Why Choose Beaute Glutathione Brightening Tone Up Cream?

Beaute Glutathione Brightening Tone Up Cream combines the convenience of a tone-up base with the comfort of a moisturizing cream. It is suitable for days when you want the complexion to appear fresh and radiant without applying a heavy foundation.

The formula contains brightening-support ingredients, humectants, silicones, ceramides and plant extracts. It spreads smoothly and helps visually soften dullness and uneven tone while providing a comfortable layer of moisture.

7 Benefits of Beaute Glutathione Brightening Tone Up Cream

  • Instant tone-up effect: Creates an immediately brighter and fresher-looking complexion after application.
  • Improves the look of uneven tone: Helps visibly balance dull, patchy or uneven-looking areas.
  • Supports long-term brightening care: Niacinamide and 1,000 ppm glutathione help improve the appearance of dullness and discoloration with consistent use.
  • Provides daily hydration: Glycerin, sodium hyaluronate, trehalose and butylene glycol help attract and maintain moisture.
  • Supports the skin barrier: Ceramide NP, Ceramide AP and Ceramide EOP help maintain a soft and comfortable skin feel.
  • Smooths the complexion: The silicone-based texture helps create a smoother surface and reduces the visible appearance of rough texture.
  • Works as a makeup base: The tone-up finish can help prepare the complexion for light, natural-looking makeup.

How Does the Tone-Up Effect Work?

The ingredient list contains zinc oxide and titanium dioxide, which are mineral powders that can create a visibly brighter finish on the skin. Silicones such as cyclomethicone, dimethicone and cyclopentasiloxane help the cream spread evenly and produce a smoother appearance.

The amount applied can affect the final result. Applying too much at once may look pale, uneven or ashy, particularly on medium to deep skin tones. Begin with a small amount and blend it gradually across the face and neck for a more natural-looking finish.

Although the formula contains zinc oxide and titanium dioxide, no verified SPF or PA rating is stated for this product. Therefore, Beaute Glutathione Brightening Tone Up Cream should not be used as a replacement for a properly labelled broad-spectrum sunscreen.

Key Ingredients

Glutathione—1,000 ppm

Glutathione is an antioxidant included to support a brighter and more radiant-looking complexion. The formula contains 1,000 ppm, equivalent to 0.1%. It complements niacinamide and the botanical extracts in the cream’s brightening-care system.

Niacinamide

Niacinamide, also known as vitamin B3, helps improve the appearance of dullness and uneven skin tone. It also supports the skin barrier and helps the complexion maintain a healthier, more balanced appearance.

Sodium Hyaluronate and Glycerin

Sodium hyaluronate and glycerin are moisture-attracting ingredients that help reduce a dry or tight feeling. They support a softer and more comfortable finish throughout the day.

Three Types of Ceramide

Ceramide NP, Ceramide AP and Ceramide EOP are included to support the skin’s natural moisture barrier. These ingredients can be particularly useful when the skin feels dry, rough or dehydrated.

Centella Asiatica, Aloe and Green Tea

Centella asiatica, aloe vera and green tea extracts provide soothing and antioxidant support. They help the formula care for skin that appears tired or stressed by dryness and environmental exposure.

Adenosine and Acetyl Hexapeptide-8

Adenosine and acetyl hexapeptide-8 are conditioning ingredients commonly used in formulas designed to support smoother and firmer-looking skin. They help complement the cream’s moisturizing and texture-smoothing benefits.

Hydrolyzed Collagen

Hydrolyzed collagen functions primarily as a moisturizing and skin-conditioning ingredient when applied topically. It helps the skin feel softer and smoother but should not be interpreted as replacing the skin’s natural collagen.

Who Should Use Beaute Glutathione Brightening Tone Up Cream?

Beaute Glutathione Brightening Tone Up Cream may be suitable for normal, dry, combination and oily skin when used in an appropriate amount. It is particularly useful for concerns such as dullness, uneven-looking tone, dehydration, rough-looking texture or the need for an instant brighter finish.

People with dry skin can apply a moisturizer underneath if additional nourishment is needed. Oily or combination skin should begin with a thin layer to avoid a heavy appearance. Because the formula contains fragrance and numerous botanical extracts, sensitive skin should patch-test before regular use.

How to Use Beaute Glutathione Brightening Tone Up Cream

  1. Begin with cleansed skin and complete your toner and serum steps.
  2. Apply your regular moisturizer first if your skin needs additional hydration.
  3. Take a small amount of tone-up cream and dot it across the forehead, cheeks, nose and chin.
  4. Blend gently and evenly across the face, jawline and neck.
  5. Add another thin layer only where additional tone correction is needed.
  6. Allow the cream to settle before applying makeup.
  7. During the day, use a separate broad-spectrum sunscreen with an appropriate SPF rating.

A small amount usually creates the most natural-looking result. Avoid applying a thick layer at once, as this may produce an uneven or overly pale finish. Remove the product thoroughly at the end of the day with a suitable cleanser.

Can It Be Used as a Makeup Base?

Yes. The smooth tone-up finish can help prepare the complexion for makeup. It may be worn alone for a fresh no-makeup look or followed with foundation, concealer or powder. Let each skincare and sun-protection layer settle before applying the next product to reduce pilling.

Texture and Finish

Beaute Glutathione Brightening Tone Up Cream has a smooth, silicone-rich texture designed to spread easily and create an even-looking surface. Its finish is brighter and more polished than a regular transparent moisturizer.

The tone-up result can appear different depending on natural skin tone, the amount applied and the products layered underneath. Always blend carefully around the hairline, eyebrows, jaw and neck.

No cosmetic product should be expected to permanently change natural skin color. This cream creates a temporary tone-up effect, while ingredients such as niacinamide and glutathione help support a brighter and more even-looking complexion with consistent use.

AXIS-Y Dark Spot Correcting Glow Cream 50 ml works through three complementary approaches: tone care, hydration and barrier support.

Targeted Tone Care

SPF50+ PA+++ UV Protection

SPF50+ indicates a high level of protection against UVB rays, which are strongly associated with sunburn and contribute to cumulative sun damage.

PA+++ indicates strong UVA protection. UVA rays contribute to premature signs of photoaging and uneven-looking skin tone.

Consistent sunscreen use helps reduce unnecessary daily UV exposure. Adequate application and reapplication remain important because no sunscreen can block 100% of ultraviolet radiation.

Hybrid UV Filter System

This sunscreen uses both mineral and organic UV filters, and they sit high in the ingredient list rather than being present in token amounts.

Titanium Dioxide

Titanium Dioxide is a mineral UV filter that helps protect the skin from ultraviolet radiation. It is listed second, immediately after water, making it the formula’s single largest active.

Ethylhexyl Methoxycinnamate

Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane

Because both mineral and organic filters are included, this product is accurately described as a hybrid sunscreen rather than a purely mineral or purely chemical one.

The product is named a Brightening sun cream, and the packaging explains exactly what that means: the sunscreen gives a tone-up effect at the same time as sun protection, leaving the skin looking bright and radiant.

How Dr.Althea 147 Barrier Cream Supports the Skin Barrier

The skin barrier is the outer protective layer responsible for retaining moisture and limiting the effects of external irritants. Over-cleansing, harsh exfoliation, strong active products and environmental conditions can reduce its ability to hold hydration.

Dr.Althea 147 Barrier Cream combines moisture-attracting ingredients with nourishing lipids and barrier-supporting components. This balanced approach helps replenish hydration while creating a comfortable layer that reduces moisture loss.

Ectoin

With consistent cosmetic use, the cream helps dark spots and blemish marks look less noticeable while supporting a clearer, brighter and more even-looking complexion.

Despite its name and dark-spot positioning, this is a cosmetic brightening cream—not a medicine for melasma, acne, scars or any other skin disorder. Results depend on the type, depth and cause of the discoloration, skincare consistency and daily sun protection.

MEDI-PEEL Melanonx Cream 2.0 Overview

MEDI-PEEL Melanonx Cream 2.0 is designed as the final moisturizing step of a dark-spot and blemish-care routine. The packaging describes it as a brightening cream with Niacinamide that effectively targets dark spots and blemishes to help reveal a clear-looking complexion.

The formula does not rely on only one brightening ingredient. It combines Niacinamide with Tranexamic Acid, Ascorbic Acid, Magnesium Ascorbyl Phosphate and Alpha-Arbutin. These ingredients approach uneven-looking tone through complementary cosmetic functions while moisturizing ingredients help prevent the dry, uncomfortable feel that can occur with some intensive brightening routines.

Shea Butter, Betaine, Hydrogenated Polydecene, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Dimethicone, Sodium Hyaluronate and selected botanical oils provide emollient and moisture-supporting care. This gives the product a more nourishing character than a lightweight brightening serum.

The tube and outer box identify the product as a brightening functional cosmetic. They do not identify it as a dual-functional brightening and wrinkle-improvement cosmetic, so its official functional status should be described specifically as brightening.

Understanding the Melanonx Cream 2.0 Version

Melanonx Cream 2.0 is an updated version of MEDI-PEEL’s dark-spot cream. Its front packaging specifically highlights:

  • Tranexamic Acid
  • Ascorbic Acid
  • Niacinamide
  • Dark spot and blemish care

The percentages of Niacinamide, Tranexamic Acid, Ascorbic Acid and Alpha-Arbutin are not stated on the supplied packaging. These ingredients should therefore be discussed by their cosmetic functions without assigning an unverified concentration.

A prominent “81” is printed on the front of the tube and box. The supplied packaging does not identify it as “81%” or explain it as the percentage of any ingredient. It should not be described as an 81% brightening complex, 81% active-ingredient concentration or clinical improvement percentage without additional brand documentation.

Key Benefits of MEDI-PEEL Melanonx Cream 2.0

  • Provides targeted cosmetic care for visible dark spots and uneven-looking tone
  • Helps improve the appearance of post-blemish pigmentation
  • Contains Niacinamide for functional brightening care
  • Features Tranexamic Acid as part of its tone-correcting formula
  • Contains Ascorbic Acid and Magnesium Ascorbyl Phosphate for antioxidant and brightening support
  • Includes Alpha-Arbutin for additional uneven-tone care
  • Helps dull skin appear clearer and more radiant
  • Provides moisturizing care through Shea Butter, Betaine and Sodium Hyaluronate
  • Contains emollients that help soften dry or rough-feeling skin
  • Includes botanical extracts and peptides for additional conditioning care
  • Can be applied to specific areas or spread thinly over the entire face
  • Can be incorporated into both morning and evening skincare routines

Selected Formula Highlights

Niacinamide

Niacinamide is the functional brightening ingredient in this formula. It helps improve the appearance of dullness, uneven-looking tone and visible discoloration while supporting the skin’s moisture barrier.

The product packaging specifically connects Niacinamide with its brightening function. However, the Niacinamide percentage is not disclosed and should not be estimated from its position in the ingredient list.

Tranexamic Acid

Topical Tranexamic Acid is included as part of the cream’s dark-spot and uneven-tone care system. It is commonly used in cosmetic formulas intended to make localized discoloration and post-blemish marks appear less noticeable over time.

The amount of Tranexamic Acid is not stated on the packaging. This topical cosmetic ingredient should not be compared directly with prescription, oral or injectable Tranexamic Acid.

Ascorbic Acid

Ascorbic Acid is a form of Vitamin C that provides antioxidant support and helps improve the appearance of dull, uneven-looking skin. It complements the formula’s other brightening ingredients.

Because the exact concentration and formula pH are not disclosed, the product should not be assigned the same potency or performance expectations as a high-percentage pure Vitamin C serum.

Magnesium Ascorbyl Phosphate

Magnesium Ascorbyl Phosphate is a Vitamin C derivative included alongside Ascorbic Acid. It provides additional antioxidant and brightening support within the complete cream formula.

Alpha-Arbutin

Alpha-Arbutin supports cosmetic care for visible pigmentation and uneven-looking tone. It is used as part of the multi-ingredient brightening system rather than as a separately disclosed high-percentage treatment.

Shea Butter

Shea Butter appears near the beginning of the ingredient list and contributes to the cream’s moisturizing, softening and nourishing skin feel. It can help reduce dryness and support a smoother-looking surface.

Because Shea Butter and several other emollients are prominent in the formula, users with very oily or clog-prone skin may prefer a thin application rather than a heavy layer.

Betaine and Sodium Hyaluronate

Betaine and Sodium Hyaluronate provide humectant care by helping the skin attract and retain moisture. They balance the formula’s brightening focus with hydration support.

Dimethicone and Emollient Ingredients

Dimethicone, Hydrogenated Polydecene and Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride help improve spreadability, soften rough-feeling skin and reduce moisture loss. They also contribute to the cream’s smooth and protective finish.

Botanical Extracts

The formula contains several plant-derived extracts, including Centella Asiatica, Mulberry Bark, Witch Hazel, Licorice, Pomegranate, Fig, Sophora and other botanical components. These provide supplementary antioxidant, soothing and skin-conditioning care.

People with known botanical sensitivities should still patch-test because the presence of soothing extracts does not guarantee that every skin type will experience zero irritation.

Peptide Complex

Selected peptides—including Copper Tripeptide-1 and several acetylated or palmitoylated peptides—provide additional skin-conditioning and smoother-looking care. No individual peptide percentage is disclosed.

Adenosine

Adenosine appears in the formula and can support smoother-looking skin. Fragrance Component

How Does It Care for Dark Spots and Blemish Marks?

Visible dark spots may develop for different reasons, including sun exposure, post-inflammatory pigmentation, hormonal factors and the natural ageing process. This cream may be useful for the appearance of flat brown or grey post-blemish marks. It cannot fill indented acne scars, remove raised scars or treat active acne. A pitted or textural scar is structurally different from surface pigmentation.

Persistent, rapidly changing or unusual pigmentation should be assessed by a qualified dermatologist. The product should not replace professional diagnosis or prescribed treatment for melasma or other pigmentary disorders.

Although the product is packaged in a treatment-style tube, the formula is a moisturizing facial cream rather than a medicinal ointment. Shea Butter, emollients and silicones give it a nourishing, smoothly spreading texture.

  • Best application: Final skincare step

Normal and dry skin may appreciate the nourishing finish. Combination or oily skin can apply it only to visible dark spots or use a very thin layer over the face. Applying too much may feel heavy, particularly in hot and humid weather.

MEDI-PEEL Melanonx Cream 2.0 may be considered for:

  • Combination skin requiring localized dark-spot care

How to Use MEDI-PEEL Melanonx Cream 2.0

  1. Cleanse the face and complete toner, essence and serum steps.

  3. Apply it directly to visible dark spots and post-blemish marks, or spread a thin layer over the entire face.

When introducing the product, begin once daily or on alternate days. Increase to morning and evening use only when the skin remains comfortable.

Avoid combining several new high-strength brightening or exfoliating products in the same routine from the first day. Introduce products gradually so that any source of irritation can be identified more easily.

Recommended Skincare Routine

Morning Routine

Gentle Cleanser → Hydrating Toner → Serum → MEDI-PEEL Melanonx Cream 2.0 → Broad-Spectrum Sunscreen

Sunscreen is particularly important because continued ultraviolet exposure can make dark spots more visible and reduce the apparent benefit of a brightening routine.

products.description:
APLB PDRN Vitamin C Ampoule Serum 40 ml is a lightweight Korean facial ampoule serum developed to provide intensive hydration, soothing care and support for smoother, brighter and healthier-looking skin. Its formula is built around 49.1% Centella Asiatica Leaf Water and combines it with PDRN, Vitamin C, Panthenol, Allantoin, Sodium Hyaluronate, Squalane, Beta-Glucan and multiple botanical ingredients.

The front packaging highlights PDRN VITA CEN™ 49.1%. This should not be interpreted as 49.1% pure PDRN. According to the brand specification, the highlighted system contains Centella Asiatica Leaf Water 49.1%, PDRN at 1,000 ppt and Vitamin C at 3,000 ppb. In the complete ingredient declaration, PDRN appears as Sodium DNA, while Vitamin C appears as Ascorbic Acid.

The serum also contains APLB’s Centella 3X Complex™, consisting of Asiaticoside, Madecassic Acid and Asiatic Acid. These Centella-derived ingredients complement the high Centella Leaf Water content and provide additional soothing and skin-conditioning support.

For hydration and skin comfort, the formula combines Butylene Glycol, Propanediol, Glycerin, Panthenol, Allantoin, Sodium Hyaluronate, Squalane and Beta-Glucan. This multi-humectant and emollient system helps maintain moisture, soften dry-feeling skin and support a smoother skin surface without relying on a heavy cream texture.

The current ingredient declaration does not list added Fragrance or Parfum, and the serum is formulated primarily as a hydrating, soothing and radiance-supporting treatment. Its PDRN and Vitamin C levels are relatively small compared with the 49.1% Centella Leaf Water base, so the product is best understood as a Centella-rich moisturizing ampoule with supporting PDRN and Vitamin C rather than a high-concentration PDRN or Vitamin C treatment.
