APLB PDRN Vitamin C Ampoule Serum Overview

APLB PDRN Vitamin C Ampoule Serum is a 40 ml Korean facial serum formulated to combine soothing Centella care with lightweight hydration, antioxidant support and skin-conditioning ingredients.

The serum may be particularly useful when the main skincare concerns include:

  • Dehydrated or moisture-deficient skin
  • Dull-looking complexion
  • Rough or uneven-looking texture
  • Skin that feels temporarily stressed or uncomfortable
  • Loss of softness and suppleness
  • Skin needing lightweight daily hydration
  • Skin lacking a healthy-looking glow

The formula begins with Centella Asiatica Leaf Water, followed by Water, Butylene Glycol and Propanediol. This confirms that the product is fundamentally a water-based hydrating ampoule rather than an oil-heavy or high-strength active serum.

Its ingredient profile combines humectants, soothing ingredients, emollients, Centella-derived components and several botanical extracts to support hydrated, comfortable and smoother-looking skin.

What Does PDRN VITA CEN™ 49.1% Mean?

The packaging prominently displays PDRN VITA CEN™ 49.1%.

This does not mean that the serum contains 49.1% PDRN.

The brand specification identifies the highlighted system as:

  • Centella Asiatica Leaf Water – 49.1%
  • PDRN / Sodium DNA – 1,000 ppt
  • Vitamin C / Ascorbic Acid – 3,000 ppb

The 49.1% figure therefore primarily refers to the concentration of Centella Asiatica Leaf Water.

PDRN is present at 1,000 ppt, equivalent to approximately 1 ppb. Vitamin C is present at 3,000 ppb, equivalent to approximately 3 ppm.

This distinction is important when comparing the product with dedicated high-concentration PDRN or Vitamin C serums. APLB PDRN Vitamin C Ampoule Serum is better positioned as a Centella-rich moisturizing and soothing ampoule with supporting PDRN and Vitamin C.

Key Benefits

  • Provides lightweight everyday hydration
  • Helps soothe dry and stressed-feeling skin
  • Contains 49.1% Centella Asiatica Leaf Water
  • Contains PDRN in the form of Sodium DNA
  • Contains Ascorbic Acid / Vitamin C
  • Helps support brighter and more radiant-looking skin
  • Helps improve the appearance of dullness
  • Supports a softer and smoother skin feel
  • Contains Panthenol for moisturizing and soothing care
  • Contains Allantoin for skin-conditioning support
  • Contains Sodium Hyaluronate for hydration
  • Contains Squalane for additional emollient care
  • Contains Beta-Glucan
  • Contains Centella 3X Complex™
  • Contains Asiaticoside
  • Contains Madecassic Acid
  • Contains Asiatic Acid
  • Contains Dipotassium Glycyrrhizate
  • Contains Tea Tree Leaf Extract
  • Contains Sea Buckthorn Fruit Extract
  • Contains Hydrolyzed Collagen
  • Contains a patented botanical ingredient complex
  • No added Fragrance / Parfum is listed in the current ingredient declaration
  • Lightweight serum texture suitable for layering
  • Made in South Korea

49.1% Centella Asiatica Leaf Water

Centella Asiatica Leaf Water is the first ingredient and is specified at 49.1%.

Centella Asiatica is widely used in Korean skincare as a botanical skin-conditioning ingredient, especially in formulas designed for hydration and soothing care.

Its role in this serum is primarily to help support:

  • Skin comfort
  • Hydrated-looking skin
  • A calmer-looking complexion
  • Improved softness
  • Healthier-looking skin condition

The serum also contains three additional Centella-derived components — Asiaticoside, Madecassic Acid and Asiatic Acid — giving the formula a broader Centella-focused profile beyond the 49.1% Leaf Water alone.

PDRN / Sodium DNA

The product is marketed as a PDRN-containing ampoule, and the current ingredient declaration lists Sodium DNA as the corresponding PDRN ingredient.

APLB specifies the amount as 1,000 ppt.

This is a very small concentration compared with the 49.1% Centella Asiatica Leaf Water base. The product should therefore not be represented as containing 49.1% PDRN or as a high-concentration PDRN treatment.

Within this cosmetic formula, Sodium DNA functions as a supporting skin-conditioning ingredient alongside Centella, Vitamin C and the moisturizing system.

The packaging does not state a biological source for the Sodium DNA, so customers looking specifically for salmon-derived PDRN should note that this product does not make that claim.

Vitamin C

The formula contains Ascorbic Acid, the conventional form of Vitamin C.

APLB specifies Vitamin C at 3,000 ppb, equivalent to approximately 3 ppm.

At this concentration, Vitamin C works primarily as a supporting antioxidant and radiance-care ingredient rather than as a high-strength Vitamin C treatment.

It complements the formula’s overall brightening and glowing-skin positioning and may help support a fresher and more radiant-looking complexion when used consistently within a complete skincare routine.

Because the concentration is comparatively low, customers seeking intensive Vitamin C treatment should not compare this formula directly with dedicated 10%, 15% or 20% Vitamin C serums.

Centella 3X Complex™

APLB combines the Centella Leaf Water base with its Centella 3X Complex™, consisting of:

  1. Asiaticoside
  2. Madecassic Acid
  3. Asiatic Acid

These compounds are naturally associated with Centella Asiatica and are included as supporting skin-conditioning ingredients.

Together with 49.1% Centella Asiatica Leaf Water, they reinforce the serum’s soothing and skin-comfort-focused formulation.

Hydrating & Soothing Ingredients

Butylene Glycol

Butylene Glycol appears near the beginning of the ingredient list and functions primarily as a humectant and solvent, helping the formula maintain moisture and spread smoothly over the skin.

Propanediol

Propanediol provides additional humectant support and contributes to the serum’s lightweight slip.

Glycerin

Glycerin helps attract and retain moisture in the outer layer of the skin, supporting a softer and less tight-feeling complexion.

Panthenol

Panthenol, also known as Provitamin B5, provides moisturizing and skin-soothing support and can help improve overall skin comfort.

Allantoin

Allantoin is a well-established cosmetic soothing and conditioning ingredient that complements Centella and Panthenol.

Dipotassium Glycyrrhizate

Dipotassium Glycyrrhizate is a licorice-derived ingredient commonly used in soothing skincare formulations.

Sodium Hyaluronate

Sodium Hyaluronate is a form of Hyaluronic Acid that functions as a humectant and helps support hydrated and plump-looking skin.

Squalane

Squalane provides lightweight emollient conditioning, helping reduce roughness and improve skin softness without making the water-based formula excessively heavy.

Beta-Glucan

Beta-Glucan provides additional moisturizing and soothing skin-conditioning support.

Patented Botanical Complex

APLB highlights a patented ingredient combination registered under Patent Registration Number 10-1332214.

The highlighted botanical components include:

  • Nelumbium Speciosum Flower Extract
  • Artemisia Annua Extract
  • Oryza Sativa (Rice) Extract
  • Saccharomyces Ferment

These ingredients provide additional botanical conditioning and complement the serum’s hydrating and soothing formulation.

The patent reference applies to the highlighted ingredient complex and should not be interpreted as meaning that the entire serum or its cosmetic benefits are patented.

Selected Ingredient Highlights

Centella Asiatica Leaf Water

Present at 49.1% and forms the main botanical base of the serum.

Sodium DNA

The ingredient corresponding to the product’s PDRN positioning. APLB specifies it at 1,000 ppt.

Pure Vitamin C included at 3,000 ppb for supporting antioxidant and radiance care.

Helps support skin comfort and conditioning.

Provides humectant hydration and helps maintain a smoother, hydrated-looking skin surface.

Tea Tree Leaf Extract

Melaleuca Alternifolia (Tea Tree) Leaf Extract provides supporting botanical skin-conditioning care.

Sea Buckthorn Fruit Extract

Hippophae Rhamnoides Fruit Extract provides additional botanical and antioxidant-supporting care.

Hydrolyzed Collagen

Hydrolyzed Collagen works mainly as a moisturizing and film-forming cosmetic ingredient.

Topically applied Hydrolyzed Collagen should not be described as permanently rebuilding the skin’s natural structural collagen.

Beta-Glucan

Supports moisturization and skin comfort.

Inulin, Fructose & Glucose

These sugar-derived ingredients contribute additional humectant and skin-conditioning support within the formula.

Current Ingredient List

The current packaging declares the following ingredients:

Centella Asiatica Leaf Water (49.1%), Aqua (Water), Butylene Glycol, Propanediol, 1,2-Hexanediol, Glycerin, Diethoxyethyl Succinate, Panthenol, Hydroxyacetophenone, Sodium Polyacryloyldimethyl Taurate, Allantoin, Cellulose Gum, Disodium EDTA, Citric Acid, Dipotassium Glycyrrhizate, Xanthan Gum, Inulin, Glyceryl Acrylate/Acrylic Acid Copolymer, Cellulose, Fructose, Glucose, Ascorbic Acid (3,000 ppb), Dipropylene Glycol, Squalane, C12-14 Alketh-12, Asiaticoside, Madecassic Acid, Asiatic Acid, Sodium Hyaluronate, Melaleuca Alternifolia (Tea Tree) Leaf Extract, Hippophae Rhamnoides Fruit Extract, Hydrolyzed Collagen, Beta-Glucan, Caprylyl Glycol, Nelumbium Speciosum Flower Extract, Artemisia Annua Extract, Oryza Sativa (Rice) Extract, Saccharomyces Ferment, Solanum Melongena (Eggplant) Fruit Extract and Sodium DNA (1,000 ppt).

Cosmetic formulations can be updated over time. Customers with specific allergies or sensitivities should always compare the ingredient list on their exact product before use.

Texture & Finish

APLB PDRN Vitamin C Ampoule Serum has a lightweight, water-based serum texture designed for easy layering within both morning and evening skincare routines.

The combination of humectants and lightweight conditioning ingredients helps the serum spread smoothly without requiring a heavy oily base.

After application, the formula is designed to leave the skin feeling:

  • Hydrated
  • Soft
  • Smoother
  • Comfortable
  • Fresh
  • Supple

Individual finish may vary depending on the amount used, skin type, climate and the other products layered in the routine.

Suitable Skin Types

APLB PDRN Vitamin C Ampoule Serum may be suitable for:

  • Normal skin
  • Dry skin
  • Combination skin
  • Oily skin needing lightweight hydration
  • Dehydrated skin
  • Dull-looking skin
  • Rough or uneven-looking skin texture
  • Skin needing soothing support
  • Skin lacking softness and radiance

Sensitive or highly reactive skin should still patch test the product before regular use, even when a formula contains soothing ingredients.

  2. Apply toner if it is part of your skincare routine.

  4. Apply evenly over the face.

Cleanser → Toner → APLB PDRN Vitamin C Ampoule Serum → Moisturizer → Sunscreen

Evening Routine

products.description:
SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Air-Fit Suncream Light SPF30 PA++++ 50 ml is a lightweight Korean mineral sunscreen formulated with Zinc Oxide to provide daily protection against UVA and UVB exposure. Its comfortable cream formula combines Madagascar Centella Asiatica, Niacinamide, Adenosine and soothing botanical ingredients to support protected, calm and healthy-looking skin.

The product is registered in Korea as a functional cosmetic for UV protection, brightening and wrinkle improvement. Niacinamide supports a brighter and more even-looking complexion, while Adenosine provides functional care for the visible appearance of fine lines.

It is designed for convenient daily application and comes in a squeeze tube with a precision nozzle, allowing the sunscreen to be dispensed in a controlled and hygienic manner.

Table of Contents

  • Understanding SPF30 PA++++

Product Overview

SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Air-Fit Suncream Light is a physical or mineral sunscreen that uses Zinc Oxide to help protect exposed skin from UVA and UVB radiation. Its light cream texture is designed to spread smoothly and form a comfortable protective layer over the skin.

The formula combines daily sun protection with soothing, brightening and wrinkle-care ingredients. Madagascar Centella Asiatica and its characteristic components provide skin-conditioning support, while Niacinamide and Adenosine contribute to the product’s Korean functional-cosmetic claims.

SKIN1004 describes it as a mild daily physical sunscreen with a fresh and moisturizing finish. It is a practical option for users who prefer a mineral sunscreen for daily face, neck and body application.

The formula has also completed a skin-irritation test, making it a considerate option for sensitive skin when individually compatible.

Understanding SPF30 PA++++

SPF30

SPF primarily represents protection against UVB radiation, which is strongly associated with sunburn. SPF30 provides effective protection for daily activities when a sufficient amount is applied evenly and reapplied during continued sun exposure.

The practical level of protection depends on the application amount and how well the sunscreen layer is maintained throughout the day. Using too little product can reduce the protection achieved on the skin.

PA++++

PA++++ indicates a high level of UVA protection under the PA rating system. UVA radiation can contribute to tanning, uneven-looking pigmentation and premature visible signs of skin ageing.

Consistent UVA protection is particularly important for anyone maintaining a brightening, pigmentation-care or anti-ageing skincare routine.

Key Benefits

  • Provides daily SPF30 PA++++ sun protection.
  • Uses Zinc Oxide as its physical or mineral UV filter.
  • Helps protect exposed skin from UVA and UVB radiation.
  • Contains Madagascar Centella Asiatica Extract for soothing and conditioning care.
  • Contains Niacinamide for functional brightening care.
  • Contains Adenosine for functional wrinkle-improvement care.
  • Includes Madecassic Acid, Asiaticoside and Asiatic Acid.
  • Contains Portulaca Oleracea and Houttuynia Cordata extracts.
  • Supports a fresher, calmer and more even-looking complexion.
  • Has completed a skin-irritation test.
  • No added Fragrance or Parfum is listed in the formula.
  • Can be applied to the face, neck, arms and legs.
  • Comes in a convenient squeeze tube with a precision nozzle.

Selected Formula Highlights

Zinc Oxide

Zinc Oxide is a mineral UV filter that provides broad-spectrum protection across UVA and UVB wavelengths. It forms an even protective layer over the skin and makes this product a physical or mineral sunscreen.

Mineral sunscreens are often preferred by users who find some organic UV filters uncomfortable. Individual experience can still vary according to skin condition, skincare layering and application amount.

Madagascar Centella Asiatica Extract

Centella Asiatica Extract provides soothing and skin-conditioning care. It helps support a calmer and more comfortable complexion while complementing the sunscreen’s daily protective function.

The Centella used by SKIN1004 is sourced from Madagascar, where the brand sources the signature botanical ingredient featured throughout its Madagascar Centella skincare line.

Madecassic Acid, Asiaticoside and Asiatic Acid

Madecassic Acid, Asiaticoside and Asiatic Acid are characteristic Centella-related components included to provide additional soothing and conditioning support.

These ingredients complement Centella Asiatica Extract and help maintain a healthy-looking complexion during daily environmental exposure.

Niacinamide

Niacinamide is the functional brightening ingredient in the formula. It helps improve the appearance of dullness and uneven-looking tone while supporting the skin’s natural moisture barrier.

The Niacinamide percentage is not disclosed by the brand.

Adenosine

Adenosine is the functional wrinkle-care ingredient. It helps support smoother-looking skin and improves the visible appearance of fine lines with consistent cosmetic use.

Portulaca Oleracea Extract

Portulaca Oleracea Extract provides supplementary soothing and skin-conditioning care. It is commonly included in formulas designed for skin affected by dryness or environmental stress.

Houttuynia Cordata Extract

Houttuynia Cordata Extract provides additional soothing and antioxidant conditioning support. It complements Centella and Portulaca within the formula’s calming botanical blend.

Tocopherol

Tocopherol provides antioxidant support and helps protect the cosmetic formula from oxidative deterioration. It also contributes to the product’s overall skin-conditioning profile.

Biosaccharide Gum-1

Biosaccharide Gum-1 is a moisturizing and conditioning ingredient that helps maintain a smooth and comfortable skin feel.

Texture and Finish

The sunscreen has a lightweight cream texture designed to spread evenly without the dense feeling sometimes associated with traditional mineral sunscreens. The brand positions it as a fresh and moisturizing daily sunscreen.

Its emollient ingredients help the formula glide across the skin and create a smoother finish. It can be layered over lightweight moisturizer and worn under makeup after allowing the sunscreen to settle.

Because Zinc Oxide is the mineral UV filter, the visible finish can vary depending on skin tone and the amount applied. Applying the sunscreen in two thin, even layers can help achieve smoother and more consistent coverage.

No added Fragrance or Parfum is listed, making it suitable for users who prefer skincare without added perfume. The formula does contain t-Butyl Alcohol near the end of the ingredient list, but Ethanol and Alcohol Denat. are not listed.

Suitable Skin Types

SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Air-Fit Suncream Light may be considered for:

  • Normal skin
  • Combination skin
  • Oily skin that prefers a mineral sunscreen
  • Sensitive skin when individually compatible
  • Skin that prefers no-added-fragrance formulas
  • Dull or uneven-looking skin
  • Skin maintaining a pigmentation-care routine
  • Skin showing early visible signs of ageing

For Dry or Dehydrated Skin

Apply a suitable moisturizer before sunscreen to create a smoother base and maintain comfort throughout the day. Allow the moisturizer to settle before applying the sunscreen.

For Combination or Oily Skin

Use lightweight skincare underneath and avoid applying excessive layers before sunscreen. Allowing each product to absorb can help reduce heaviness and pilling.

For Sensitive Skin

The product has completed a skin-irritation test and contains several soothing ingredients. Sensitive skin should still introduce any new sunscreen gradually according to individual compatibility.

How to Use

  1. Complete your morning skincare routine with toner, serum and moisturizer as required.
  2. Allow the previous skincare layers to settle.
  3. Remove the protective outer cap.
  4. Dispense the sunscreen through the precision nozzle.
  5. Apply a sufficient amount evenly over the face and neck.
  6. Blend carefully around the hairline, eyebrows, ears and jawline.
  7. Apply to other exposed areas such as the arms and legs when required.
  8. Allow the sunscreen to settle before applying makeup.

For the face and neck, approximately two finger-lengths of sunscreen is a commonly used practical application guide. The exact amount may vary according to face size and the area being covered.

Apply sunscreen before going outdoors so that the protective layer is already even and settled when the skin is exposed to sunlight.

When to Reapply

Reapply sunscreen approximately every two hours during continued outdoor sun exposure. Reapplication is especially important after:

  • Heavy sweating
  • Swimming or contact with water
  • Wiping the face
  • Using a towel
  • Rubbing or touching the skin repeatedly
  • Spending an extended period outdoors

When applying sunscreen over makeup, use a suitable reapplication method that provides even coverage without excessively disturbing the existing sunscreen layer.

Suggested Morning Routine

  1. Cleanser: Use a gentle facial cleanser appropriate for your skin type.
  2. Toner: Apply a hydrating or soothing toner if required.
  3. Serum: Apply a treatment serum according to your primary skin concern.
  4. Moisturizer: Use a suitable moisturizer, particularly if your skin is dry or dehydrated.
  5. Sunscreen: Apply SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Air-Fit Suncream Light evenly as the final skincare step.
  6. Makeup: Apply makeup after the sunscreen has settled.

At night, remove sunscreen thoroughly with an appropriate cleanser. If makeup, heavy sunscreen application or repeated reapplication is present, use a cleansing oil or balm followed by a water-based cleanser.

Squalane

Beta-Glucan

Rice Extract and Saccharomyces Ferment

Tea Tree Leaf Extract

These botanical components provide supporting antioxidant and skin-conditioning care. Individual tolerance can vary, particularly in highly reactive skin.

Hydration and Skin Barrier Support

A healthy moisture barrier helps reduce excessive water loss and keeps skin feeling comfortable.

APLB Hyaluronic Acid Ceramide HA B5 Facial Cream uses several complementary types of moisturizing ingredients:

Product Overview

Anua Airy Sun Cream SPF50+ PA++++ is a Korean mineral sunscreen formulated for everyday UV protection with a lightweight, non-sticky finish.

The sunscreen uses Zinc Oxide, declared second in the ingredient list, as its UV-filtering ingredient. The Korean name 무기자차 선크림 identifies it specifically as an inorganic, or mineral, sunscreen.

Alongside sun protection, the formula contains the botanical extracts associated with Anua’s soothing skincare approach — Heartleaf, Cica, Artemisia and Tea Tree — and Sodium Hyaluronate for lightweight moisture support as the final step of a daytime routine.

Korean Functional Cosmetic Status

This sunscreen is a registered Korean 기능성화장품 (functional cosmetic). The box carries the declaration | 자외선차단 기능성 화장품 | directly under the product name — a functional cosmetic for UV protection.

Its officially stated efficacy is simple and specific: to protect the skin from ultraviolet rays, at SPF50+ PA++++. UV protection is one of Korea’s three core functional cosmetic categories, alongside brightening and wrinkle improvement.

Key Benefits

  • Registered Korean functional cosmetic for UV protection.
  • Provides SPF50+ PA++++ sun protection.
  • Helps protect skin from both UVA and UVB exposure.
  • Uses Zinc Oxide, second in the formula, as the mineral UV filter.
  • Inorganic (mineral) sunscreen formula.
  • Non-sticky, soft matte finish.
  • Centella Asiatica provides soothing skin-conditioning care.

  • Artemisia Capillaris Extract provides soothing and antioxidant support.
  • Tea Tree Extract provides additional botanical conditioning care.
  • Sodium Hyaluronate helps maintain skin hydration.
  • Tocopherol provides antioxidant skin-conditioning support.
  • No Fragrance or Parfum in the ingredient list.

SPF50+ PA++++ UV Protection

SPF50+ indicates a high level of protection against UVB rays, which are strongly associated with sunburn and contribute to cumulative sun damage.

PA++++ is the highest grade on Korea’s UVA protection scale. UVA rays penetrate more deeply into the skin and contribute to premature signs of photoaging and uneven-looking skin tone.

Using sunscreen consistently during the daytime helps reduce unnecessary UV exposure and supports skincare routines focused on maintaining an even, healthy-looking complexion.

No sunscreen can block 100% of ultraviolet radiation, so adequate application and regular reapplication remain important during prolonged outdoor exposure.

Zinc Oxide Mineral Protection

Zinc Oxide is the UV filter in this formula and is declared second, immediately after water. This makes Anua Airy Sun Cream a mineral, or physical, sunscreen.

Zinc Oxide provides broad-spectrum protection, helping shield the skin from both UVA and UVB radiation with a single filter.

It is combined with lightweight silicones, emollients and powder-type texture ingredients that improve spreadability and help avoid the heavy, chalky feel of traditional mineral sunscreens.

Butyloctyl Salicylate

Butyloctyl Salicylate functions here as an emollient and formulation-supporting ingredient, improving spreadability and the sensory feel of the sunscreen. It is not acting as a UV filter in this formula.

Cyclohexasiloxane

Cyclohexasiloxane, declared third, is a lightweight silicone that helps the sunscreen glide smoothly over the skin and contributes to its light finish.

Isododecane

Isododecane is a lightweight volatile ingredient commonly used to improve spreadability and support a smoother, less greasy skin feel.

Cica, Heartleaf, Artemisia & Tea Tree

The box names Heartleaf, Cica and Zinc Oxide as the product’s three defining ingredients. The four botanical extracts below are declared together in positions thirteen to sixteen of the formula.

Centella Asiatica Extract

Centella Asiatica Extract, commonly known as Cica, provides soothing and skin-conditioning support. It is particularly relevant in a daily sunscreen, because skin exposed to heat and outdoor conditions benefits from additional calming ingredients.

Houttuynia Cordata Extract

Houttuynia Cordata Extract, commonly known as Heartleaf, is Anua’s signature botanical ingredient and provides soothing and antioxidant-supporting care.

Artemisia Capillaris Extract

Artemisia Capillaris Extract provides botanical soothing, antioxidant and skin-conditioning support.

Melaleuca Alternifolia Extract

Melaleuca Alternifolia (Tea Tree) Extract provides additional refreshing and skin-conditioning care, completing the formula’s botanical soothing profile.

Hydration & Antioxidant Care

Sodium Hyaluronate

Sodium Hyaluronate, a salt form of Hyaluronic Acid, helps attract and retain moisture at the skin surface. Its inclusion helps balance the mineral formula with lightweight hydration, which matters when sunscreen is worn for long stretches of the day.

Propanediol, Butylene Glycol & Pentylene Glycol

These three humectants help maintain hydration and contribute to the sunscreen’s smooth, comfortable texture.

Tocopherol

Tocopherol, a form of Vitamin E, provides antioxidant and skin-conditioning support.

Formula & Finish

The box describes this as a daily sunscreen with an inorganic UV filter that finishes without stickiness, leaving a soft matte feel on the skin.

The formula contains texture-supporting ingredients such as Methyl Methacrylate Crosspolymer and Polymethylsilsesquioxane, both spherical powders that help create a smoother, more refined skin feel and contribute to the matte finish.

Silicone-based ingredients including Cyclohexasiloxane, Caprylyl Methicone and Phenyl Trimethicone further support smooth application and help prevent the mineral formula from feeling dense or chalky.

The resulting texture is designed for comfortable everyday wear and easy layering as the final step of a morning skincare routine.

The ingredient list contains no Fragrance or Parfum.

Selected Ingredient Highlights

Zinc Oxide

Declared second in the formula, it provides mineral broad-spectrum UVA and UVB protection.

Centella Asiatica Extract

Provides soothing and skin-conditioning support.

Dicaprylyl Carbonate

Dicaprylyl Carbonate is a lightweight emollient that improves softness and spreadability without creating an excessively rich feel.

Glyceryl Caprylate

Glyceryl Caprylate provides emollient and skin-conditioning support while contributing to formula stability.

Dr.Althea Aqua Marine Deep Serum is a moisture-focused facial serum developed for skin that feels dehydrated, tight or less plump even when it does not appear visibly flaky.

The product is also positioned as a vegan face serum suitable for all skin types.

Niacinamide is the fourth ingredient on the label and is declared at 50,200 ppm, which is 5.02% of the formula. This is the ingredient that earns the Korean brightening designation, and it is present at the top of the approved 2–5% range.

Niacinamide is a multifunctional form of Vitamin B3. It helps with the appearance of dullness, dark spots and uneven tone, and it also supports normal skin barrier function. At 5% it is a meaningful, working concentration rather than a label-dressing amount.

One practical note: 5% Niacinamide is on the higher side, and a small number of people find concentrations at this level cause flushing or mild irritation at first. If you are new to Niacinamide, start every other day.

Glutathione — 200 ppm (0.02%)

Glutathione is an antioxidant included as part of the Triple Whitening concept, declared at 200 ppm. It sits twenty-second on the ingredient list.

That number deserves to be read honestly: 0.02% is a trace level, and it is roughly 251 times less than the Niacinamide in the same jar. Glutathione is genuinely present and declared, but it is a supporting ingredient here, not the one producing results.

PDRN / Sodium DNA — 100 ppm (0.01%)

Sodium DNA, which the packaging refers to as PDRN, is declared at 100 ppm and is the last ingredient on the list. At 0.01% it is roughly 502 times less than the Niacinamide.

PDRN has become a well-known name in Korean skincare, so it is worth being clear: its presence here is a declared trace amount. Judge this cream on the Niacinamide, which is where the formula actually invests.

Titanium Dioxide

Titanium Dioxide is the eighth ingredient and is the white pigment responsible for the immediate tone-up effect. It is coated with Aluminum Hydroxide and Triethoxycaprylylsilane, the standard treatment that helps pigment disperse evenly in a cream.

The presence of Titanium Dioxide does not mean the product provides tested UV protection. Because no SPF rating is specified, a separate sunscreen is still required during the daytime.

Baobab Seed Oil & Sunflower Seed Oil

Adansonia Digitata (Baobab) Seed Oil and Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil are the two plant oils in the formula. Both are lightweight emollients that help maintain softness and reduce a dry or rough skin feel without weighing the cream down.

Glycerin & Butylene Glycol

Butylene Glycol is the second ingredient and Glycerin the seventh. Both are humectants that attract and hold moisture, keeping the skin comfortable under the pigment layer.

Allantoin

Allantoin provides soothing and skin-conditioning support, a sensible inclusion alongside a 5% Niacinamide formula.

Dimethicone

Dimethicone is the third ingredient. It creates a smoother skin surface, improves spreadability and gives the cream its soft, silky finish — which is also what helps it sit well under makeup.

How the Tone-Up Effect Works

It helps to separate the two things this cream does, because they work on completely different timescales.

The immediate effect is optical. Titanium Dioxide is a white pigment sitting high in the formula. The moment you apply the cream, it puts a fine layer of white pigment on the skin surface, which visually lifts the tone and softens the look of unevenness. This washes off at the end of the day, exactly like makeup.

The longer-term effect is the Niacinamide. At 5.02%, used consistently over weeks, it works on the appearance of dark spots and uneven tone from within the skin’s own processes. This is the part the Korean brightening designation refers to.

A practical note on the white cast. Because the tone-up relies on white pigment, applying too much can leave a visible pale or greyish cast, and this shows up more on medium and deeper skin tones. Start with a small amount, blend it well, and build up only if you want more. Used thinly it reads as a healthy brightness; used heavily it reads as a mask.

Texture & Fragrance

Phytotree Triple Whitening Tone Up Cream has a smooth cream texture that spreads evenly and creates an immediate brightening effect on the skin.

Silicones including Dimethicone, Cyclopentasiloxane and Cyclohexasiloxane help the formula glide across the skin and give a soft, refined finish that works well underneath makeup.

It is not fragrance-free. The formula contains Orange Peel Oil along with Limonene, Linalool and Citral — the aroma components that naturally occur in citrus oil and must be declared separately. There is no synthetic Fragrance or Parfum in the list; the scent comes from the orange oil itself.

How to Use

Forest Vita C Tangerine Toning Sun Cream uses a combination of UV filters to help reduce the amount of UVA and UVB radiation reaching the skin. Consistent sunscreen use is important because ultraviolet exposure can affect the skin even when the weather appears cloudy.

Christian Dean 24K Gold & Snail Luxury Cream: A Radiant Revolution in Skincare

In the world of luxury skincare, few products strike the perfect balance between science and opulence. Christian Dean 24K Gold & Snail Luxury Cream does just that. Meticulously formulated with premium ingredients such as 24-karat gold and snail mucin, this advanced cream elevates your skincare ritual to new levels of nourishment, rejuvenation, and radiance.

At the heart of this luxurious formula lies the synergy between time-tested Korean skincare traditions and cutting-edge cosmetic science. Whether you’re combating fine lines, dullness, dehydration, or uneven texture, this cream addresses multiple signs of aging while leaving your skin silky, luminous, and deeply moisturized.

Key Ingredients and Their Benefits

24K Gold

Gold has been prized in beauty rituals for centuries, from Cleopatra’s nightly routines to modern luxury skincare. In Christian Dean’s formula, 24K gold serves both a functional and indulgent purpose. Known for its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, gold helps calm skin irritation, reduce redness, and protect against environmental stressors. It enhances circulation and supports the skin’s natural regeneration processes, promoting a youthful, radiant complexion.

Snail Mucin (20,000 ppm)

Snail mucin is one of the most celebrated ingredients in Korean skincare, and for good reason. It’s rich in glycoproteins, hyaluronic acid, and zinc, which collectively help to moisturize, repair, and strengthen the skin barrier. With an impressive concentration of 20,000 parts per million, Christian Dean’s cream uses snail filtrate to help fade acne scars, improve elasticity, soothe inflammation, and promote cell regeneration. It’s especially effective in reducing the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, giving your skin a firm and plump look.

Niacinamide (Vitamin B3)

Niacinamide is a versatile ingredient known for its ability to improve uneven skin tone, smooth out texture, and refine pores. In this cream, niacinamide enhances the skin-brightening effects, helping to diminish dark spots and pigmentation caused by sun damage or aging. It also reinforces the skin barrier, reduces redness, and controls excess oil production, making it ideal for all skin types—even sensitive or acne-prone skin.

Adenosine

Adenosine is a naturally occurring molecule that plays a key role in cellular energy. When applied topically, it has proven anti-aging benefits. It helps smooth out wrinkles and fine lines while improving skin firmness. In Christian Dean 24K Gold & Snail Luxury Cream, adenosine works synergistically with other ingredients to enhance collagen production and improve overall skin texture.

Marine Collagen

Derived from the ocean, marine collagen is renowned for its superior absorption compared to bovine or porcine collagen. It provides intense hydration and helps improve skin elasticity, contributing to a firmer and more youthful appearance. Marine collagen supports the skin’s structure and keeps it looking supple and resilient over time.

Designed to provide high-level sun protection while soothing and hydrating the skin, this sunscreen has become a favorite among skincare enthusiasts.

Key Ingredients and Their Benefits

  1. Centella Asiatica Extract (49%): Known for its healing properties, Centella Asiatica, or Cica, is a cornerstone in many K-beauty products. In this sunscreen, it plays a pivotal role in calming irritated skin and promoting the healing of minor skin damage.
  2. Niacinamide (2%): This form of Vitamin B3 is celebrated for its ability to brighten the complexion, reduce the appearance of pores, and strengthen the skin’s barrier. Incorporating niacinamide helps in evening out skin tone and enhancing overall skin health.
  3. Beta-Glucan (10,000 ppm): A potent humectant, Beta-Glucan draws moisture into the skin, providing deep hydration. It also aids in fortifying the skin’s natural barrier, making it more resilient against environmental stressors.
  4. Adenosine: This ingredient is known for its anti-aging benefits, helping to smooth fine lines and improve skin elasticity.
  5. Allantoin and Licorice Extract: Both are renowned for their soothing and anti-inflammatory properties, making them ideal for calming sensitive or irritated skin.

Texture and Application

The iUNIK Centella Calming Daily Sunscreen boasts a lightweight, lotion-like texture that absorbs quickly into the skin. Upon application, it leaves a dewy finish without any greasy residue. The formulation is designed to be non-comedogenic, ensuring it won’t clog pores. Additionally, it is fragrance-free, catering to those with sensitivities to added scents.

Performance and User Experience

Users have reported a generally positive experience with this sunscreen. Its high SPF rating of 50+ PA++++ offers robust protection against both UVA and UVB rays, which are responsible for premature aging and sunburn. The inclusion of Centella Asiatica and Beta-Glucan ensures that the skin remains hydrated and soothed throughout the day.

However, some users with oily or combination skin have noted that the sunscreen can leave a slightly greasy finish, particularly in humid conditions. This may be a consideration for those with such skin types. Additionally, a few individuals have reported mild irritation or stinging sensations, especially if the skin is already compromised or if the product comes into contact with the eyes.

Packaging

The sunscreen comes in a 60ml tube with a pointed nozzle, allowing for precise dispensing. The minimalist design reflects iUNIK’s commitment to simplicity and functionality.

Conclusion

The iUNIK Centella Calming Daily Sunscreen SPF 50+ PA++++ is a commendable choice for those seeking a sunscreen that not only protects against the sun’s harmful rays but also nourishes and soothes the skin. Its blend of effective sun filters and skin-beneficial ingredients makes it suitable for various skin types, particularly sensitive and dry skin. While it may not be ideal for individuals with oily skin in humid climates, its overall performance and formulation make it a valuable addition to any skincare routine.

  • Suitable for sensitive skin.

Medicube Kojic Acid Turmeric Resurfacing Toner 250 ml
products.description:
Medicube Kojic Acid Turmeric Resurfacing Toner 250 ml is a lightweight Korean exfoliating toner designed for both face and body care. It helps improve the appearance of dark spots, dullness, uneven skin tone, rough texture and dead skin buildup while supporting a smoother, clearer and more radiant-looking complexion.

The non-sticky formula combines Kojic Acid, Turmeric, Niacinamide and Glycolic Acid to provide brightening, soothing and resurfacing care. It can be used on the face as well as dark-looking or rough areas of the body, including the underarms, elbows and knees.

Why Choose Medicube Kojic Acid Turmeric Resurfacing Toner?

Dead skin buildup can make the complexion appear dull, rough and uneven. It may also prevent other skincare products from spreading evenly across the skin. Medicube Kojic Acid Turmeric Resurfacing Toner uses Glycolic Acid to exfoliate the surface gently while Kojic Acid and Niacinamide target the appearance of uneven tone and dark-looking areas.

Unlike a toner created only for the face, this multi-purpose formula is also suitable for targeted body care. Its hygienic nozzle allows controlled application to areas such as the underarms, elbows and knees without unnecessary mess.

Key Benefits of This Resurfacing Toner

  • Improves uneven-looking tone: Helps the complexion and targeted body areas appear clearer and more balanced.
  • Reduces the look of dark spots: Kojic Acid and Niacinamide support a brighter, more even-looking appearance.
  • Exfoliates dead skin cells: Glycolic Acid helps remove dull surface buildup and refine rough texture.
  • Smooths rough areas: Regular use helps areas such as the elbows and knees feel softer and look smoother.
  • Refreshes dull skin: Exfoliating and brightening care helps reveal a more radiant-looking complexion.
  • Supports soothing care: Turmeric complements the brightening formula with antioxidant and skin-conditioning benefits.
  • Works on face and body: Can be applied to several areas affected by uneven tone or roughness.
  • Feels lightweight: The watery, non-sticky texture fits comfortably into a regular skincare routine.

How Medicube Kojic Acid Turmeric Resurfacing Toner Works

Medicube Kojic Acid Turmeric Resurfacing Toner combines surface exfoliation with targeted tone care. Glycolic Acid loosens and removes dead skin cells that can contribute to rough texture and visible dullness. This helps the skin surface appear smoother and more refined.

Kojic Acid and Niacinamide work alongside exfoliation to improve the appearance of uneven tone, dark spots and shadowy-looking areas. Turmeric provides complementary antioxidant and conditioning care, helping the complexion look fresh and healthy.

This toner does not bleach the skin or permanently change its natural colour. It is designed to improve the appearance of excess pigmentation, dullness and uneven-looking areas through consistent cosmetic care.

Key Actives and Their Benefits

Kojic Acid

Kojic Acid is used in brightening skincare to help improve the appearance of dark spots and uneven tone. Consistent use can support a clearer and more balanced-looking complexion without changing the skin’s natural tone.

Turmeric

Turmeric provides antioxidant and skin-conditioning benefits. It complements the formula by supporting a calm, fresh and healthy-looking appearance while the exfoliating ingredients refine surface texture.

Niacinamide

Niacinamide helps improve uneven-looking tone, support the skin barrier and maintain a balanced complexion. It works with Kojic Acid to target dark-looking areas and visible dullness.

Glycolic Acid

Glycolic Acid is an alpha hydroxy acid that exfoliates dead skin cells from the surface. It helps reduce visible roughness and supports smoother, softer and more radiant-looking skin.

Face and Body Resurfacing Care

The versatile formula makes Medicube Kojic Acid Turmeric Resurfacing Toner suitable for several areas where texture and tone may look uneven.

  • Face: Helps improve dullness, uneven tone, dark spots and rough surface texture.
  • Underarms: Supports a smoother and more even-looking appearance.
  • Elbows: Helps refine thick, rough and dull-looking surface buildup.
  • Knees: Provides exfoliating care for visibly rough and uneven areas.
  • Other body areas: May be applied where texture or tone needs targeted cosmetic care.

Do not use the toner immediately after shaving, waxing or hair-removal treatments. Wait until the skin feels completely calm and comfortable before applying an exfoliating product.

Who Should Use This Toner?

Medicube Kojic Acid Turmeric Resurfacing Toner may be suitable for people concerned about:

  • Dark spots and post-blemish marks
  • Dull or tired-looking skin
  • Uneven-looking facial or body tone
  • Rough and bumpy surface texture
  • Dead skin cell buildup
  • Dark-looking underarms, elbows or knees
  • A lack of visible smoothness and radiance

Medicube lists the toner for combination, dry, oily and sensitive skin. However, it contains an exfoliating acid, so sensitive or inexperienced users should patch-test and introduce it gradually.

How to Use Medicube Kojic Acid Turmeric Resurfacing Toner on the Face

  1. Cleanse the face and gently pat the skin dry.
  2. Dispense an appropriate amount onto a cotton pad.
  3. Gently wipe it across the face without applying excessive pressure.
  4. Avoid the eye contour, lips and broken or irritated areas.
  5. Allow the toner to absorb before applying serum.
  6. Follow with a gentle moisturizer.
  7. During the daytime, finish with broad-spectrum sunscreen.

Do not rinse after application. If the skin is very sensitive, apply a small amount with the palms and gently pat instead of wiping with a cotton pad.

How to Use It on the Body

  1. Begin with clean and completely dry skin.
  2. Use the nozzle to dispense a controlled amount onto the target area.
  3. Spread a thin, even layer over the underarms, elbows, knees or another rough area.
  4. Allow the toner to absorb before applying body lotion.
  5. Wash your hands after application.

Avoid applying it immediately after shaving, waxing or using a body scrub. Do not use on broken, inflamed or actively irritated skin.

How Often Should It Be Used?

Beginners can introduce Medicube Kojic Acid Turmeric Resurfacing Toner two or three evenings per week. If the skin remains comfortable, the frequency may gradually be increased to every other day or according to individual tolerance.

Using more product or applying it too frequently will not produce faster results and may cause dryness or irritation. Reduce the frequency if the skin feels tight, sensitive or unusually dry.

Can It Be Used with Other Active Products?

Because the formula contains Glycolic Acid, avoid layering it in the same routine with another strong AHA, BHA or PHA exfoliant. Sensitive skin should also avoid combining it immediately with retinoids, strong direct Vitamin C or physical scrubs.

Use potentially irritating treatments on alternate nights. Simple hydrating serums, barrier-supporting moisturizers and sunscreen can help maintain comfort while using an exfoliating toner.

Why Sunscreen Is Important

Exfoliating acids can make the skin more vulnerable to the visible effects of sun exposure. Apply a broad-spectrum sunscreen every morning, including on exposed body areas treated with Medicube Kojic Acid Turmeric Resurfacing Toner.

Without consistent sun protection, dark spots and uneven-looking tone may become more noticeable, reducing the visible benefits of a brightening routine.

Texture and Finish

The toner has a lightweight and watery consistency that spreads easily and absorbs without leaving a heavy or sticky coating. This makes it convenient for layering with serum, moisturizer or body lotion.

The formula may produce mild tingling during initial use, particularly on areas with dryness or sensitivity. Strong burning, persistent redness, itching or swelling is a reason to rinse the product off and discontinue application.

Important Usage Tips

  • Patch-test before applying it to the face or a large body area.
  • Introduce the toner gradually instead of beginning with daily use.
  • Avoid the eyes, lips and other highly sensitive areas.
  • Do not use on broken or irritated skin.
  • Wait after shaving or waxing before applying the toner.
  • Avoid using several strong exfoliants in the same routine.
  • Apply moisturizer to support skin comfort.
  • Use broad-spectrum sunscreen every morning.
  • Store the bottle away from heat and direct sunlight.

About the 250 ml Size

The generous 250 ml bottle makes Medicube Kojic Acid Turmeric Resurfacing Toner practical for regular face and body care. Its targeted nozzle helps dispense the toner directly onto areas such as the underarms, elbows and knees.

Formula details can be updated by the manufacturer. Check the packaging received for the most current directions, precautions and product information.

Buy Medicube Kojic Acid Turmeric Resurfacing Toner in Bangladesh

Choose Medicube Kojic Acid Turmeric Resurfacing Toner 250 ml if you need multi-purpose exfoliating and brightening care for uneven-looking tone, dark spots, rough texture and dullness on the face or body. Its lightweight formula helps reveal smoother, clearer and more radiant-looking skin with consistent and careful use.

Explore more authentic Medicube products at KC Bazar or browse the Korean toner collection. For updated manufacturer information, visit the official Medicube product page.

Frequently Asked Questions

What does Medicube Kojic Acid Turmeric Resurfacing Toner do?

It gently exfoliates dead skin buildup and helps improve the appearance of dark spots, uneven tone, dullness and rough texture on the face and body.

Can it be used on the underarms?

Yes. It can be applied to the underarms to support a smoother and more even-looking appearance. Do not use it immediately after shaving or waxing.

Can it be used on elbows and knees?

Yes. The toner can help exfoliate rough surface buildup and improve the appearance of uneven tone on the elbows and knees.

Is it suitable for sensitive skin?

The manufacturer includes sensitive skin among the suitable skin types. However, the formula contains Glycolic Acid, so patch-testing and gradual introduction are recommended.

Can I use this toner every day?

Tolerance varies. Beginners should start two or three times per week and increase the frequency only if the skin remains comfortable.

Can it be used with retinol?

Avoid using this exfoliating toner and retinol in the same routine, particularly if the skin is sensitive. Apply them on alternate nights instead.

Should I wash it off?

No. This is a leave-on toner. Allow it to absorb, then follow with serum or moisturizer.

Is sunscreen necessary?

Yes. Apply broad-spectrum sunscreen every morning because exfoliation can increase the skin’s sensitivity to sun exposure.

For this reason, consistent sunscreen application is particularly important when addressing:

  • Dark spots
  • Uneven-looking skin tone

How to Use APLB Glutathione Niacinamide Sunscreen

When mixed with water, the formula creates a dense, creamy foam that spreads easily over the face. The cleansing system helps loosen oil and debris so they can be rinsed away, leaving the skin with a fresh and thoroughly cleansed feel.

The tube describes the product as providing “the powerful purifying and pore care of charcoal.”

The formula combines traditional fatty-acid-based cleansing ingredients with 0.1% Charcoal Powder and botanical extracts including Witch Hazel, Bamboo and Portulaca.

This cleanser should be viewed primarily as a cleansing and oil-removal product. Charcoal does not literally remove toxins from inside the skin, and the product is not a treatment for acne or permanently enlarged pores.

Several important ingredients in this system include:

  • Stearic Acid
  • Myristic Acid
  • Lauric Acid
  • Potassium Hydroxide
  • Cocamidopropyl Betaine

Fatty acids such as Stearic Acid, Myristic Acid and Lauric Acid react with Potassium Hydroxide during formulation to form cleansing salts that produce abundant foam and remove oil effectively.

Cocamidopropyl Betaine is an additional surfactant that supports cleansing and foam formation.

This type of formula can provide a very clean after-feel, which many oily and combination skin users prefer. However, people with dry, dehydrated or easily irritated skin may find high-foaming cleansers more cleansing than necessary if used too frequently.

Charcoal is an adsorbent material that can bind some oil and impurities on its surface. In a rinse-off facial cleanser, its role is mainly to complement the overall cleansing system and support the product’s oil-control and pore-cleansing positioning.

It is important to distinguish cosmetic cleansing from medical or biological “detoxification.” Charcoal in a face wash does not remove toxins from the bloodstream or pull impurities from deep inside the body.

Its practical benefit in this product is primarily related to helping remove surface oil and debris during cleansing.

Charcoal Powder

Glycerin

Why Choose Dabo Rice PDRN Niacinamide 15 Serum?

Visible dark spots, post-acne marks, enlarged-looking pores and excess shine can make the complexion appear uneven and unbalanced. Dabo Rice PDRN Niacinamide 15 Serum addresses several of these concerns in one daily skincare step.

Its high-strength Niacinamide formula helps improve visible clarity and promote a more even-looking tone. Rice-derived components provide nourishing moisture, while PDRN supports hydrated, smooth and revitalized-looking skin.

  • Refines visible pores: Supports a smoother-looking and more balanced skin texture.
  • Balances excess oil: Helps control unwanted shine without stripping essential moisture.
  • Provides hydration: Maintains a soft and comfortable skin feel without excessive heaviness.
  • Supports the skin barrier: Niacinamide helps maintain a stronger and healthier-looking complexion.

How Dabo Rice PDRN Niacinamide 15 Serum Works

Niacinamide is a multifunctional form of Vitamin B3 used for visible brightening, pore, sebum and barrier care. At a 15% concentration, it provides targeted care for stubborn dullness, uneven-looking tone and enlarged pores.

Dabo Rice PDRN Niacinamide 15 Serum also combines tone care with moisture support. This helps oily and combination skin maintain hydration while improving the appearance of unwanted shine and uneven texture.

15% Niacinamide for Tone and Pore Care

Niacinamide helps reduce the appearance of excess pigmentation within the skin’s surface. With regular and tolerable use, it can improve the visibility of post-blemish marks and help the complexion appear more even.

It also supports sebum balance. Better oil control can make enlarged-looking pores appear less noticeable, although a cosmetic serum cannot permanently change the natural size of pores.

Rice and PDRN Skin Care

Rice-derived skincare provides nourishing moisture and supports a soft, luminous-looking complexion. It complements the concentrated Niacinamide formula by helping the skin remain hydrated and comfortable.

PDRN is included as a cosmetic skincare component that supports smooth, revitalized and healthy-looking skin. It complements the serum’s brightening and hydration benefits but should not be considered a medical treatment.

Who Should Use Dabo Rice PDRN Niacinamide 15 Serum?

This serum may be suitable for people concerned about:

  • Dull or tired-looking skin
  • Uneven-looking skin tone
  • Post-acne or post-blemish marks
  • Enlarged-looking pores
  • Excess oil and unwanted shine
  • Rough or uneven-looking texture
  • Combination skin affected by dehydration

Because 15% Niacinamide is a relatively high concentration, sensitive skin and beginners should introduce the serum gradually. Patch-test before applying it to the entire face.

Texture and Finish

Dabo Rice PDRN Niacinamide 15 Serum has a lightweight texture that absorbs comfortably without creating an excessively oily finish. It layers easily underneath moisturizer and sunscreen, making it suitable for morning and evening routines.

Only a small amount is required during each application. Using more product will not necessarily provide faster results and may increase the possibility of irritation.

How to Use Dabo Rice PDRN Niacinamide 15 Serum

  1. Cleanse the face with a suitable facial cleanser.
  2. Apply toner and allow it to absorb.
  3. Dispense two or three drops of serum.
  4. Spread it gently across the face and neck.
  5. Avoid direct contact with the eyes and broken skin.
  6. Pat lightly until comfortably absorbed.
  7. Follow with a suitable moisturizer.
  8. During the daytime, finish with broad-spectrum sunscreen.

Beginners can start by using the serum two or three times per week. Gradually increase the frequency when the skin remains comfortable. Discontinue use if persistent redness, itching or irritation develops.

The serum can generally be paired with Hyaluronic Acid, Centella, Ceramides, Panthenol and other hydrating products. These combinations can help maintain moisture and skin comfort.

When introducing Dabo Rice PDRN Niacinamide 15 Serum, avoid adding several other concentrated active products simultaneously. Sensitive skin may prefer alternating it with strong exfoliating acids, retinoids or high-strength Vitamin C products.

Dabo T-Tree Cica Relief Moisturizer is a lightweight Korean facial moisturizer developed to provide hydration, soothing care and moisture-balance support for skin that feels stressed or uncomfortable. In Korea it is registered as a 미백 기능성 화장품 — a functional cosmetic for brightening — and the packaging also states that skin irritation testing has been completed.

The formula is built around Australian Tea Tree Leaf Extract at 8,280 ppm (0.828%), which sits twelfth on the ingredient list and is a genuinely meaningful level for a botanical of this kind. Niacinamide is the fourth ingredient and is the active behind the Korean brightening designation.

Humectants including Butylene Glycol, Trehalose, Glycereth-26, Glycerin and Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid maintain hydration without needing a rich, heavy texture, while Beta-Glucan, Ceramide NP and Hydrogenated Lecithin add barrier and skin-conditioning support.

The “Cica” in the name refers to Centella Asiatica Extract, declared at 31 ppm. That is a trace level — around 267 times less than the tea tree in the same jar — so it is worth knowing that this is a tea tree moisturizer with a small amount of centella, rather than a centella-led cream. DABO positions it as a pH-balancing relief moisturizer for fresh, calm-looking skin.

Product Overview

Dabo T-Tree Cica Relief Moisturizer is a daily moisturizing cream for skin that needs lightweight hydration together with soothing and skin-conditioning care. It combines a water-based moisturizing system with Australian tea tree, Niacinamide, centella and barrier-supporting ingredients.

Butylene Glycol, Trehalose, Polyglycerin-3, Glycereth-26 and Glycerin attract and hold moisture, while Ethylhexyl Stearate, Cetearyl Alcohol and Methyl Trimethicone provide softness and a smooth, non-greasy feel.

Beta-Glucan, Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid, Ceramide NP and Hydrogenated Lecithin complement the hydration with moisture-barrier and conditioning support, and a broad set of botanical extracts rounds out the formula.

DABO’s box describes it as a skin treatment solution with Australian tea tree, and a pH-balancing moisturizer for fresh, calm skin — which matches what the ingredient list actually delivers.

Korean Functional Designation & Testing

The lid of the jar carries two statements that are worth knowing about:

미백 기능성 화장품 — a functional cosmetic for brightening. This is Korea’s registered designation, and the active behind it is Niacinamide, the fourth ingredient in the formula. Korea permits Niacinamide as a brightening functional active between 2% and 5%, and its position here is consistent with that. The claim is that it helps with the appearance of dullness and uneven tone — a cosmetic claim, not a medical one, and not skin bleaching.

피부 자극 테스트 완료 — skin irritation testing completed. For a moisturizer aimed at stressed or reactive skin, this is a meaningful statement. It means the finished formula has been through a dermatological irritation test rather than simply being marketed as gentle.

Neither claim replaces your own patch test, especially as the formula contains added fragrance, but together they tell you this is a properly registered and tested Korean cosmetic rather than a marketing-only “cica” product.

Tea Tree and Cica — the Actual Amounts

Both hero ingredients are declared with exact amounts on the label, which is unusual and welcome. Reading them side by side tells you what this moisturizer really is:

  • Tea Tree Leaf Extract — 8,280 ppm, or 0.828% (twelfth ingredient)
  • Centella Asiatica Extract — 31 ppm, or 0.0031% (twenty-seventh ingredient)

The tea tree is roughly 267 times the centella. At 0.828%, the tea tree extract is present at a level that genuinely does something — this is a real tea tree product, and that is its strength.

The centella at 31 ppm is a declared trace amount. It is genuinely in the formula, but it is not what makes the cream soothing. The calming side comes from the tea tree itself, from Beta-Glucan, from Ceramide NP supporting the barrier, and from the overall lightweight, fragrance-light formulation.

So read “Cica” in the product name as part of the line’s branding rather than as a high-dose centella claim, and buy this one for the tea tree — which is where the formula actually invests.

Key Benefits

  • Registered in Korea as a brightening functional cosmetic (미백 기능성 화장품).
  • Skin irritation testing completed, as stated on the packaging.
  • Australian Tea Tree Leaf Extract at 8,280 ppm (0.828%).

  • Broad botanical extract blend for additional skin-conditioning care.
  • Positioned as a pH-balancing moisturizer for fresh, calm-looking skin.

Selected Ingredient Highlights

Australian Tea Tree Leaf Extract — 8,280 ppm

Melaleuca Alternifolia (Tea Tree) Leaf Extract is declared at 8,280 ppm, which is 0.828% of the formula, and DABO specifies Australian tea tree on the packaging. Australia is the plant’s native home and the benchmark origin for tea tree quality.

Tea tree is one of the most established botanicals for oily, congested and blemish-prone skin. At this level it is a working ingredient rather than a label decoration, and it is the main reason to choose this moisturizer.

Niacinamide

Niacinamide is the fourth ingredient and the active behind the Korean brightening designation. This multifunctional form of Vitamin B3 helps with the appearance of dullness and uneven tone while also supporting normal skin barrier function — a useful pairing with tea tree, since blemish-prone skin often deals with post-blemish marks.

Centella Asiatica Extract — 31 ppm

Centella Asiatica Extract, or Cica, is declared at 31 ppm (0.0031%) and sits twenty-seventh on the list. It is genuinely present at a declared trace level, and it is the ingredient the “Cica” in the name refers to.

Trehalose

Trehalose is a sugar-derived humectant known for helping skin hold moisture under dry conditions. It sits sixth, which is high, and is a real part of the hydration system.

Beta-Glucan

Beta-Glucan provides both moisture-binding and soothing skin-conditioning support — one of the ingredients genuinely doing the calming work in this formula.

Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid

Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid is the broken-down, smaller-fragment form of hyaluronic acid, which sits more readily on the skin surface and supports hydrated, plump-looking skin.

Ceramide NP

Ceramide NP is a skin-identical lipid that helps support the skin’s natural moisture barrier. Finding a ceramide in a moisturizer at this price point is a genuine plus, particularly in a product aimed at stressed skin.

Hydrogenated Lecithin

Hydrogenated Lecithin is a phospholipid that acts as both an emulsifier and a skin-compatible lipid, complementing Ceramide NP in supporting the barrier.

Kelp & Houttuynia Cordata

Laminaria Japonica (Kelp) Extract sits twenty-first and provides antioxidant and skin-conditioning support, while Houttuynia Cordata Extract is a long-established East Asian botanical used for calming blemish-prone skin — a sensible companion to tea tree.

Botanical Extract Complex

The formula also contains Eucommia Ulmoides Leaf Extract, Eclipta Prostrata Leaf Extract, Ulmus Davidiana Root Extract, Ficus Carica (Fig) Fruit Extract, Amaranthus Caudatus Seed Extract, Veronica Officinalis Extract, Poterium Officinale Root Extract and Fructooligosaccharides, with Tocopherol (Vitamin E) for antioxidant support.

Texture & Fragrance

Dabo T-Tree Cica Relief Moisturizer has a lightweight cream texture that provides moisture without a heavy or greasy finish — appropriate for a product aimed at oily and blemish-prone skin.

Methyl Trimethicone and Ethylhexyl Stearate help the cream spread smoothly and absorb, while Cetearyl Alcohol, Sorbitan Olivate and Sorbitan Stearate give it body.

It is not fragrance-free. Fragrance is declared on the ingredient list at position twenty-two. If your skin reacts to fragranced skincare, patch test before regular use — the completed irritation test is reassuring but does not rule out individual sensitivity.

Think twice if:

The sunscreen is labelled SPF50+ PA+++ and is registered in Korea as a functional cosmetic for UV protection.

One of the most common complaints about high-SPF sunscreen is the pale grey or chalky film it can leave behind, particularly on medium and deeper skin tones.

The packaging also names Aloe Vera Leaf Juice as a soothing ingredient intended to calm skin after sun exposure.

As with any sunscreen, the finish on skin can still vary depending on how much product is applied, the skincare worn underneath and individual skin tone and type.

One of the main advantages of Dabo White Sun Stick UV Essence Aqua is its solid stick format.

The twist-up container also helps keep the product compact and protected while stored inside a bag or skincare pouch.

Sun sticks can be particularly useful for sunscreen reapplication. However, users should avoid relying on only one light swipe because the labelled SPF protection assumes an adequate quantity of sunscreen has been applied.

For more even coverage, use multiple overlapping passes and pay particular attention to areas that are easy to miss, including the sides of the face, hairline, jawline, nose and around the ears.

How to Reapply Sunscreen

Sunscreen protection gradually decreases through normal activity, sweating, touching the face and environmental exposure.

During continued outdoor exposure, reapply sunscreen regularly. Reapplication is particularly important after heavy sweating, wiping the face or other activities that may remove sunscreen from the skin.

When using the stick for reapplication, glide it evenly across exposed areas with several overlapping passes.

If applying over makeup, use gentle pressure to minimise disturbing the makeup underneath. Coverage should remain the priority because applying too little sunscreen can reduce the level of protection achieved.

The Ordinary Retinol 1% In Squalane Overview

The Ordinary Retinol 1% In Squalane is an anhydrous retinol serum intended to provide high-strength age-supporting skincare without the complexity of a multi-active formula.

Its main goals are to help improve the visible appearance of:

  • Fine lines
  • Uneven-looking skin tone
  • Rough or irregular skin texture
  • General visible signs of skin aging
  • Dryness associated with retinol use through its emollient Squalane base

The formula contains only a short ingredient list of eight ingredients and does not rely on water as its base. Instead, the serum uses Squalane and other emollient ingredients to deliver Retinol in an oil-like format.

This product should be considered a high-strength retinol serum rather than an entry-level anti-aging serum.

1% Retinol Explained

Retinol is a cosmetic form of Vitamin A and belongs to the retinoid family. It is widely used in skincare products intended to improve the visible appearance of fine lines, rough texture and uneven tone.

The Ordinary Retinol 1% In Squalane contains 1% Retinol, which is the highest concentration available in The Ordinary’s traditional Retinol in Squalane range.

The range generally progresses through:

  • Retinol 0.2% in Squalane
  • Retinol 0.5% in Squalane
  • Retinol 1% in Squalane

For this reason, The Ordinary recommends that inexperienced retinol users begin at a lower concentration and gradually progress upward as the skin develops tolerance.

Retinol supports the appearance of smoother and more even-looking skin over time. Results are gradual, so consistent use and appropriate sun protection are more important than applying excessive amounts.

Why Squalane Is Used

Squalane is the first ingredient in the formula and forms the main base of the product.

Squalane is an oil-like emollient related to components naturally present in human sebum. In cosmetic formulations, it helps soften the skin and reduce moisture loss.

This is especially relevant in a strong retinol formula because Retinol may initially cause dryness, tightness or flaking in some users. The Squalane base helps provide additional emollient support and can make the formula feel more comfortable than a completely non-emollient retinol treatment.

However, Squalane does not eliminate the possibility of retinol irritation. Proper introduction, frequency control and moisturizer use are still important.

  • Helps improve uneven-looking skin tone
  • Helps refine rough and irregular-looking skin texture

Formula & Texture

The Ordinary describes Retinol 1% In Squalane as an anhydrous serum, meaning that the formula does not use water as its main base.

The ingredient declaration begins with:

  1. Squalane
  2. Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride

This composition gives the serum a lightweight oil-like texture rather than a conventional water-based serum texture.

Only a few drops are needed for the entire face. Applying more product does not make Retinol work faster and may increase the chance of irritation.

Retinol 1%

Retinol is the key active ingredient and is present at a confirmed concentration of 1%.

It is used to improve visible signs associated with skin aging, including fine lines, uneven tone and textural irregularities.

Because 1% is a relatively strong concentration for cosmetic Retinol, tolerance should be built gradually.

Squalane

Squalane is the first ingredient and the principal base of the serum.

It acts as an emollient that helps soften the skin and reduce moisture loss. The Ordinary specifically uses it to support the skin against some of the drying effects that can accompany Retinol use.

Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride

Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride is a lightweight emollient that contributes to slip, spreadability and softness.

It helps distribute the oil-based formula smoothly over the skin.

Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil

Jojoba Seed Oil provides additional emollient conditioning and contributes to the serum’s oil-like texture.

Its main role in this formula is supportive moisturization rather than functioning as the primary active ingredient.

Solanum Lycopersicum (Tomato) Fruit Extract

Tomato Fruit Extract is included as a supporting botanical ingredient within the formula.

Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Extract

Rosemary Leaf Extract is also included as a supporting antioxidant botanical ingredient.

Hydroxymethoxyphenyl Decanone

Hydroxymethoxyphenyl Decanone is a supporting cosmetic ingredient used within the formula.

BHT

BHT is the final ingredient and acts as an antioxidant stabilizing ingredient that helps protect the oil-based formulation from oxidation.

Suitable Skin Types

The Ordinary lists the formula as suitable for all skin types, but practical suitability depends heavily on individual retinol tolerance.

It may be particularly appropriate for:

  • Normal skin experienced with retinoids
  • Combination skin experienced with retinoids
  • Dry skin needing an emollient retinol base
  • Mature-looking skin
  • Skin with visible fine lines
  • Skin with rough texture
  • Skin with uneven-looking tone
  • Users progressing from lower-strength Retinol

People with highly sensitive, compromised or easily irritated skin should use particular caution because 1% Retinol can be intense.

Is The Ordinary Retinol 1% In Squalane Suitable for Beginners?

Generally, it is not the ideal first Retinol for a complete beginner.

The Ordinary describes the 1% formula as a high-strength option and advises users to begin with lower concentrations such as Retinol 0.2% in Squalane and gradually move to 0.5% and then 1%.

  • Dryness
  • Redness
  • Peeling
  • Tightness
  • Stinging
  • Sensitivity

If you are already comfortable with a lower-strength Retinol and your skin tolerates it consistently, the 1% formula may be considered as a stronger progression.

When introducing Retinol, keeping the rest of the routine relatively simple makes it easier to understand how the skin is responding.

Retinol Adjustment & Possible Irritation

Retinol may cause temporary irritation while the skin develops tolerance, particularly when used at higher concentrations.

Possible early reactions may include:

  • Dryness
  • Flaking
  • Redness
  • Tightness

  • Increased sensitivity

Persistent, severe or painful irritation should not simply be considered a normal adjustment period. Stop use, rinse the product off if necessary and seek appropriate medical advice if significant irritation develops.

Retinol is sensitive to light, heat and air, and it can gradually degrade. Careful storage helps maintain the formula’s stability after opening.

  • Keep the cap and dropper securely closed.
  • Avoid prolonged exposure to direct sunlight.

The packaging summarizes the product’s cosmetic benefits in three key areas: it helps reduce the appearance of uneven skin tone, smooths skin texture, and provides deep hydration and glow.

Arencia PDRN Booster Shot Overview

Arencia PDRN Booster Shot is a concentrated skincare booster designed for skin that needs additional hydration, tone care, texture care, firmness support and revitalizing moisture.

The exact packaging uses more than one product description. The outer box describes it as a “Serum and Moisturizer for Targeted Solutions”, the front of the tube describes it as a Face and Eye Moisturizer, and the multilingual information on the tube identifies its cosmetic function as a serum.

For that reason, it is more accurate to describe this product as a serum-moisturizer booster rather than forcing it into only one conventional skincare category.

Its formula combines humectants, emollients, PDRN-related ingredients, barrier-supportive ingredients and multiple peptides. This makes it relevant for routines focused on dehydration, uneven-looking skin tone, rough texture, fine lines, visible loss of firmness and dullness.

Arencia’s U.S. product information additionally positions the booster for stressed and red-prone skin and describes the PDRN system as combining Rosy-PDRN and Salmon PDRN.

This is a cosmetic skincare product. It should not be described as medically regenerating damaged tissue, repairing wounds, treating inflammatory skin disease or replacing professional dermatological treatment.

What It Does

The supplied outer packaging highlights three primary cosmetic benefits:

  • Helps Reduce Uneven Skin Tone: Niacinamide and the supporting formula help improve the appearance of dull or uneven-looking skin.
  • Smooths Skin Texture: Hydrating, conditioning and peptide ingredients help rough or tired-looking skin appear smoother and more refined.
  • Provides Deep Hydration and Glow: Glycerin, Panthenol, Ceramide NP and multiple Hyaluronic Acid-related ingredients help maintain moisture and support a plumper, healthier-looking glow.

The packaging also describes the formula as containing 5% Rosy-PDRN Complex to help uneven-looking skin tone. This should be understood as a cosmetic tone-care claim rather than a medical pigmentation treatment.

5% Rosy-PDRN Complex

Those descriptions would imply a concentration that is not stated on the current packaging or Korean official ingredient information.

Sodium DNA – 100 ppm

Arencia Korea’s current official ingredient declaration separately lists Sodium DNA at 100 ppm.

The 100 ppm Sodium DNA declaration and the 5% Rosy-PDRN Complex statement are separate formulation details. They should not be treated as equivalent concentrations or mathematically combined.
