products.name: Cosrx Hyaluronic Acid Hydra Power Essence 100 ml
products.description:
Key Ingredients and Their Benefits

At the heart of this essence is hyaluronic acid, a powerful and widely recognized humectant known for its ability to attract and retain moisture. Hyaluronic acid is naturally present in the skin and plays a vital role in maintaining hydration levels, but as we age, its production decreases. By replenishing the skin’s hyaluronic acid levels, this essence helps the skin retain moisture, ensuring it stays hydrated for longer periods. The high concentration of hyaluronic acid in this product is responsible for its ability to offer deep hydration, making it especially beneficial for dry and dehydrated skin.

In addition to hyaluronic acid, the Cosrx Hyaluronic Acid Hydra Power Essence also contains a combination of other ingredients that complement its hydrating effects. Some of these include panthenol (also known as provitamin B5), ethylhexylglycerin, and 1,2-hexanediol. Panthenol is a soothing ingredient that helps improve the skin’s moisture retention and has anti-inflammatory properties that can calm irritated skin. Ethylhexylglycerin acts as a preservative and has antimicrobial benefits, while 1,2-hexanediol helps the skin retain moisture and contributes to the essence’s smooth, silky texture.

Texture and Application

One of the standout features of the Cosrx Hyaluronic Acid Hydra Power Essence is its texture. Unlike some thicker, heavier serums or essences, this product has a lightweight, watery consistency that absorbs quickly into the skin. This makes it an excellent choice for layering within a skincare routine.

The essence is designed to be used after cleansing and toning and can be applied both in the morning and evening. To use, simply dispense a small amount of the essence onto your palms and gently press it into the skin. The formula absorbs rapidly, delivering an instant surge of hydration. Since it’s so lightweight, it works well with other products in your routine, such as moisturizers, sunscreens, or more intensive serums. Many users find that it provides a smooth, soft base for makeup application as well, as it hydrates and plumps the skin without making it feel heavy.

Skin Benefits

The primary benefit of using the Cosrx Hyaluronic Acid Hydra Power Essence is its ability to provide deep, long-lasting hydration. Hydrated skin is not only more comfortable, but it also looks healthier and more youthful. Dehydration can cause the skin to appear dull, rough, or uneven, but by infusing the skin with moisture, this essence helps restore a more radiant complexion.

In addition to improving hydration levels, the essence also plays a role in enhancing skin elasticity. Hyaluronic acid has been shown to help stimulate collagen production, which is crucial for maintaining skin’s firmness and elasticity. This can result in smoother, more supple skin, reducing the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles over time. The hydration provided by the Cosrx Hyaluronic Acid Hydra Power Essence also helps the skin appear plumper, giving it a more youthful, dewy appearance.

Another key advantage of the essence is its ability to support the skin’s natural barrier. The skin’s moisture barrier is essential for protecting against environmental pollutants, bacteria, and other harmful substances. A compromised barrier can lead to increased sensitivity, irritation, and moisture loss. By keeping the skin adequately hydrated and supporting the barrier’s function, this essence helps maintain overall skin health.

How to Incorporate Into a Skincare Routine

The Cosrx Hyaluronic Acid Hydra Power Essence can be seamlessly incorporated into both basic and advanced skincare routines. After cleansing and toning, apply a few drops of the essence onto your palms and gently press it into the face and neck. You can follow it up with a serum if you desire additional benefits such as brightening or anti-aging, and then seal in the moisture with your favorite moisturizer. Be sure to finish your routine with sunscreen in the morning to protect the skin from harmful UV rays.

This essence is particularly beneficial in the colder months when skin tends to lose moisture more quickly due to the dry air. However, it is light enough to be used year-round, offering hydration without making the skin feel too heavy or greasy. It’s also an excellent option for anyone living in an area with low humidity or in air-conditioned environments, which can contribute to skin dehydration.

Conclusion

The Cosrx Hyaluronic Acid Hydra Power Essence is a highly effective, lightweight skincare product that offers deep hydration, improves skin elasticity, and promotes a healthy, glowing complexion. Its star ingredient, hyaluronic acid, provides an instant boost of moisture, while other ingredients work in harmony to maintain skin health and support a strong moisture barrier. The essence is suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin, and is an ideal addition to any skincare routine aimed at combating dryness, dehydration, or dullness. With consistent use, this essence helps achieve plump, smooth, and well-hydrated skin that radiates with health and vitality.

Product Overview

Anua Heartleaf 77% Soothing Toner is a daily hydrating and soothing toner developed for sensitive-feeling, dehydrated, stressed and redness-prone skin.

The formula is powered by 77% Houttuynia Cordata Flower/Leaf/Stem Water, commonly known as Heartleaf. It is Anua’s signature soothing botanical, and in this toner it is the first ingredient on the list — the base of the product rather than a supporting addition.

Alongside Heartleaf, the formula adds a moisture-supporting system built on Glycerin, Betaine, Butylene Glycol, Isopentyldiol and Panthenol, finished with seven forms of Hyaluronic Acid, in a lightweight watery texture.

77% Heartleaf Care

Houttuynia Cordata Flower/Leaf/Stem Water – 77%

Heartleaf Water makes up 77% of the formula and is the signature ingredient of this toner.

It is listed first on the ingredient list, ahead of water. That placement matters: many products name a hero ingredient that turns out to sit near the bottom of the list. Here the 77% figure is the actual base of the product.

Heartleaf is widely used in Korean skincare for soothing and skin-conditioning care. In this formula it helps support sensitive-feeling, stressed and redness-prone skin while keeping the skin comfortable after cleansing.

The high Heartleaf content makes this toner particularly relevant for users who want a simple soothing step without strong exfoliating or treatment-focused actives.

Panthenol & Soothing Care

Panthenol

Panthenol, also known as Pro-Vitamin B5, provides soothing, moisturizing and skin-barrier-supporting care. It is listed eighth, placing it among the formula’s substantial ingredients rather than at trace level.

It complements Heartleaf and makes the toner useful when skin feels dry, tight or uncomfortable after cleansing.

Centella Asiatica Extract

Centella Asiatica Extract, commonly known as Cica, is listed eleventh and provides additional soothing and skin-conditioning support. It is the highest-placed botanical extract in the formula after Heartleaf.

Where the Moisture Actually Comes From

The toner’s hydration is carried mainly by its humectants, which occupy the top of the ingredient list.

Glycerin, Betaine, Butylene Glycol & Isopentyldiol

Glycerin (fourth), Betaine (fifth), Butylene Glycol (sixth) and Isopentyldiol (seventh) sit directly after the Heartleaf and water base. Together with Panthenol they do the real moisture work, attracting water to the skin and keeping it comfortable and soft.

The Seven Hyaluronic Acid Forms

The formula is finished with seven Hyaluronic Acid and Hyaluronate derivatives: Sodium Hyaluronate, Hydroxypropyltrimonium Hyaluronate, Sodium Acetylated Hyaluronate, Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid, Hyaluronic Acid, Sodium Hyaluronate Crosspolymer and Potassium Hyaluronate.

They differ in molecular size and in how they bind water, and they add a layer of surface moisture retention on top of the humectant base. All seven appear in the final section of the 24-ingredient list, so they are present in small supporting amounts — they refine the toner’s moisture profile rather than drive it.

Phellinus Linteus Extract

Phellinus Linteus Extract, a mushroom-derived ingredient, provides additional antioxidant and conditioning care.

Portulaca Oleracea Extract

Chamomilla Recutita Flower Extract

Chamomile Flower Extract provides additional soothing and skin-conditioning benefits.

Vitex Agnus-Castus Extract

Vitex Agnus-Castus Extract provides botanical conditioning support and completes the extract complex.

A Short 24-Ingredient Formula

The full ingredient list runs to just 24 ingredients, which is short for a toner of this kind.

There is no Fragrance or Parfum, no AHA, BHA or PHA, and no Phenoxyethanol — 1,2-Hexanediol, listed third, handles that role instead.

For anyone whose skin reacts easily, a shorter list means fewer ingredients to react to, which is part of why this toner suits sensitive and redness-prone skin.

products.description:
Eqqualberry Swimming Pool Toner – A Refreshing Dive Into Skincare

The Eqqualberry Swimming Pool Toner is a standout product in the world of K-beauty, expertly crafted to hydrate, balance, and gently exfoliate the skin. With its refreshing concept and science-backed ingredients, this toner doesn’t just prep the skin—it transforms your skincare routine into a sensory, skin-loving experience.

1. Concept & Inspiration

Inspired by the clean, refreshing feeling of diving into a swimming pool, the Eqqualberry Swimming Pool Toner was formulated to provide skin with a similar sense of cool, deep hydration. This product captures the essence of that first splash—awakening and invigorating—while infusing the skin with moisture, antioxidants, and gentle exfoliants.

The toner’s water-light consistency and skin-friendly formula make it ideal for all skin types, including sensitive and acne-prone skin. It’s especially beneficial for people looking for a mild exfoliating toner that won’t irritate or dry out the skin.

2. Key Benefits

  • Deep Hydration: Thanks to 8-layered hyaluronic acid, this toner penetrates multiple layers of the skin, providing lasting hydration.
  • Gentle Exfoliation: Natural protease enzymes work to dissolve and remove dead skin cells without mechanical irritation or harsh acids.
  • Antioxidant Protection: A 5 Berry Complex shields the skin from oxidative stress and environmental damage.
  • Skin Barrier Support: The low-pH formula (around 5.5) helps maintain the skin’s natural acid mantle, promoting overall barrier health.
  • Soothing and Calming: Alcohol- and fragrance-free, it’s designed to minimize the risk of irritation or redness.

3. Ingredient Highlights

🔹 8-Layered Hyaluronic Acid

  • This powerhouse humectant comes in various molecular sizes, each penetrating different depths of the skin. The result is plump, well-hydrated skin from the surface to the deeper layers.
  • It helps maintain skin elasticity, smoothness, and suppleness, all while reducing the appearance of fine lines and dehydration.

🔹 Natural Protease Enzyme

  • Derived from fermentation, protease gently breaks down and removes dead skin cells, making it an excellent alternative to traditional AHAs or BHAs for sensitive skin.
  • It promotes cell turnover, brightens dull skin, and allows better absorption of subsequent skincare products.

🔹 5 Berry Complex

  • A proprietary blend of blueberry, cranberry, raspberry, blackberry, and elderberry extracts. These berries are rich in anthocyanins and vitamin C, which help fight free radicals and reduce signs of aging.
  • They also contribute to an even skin tone and a more radiant complexion.

🔹 Panthenol (Pro-Vitamin B5)

  • Soothes and protects the skin while enhancing hydration.
  • Supports the skin’s natural healing process and helps reduce inflammation or redness.

🔹 Allantoin

  • A gentle skin-soothing ingredient that also supports exfoliation and cell regeneration.
  • Calms irritated or inflamed skin, making this toner ideal even after sun exposure or skin treatments.

4. Texture and Application

The toner has a lightweight, watery texture that absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving any sticky or greasy residue. Despite its feather-light feel, the hydration it delivers is long-lasting and immediately noticeable.

How to Use:

  • After cleansing, pour a small amount onto a cotton pad or your hands.
  • Gently pat or sweep it across the face and neck.
  • Follow up with serums and moisturizer.
  • Can be used morning and night. For very dry skin, apply multiple layers using the “7-skin method.”

5. Packaging & Sustainability

Eqqualberry is known for its eco-conscious branding, and the Swimming Pool Toner is no exception. The product comes in a recyclable, minimalist plastic bottle with a modern design that reflects its “pool-inspired” identity—cool blues and clear visuals to evoke freshness and purity.

6. Who Should Use It?

  • Oily Skin: It helps balance sebum without clogging pores.
  • Dry Skin: Multi-layered hyaluronic acid ensures deep hydration.
  • Sensitive Skin: Free from alcohol, parabens, synthetic dyes, and fragrances.
  • Aging Skin: Antioxidants and hydration improve elasticity and reduce fine lines.
  • Acne-Prone Skin: Mild exfoliation without irritating ingredients makes this a great option for those managing breakouts or skin congestion.

7. Real User Experiences

Users consistently rave about the toner’s hydrating and refreshing properties. Many note how it immediately soothes tight or dry skin post-cleansing and improves the texture of their skin over time.

💬 “It’s the only toner I can use without any stinging or irritation. I have sensitive skin and rosacea, and this feels like water—but better.”

products.name: Essance Pearl Whitening Cream 50 ml
products.description:
Essance Pearl Whitening Cream is a brightening and moisturizing facial cream formulated to help improve the appearance of dull, uneven-looking skin while maintaining softness and comfortable hydration. Its formula combines Niacinamide and Pearl Powder with nourishing emollients, humectants and skin-conditioning ingredients for a smoother and more radiant-looking complexion.

The formula begins with Water, Propanediol and Macadamia Ternifolia Seed Oil, followed by emollient ingredients such as Dimethicone and Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride. These ingredients help replenish moisture, soften rough-feeling skin and create a smooth, comfortable finish without relying on a single moisturizing ingredient.

Niacinamide provides brightening and skin barrier-supporting care, while Pearl Powder is the ingredient the line is named after. Shea Butter, Panthenol and Trehalose provide additional moisturizing and conditioning support, making the cream particularly useful for skin that feels dry, dull or lacking in softness.

The product is officially positioned as suitable for all skin types. Its rich yet lightweight cream texture is designed to absorb comfortably while leaving the skin soft and moisturized. The formula does contain added fragrance and six individually declared fragrance components, so users with highly fragrance-sensitive skin should patch test before regular use.

Table of Contents

  • Product Overview
  • Key Benefits
  • Selected Ingredient Highlights
  • Why the Cream Looks Pearly
  • Texture & Fragrance

Product Overview

Essance Pearl Whitening Cream is a Korean facial moisturizer developed for skin that needs hydration together with brightening and radiance-focused care. The combination of Niacinamide, Pearl Powder, nourishing plant oil, Shea Butter and humectants helps improve the appearance of dullness while keeping the skin soft and moisturized.

Its moisturizing base combines humectants and emollients rather than relying only on heavy occlusive ingredients. Propanediol and Trehalose are the two humectants in the formula — notably, it contains no Glycerin — while Macadamia Seed Oil, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Shea Butter, Hydrogenated Polydecene and Pentaerythrityl Tetraisostearate provide softness and nourishment.

Niacinamide is included to support a brighter, more even-looking complexion and healthy skin barrier function. Pearl Powder is incorporated as the ingredient the Essance Pearl line is built around.

A word on the name: “Whitening” here is a product name, not a description of what the cream does to your skin colour. This is a cosmetic moisturizer that works on the appearance of dullness and uneven tone. It does not bleach the skin and will not change your natural skin colour.

Key Benefits

  • Helps moisturize dry and dehydrated-feeling skin.
  • Supports a brighter and more radiant-looking complexion.
  • Helps improve the appearance of dull and uneven-looking skin tone.
  • Niacinamide provides brightening and skin barrier support.
  • Macadamia Seed Oil and Shea Butter provide nourishing emollient care.
  • Panthenol supports moisture and skin comfort.
  • Propanediol and Trehalose support moisture retention.
  • Gives an immediate soft-focus, luminous finish on the skin.
  • Helps leave the skin feeling softer and smoother.
  • Suitable for all skin types according to the product packaging.

Selected Ingredient Highlights

Niacinamide

Niacinamide, a form of Vitamin B3, is the main brightening ingredient in the formula. It helps improve the appearance of dullness and uneven-looking skin tone while also supporting the skin’s natural moisture barrier.

It sits in the middle of the ingredient list and the packaging does not declare a percentage, so treat it as a supporting level rather than a high-dose Niacinamide treatment. With regular use as part of a balanced routine, it can help skin look clearer and more even.

Pearl Powder

Pearl Powder is the ingredient the Essance Pearl line is named after. It is genuinely present in the formula, and no percentage is declared on the packaging.

Where it sits is worth knowing. Pearl Powder is twenty-fifth of the thirty-two ingredients, and it appears directly below the four pearlescent pigments described in the next section. So while it is a real part of the formula, the visible luminous finish you see when the cream goes on comes from those pigments rather than from the Pearl Powder itself. Judge the cream on how well it moisturizes and how your skin looks over time, which it does well, rather than on an expectation of high-dose pearl.

Macadamia Ternifolia Seed Oil

Macadamia Seed Oil is the third ingredient, which is unusually high for a plant oil in a face cream, and it is a real strength of this formula. Macadamia oil is rich in oleic and palmitoleic acid, making it closer in character to the skin’s own sebum than most plant oils. It softens the skin and reduces the rough or tight feeling that comes with insufficient moisture.

Shea Butter

Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter provides richer emollient care and helps support a soft, smooth and comfortable skin feel.

It works alongside Macadamia Seed Oil, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Hydrogenated Polydecene and Pentaerythrityl Tetraisostearate to create the cream’s nourishing moisturizing base.

Panthenol

Panthenol, also known as Pro-Vitamin B5, is a moisturizing and skin-conditioning ingredient that helps support skin comfort and softness.

Propanediol & Trehalose

Propanediol is the second ingredient and the formula’s main humectant, drawing and holding water in the upper layers of the skin. Trehalose is a sugar-derived humectant known for helping skin hold moisture under dry conditions. Together they do the water-binding work that Glycerin usually does in a Korean cream — this formula contains no Glycerin.

Dimethicone

Dimethicone is the fourth ingredient. It smooths the skin surface, reduces water loss, and gives the cream its silky slip on application.

The Emulsifier System

Polyglyceryl-3 Methylglucose Distearate, Cetearyl Alcohol, Glyceryl Stearate, PEG-100 Stearate and Hydrogenated Lecithin are the emulsifiers that hold the oil and water phases together and give the cream its stable, uniform texture. Cetearyl Alcohol is a fatty alcohol and, despite the name, is not drying.

Why the Cream Looks Pearly

The soft pearly glow this cream leaves on the skin comes from pearlescent pigments, not from the Pearl Powder. Four are declared on the packaging, and all four sit above Pearl Powder in the ingredient list:

  • Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891) — a white pigment that brightens and gives the soft-focus effect
  • Mica — the mineral that provides the pearl shimmer
  • Iron Oxides (CI 77491) — red iron oxide, supplying the warm pink tone of the cream
  • Synthetic Fluorphlogopite — synthetic mica, used for a finer, more uniform shimmer than natural mica alone

These are standard, widely used cosmetic pigments, and they do a genuine job: they give an immediate soft-focus, luminous look the moment the cream is applied. We list them here so there is no confusion about where that glow comes from. The immediate radiance is an optical effect from these pigments. The longer-term work on dullness and uneven tone is done by Niacinamide and by keeping the skin properly moisturized.

Texture & Fragrance

Essance Pearl Whitening Cream has a rich yet lightweight cream texture designed to spread smoothly and absorb without leaving an excessively heavy or greasy finish.

The combination of silicone, Macadamia oil, Shea Butter and lightweight emollient esters creates a soft, velvety skin feel after application, with the pigments adding a subtle luminous finish.

It is not a fragrance-free moisturizer. The packaging declares Fragrance along with six individual fragrance components: Benzyl Benzoate, Linalool, Citronellol, Hexyl Cinnamal, Limonene and Hydroxycitronellal. Six declared allergens is on the higher side for a face cream, which is worth knowing if your skin reacts to fragranced skincare.

Users who are highly sensitive to fragranced products should patch test on the inner forearm before introducing the cream into their regular routine.

Suitable Skin Types

  • Normal skin
  • Dry skin
  • Dehydrated skin
  • Dull-looking skin
  • Uneven-looking skin tone
  • Skin lacking softness and radiance
  • Combination skin needing moisturizing care

Think twice if:

  • You are fragrance-sensitive — six fragrance allergens are declared
  • You avoid silicones; Dimethicone is the fourth ingredient
  • You want a high-dose Niacinamide treatment rather than a moisturizer with brightening support

Very oily skin may prefer using a smaller amount, especially during warm or humid weather, while dry skin may benefit from applying the cream more generously as the final moisturizing step.

How to Use

  1. Cleanse the face thoroughly with a suitable facial cleanser.
  2. Apply toner, essence and serum according to your regular skincare routine.
  3. Take an appropriate amount of Essance Pearl Whitening Cream.
  4. Apply evenly over the face and neck.
  5. Gently massage or pat until the cream is absorbed.
  6. Use in the morning and evening according to your skin’s needs.
  7. During the daytime, finish the routine with a broad-spectrum sunscreen.

Step 1 – Cleanser: Cleanse the skin to remove excess oil, sunscreen, makeup and daily impurities.

Step 3 – Essence or Serum: Apply treatment products according to your individual skin concerns.

<h2 id=”overview”>Product Overview</h2>

<p><strong>K-Secret Seoul 1988 Sun: Pine Tree + Ceramide</strong> is a daily facial sunscreen that combines strong UV protection with soothing, barrier-supporting and moisturizing skincare ingredients.</p>

<p>Its formula delivers broad-spectrum <strong>SPF50+ PA++++</strong> protection using four modern organic UV filters, without relying on mineral filters such as Zinc Oxide or Titanium Dioxide.</p>

<p>Alongside sun protection, the sunscreen carries Pine Tree Bud Extract at a declared 1%, Niacinamide in the top ten ingredients, Adenosine, Ceramide NP and a blend of eight peptides — making it suitable for users who want their sunscreen step to carry skincare ingredients as well.</p>

<h2 id=”functional”>Korean Functional Cosmetic Status</h2>

<p>In Korea, any product carrying an SPF and PA rating is regulated as a <strong>자외선차단 기능성 화장품</strong> — a functional cosmetic registered for UV protection. This sunscreen’s SPF50+ PA++++ rating places it in that category, with the officially recognised purpose of helping protect the skin from ultraviolet rays.</p>

<p>The formula also contains <strong>Adenosine</strong>, which is Korea’s approved active for the wrinkle-improvement (주름개선) functional claim. Its inclusion is consistent with the way the product is positioned internationally as an anti-aging-supported sunscreen.</p>

<h2 id=”benefits”>Key Benefits</h2>

<ul>
<li>Provides SPF50+ PA++++ broad-spectrum sun protection.</li>
<li>Korean functional cosmetic for UV protection.</li>
<li>Uses four modern UV filters, all approved for Korean sunscreens.</li>
<li>Pine Tree Bud Extract declared at 10,009 ppm, about 1%.</li>
<li>Niacinamide listed seventh for barrier and tone-conditioning support.</li>
<li>Contains Adenosine, Korea’s approved wrinkle-care active.</li>
<li>Ceramide NP adds skin-identical lipid support.</li>
<li>Contains a blend of eight peptides.</li>
<li>Glycerin, Propanediol and glycols provide lightweight hydration.</li>
<li>Tocopherol provides antioxidant support.</li>
<li>Contains no Fragrance or Parfum.</li>
<li>Contains no drying alcohol.</li>
<li>Lightweight texture suitable for daily use under makeup.</li>
</ul>

<h2 id=”uv-protection”>SPF50+ PA++++ UV Protection</h2>

<p><strong>SPF50+</strong> provides a high level of protection against UVB radiation, which is strongly associated with sunburn and contributes to cumulative UV-related skin damage.</p>

<p><strong>PA++++</strong> is the highest UVA rating in the Korean and Japanese system. UVA rays contribute to premature visible aging, uneven-looking skin tone and long-term sun-related skin stress.</p>

<p>Daily sunscreen use matters especially when a routine is focused on brightness, elasticity or the appearance of pigmentation, since UV exposure works against all three.</p>

<h2 id=”filters”>Advanced UV Filter System</h2>

<h3>Diethylamino Hydroxybenzoyl Hexyl Benzoate</h3>

<p><strong>Diethylamino Hydroxybenzoyl Hexyl Benzoate</strong>, also known as Uvinul A Plus, is a modern UVA filter that provides strong, photostable protection across the UVA range. It is listed fourth.</p>

<h3>Ethylhexyl Triazone</h3>

<p><strong>Ethylhexyl Triazone</strong>, also known as Uvinul T150, is one of the most efficient UVB filters available and supports the product’s high SPF rating. It is listed sixth.</p>

<h3>Methylene Bis-Benzotriazolyl Tetramethylbutylphenol</h3>

<p><strong>Methylene Bis-Benzotriazolyl Tetramethylbutylphenol</strong>, commonly known as Tinosorb M, provides broad-spectrum UVA and UVB filtering and is listed eighth.</p>

<h3>Diethylhexyl Butamido Triazone</h3>

<p><strong>Diethylhexyl Butamido Triazone</strong>, also known as Uvasorb HEB, adds further photostable UVB protection and is listed twelfth.</p>

<h3>Butyloctyl Salicylate</h3>

<p><strong>Butyloctyl Salicylate</strong>, listed fifth, is not itself a UV filter. Three of the four filters above are crystalline powders, and this ingredient dissolves and disperses them evenly through the formula. Without a solvent of this kind, a high-SPF formula built on powder filters would feel gritty and apply unevenly, so its high position in the list is a meaningful part of why this sunscreen spreads smoothly.</p>

<p>Together these ingredients create a modern broad-spectrum protection system suited to everyday wear.</p>

<h2 id=”pine”>Pine Tree Care – 10,009 ppm</h2>

<h3>Pinus Sylvestris Bud Extract</h3>

<p><strong>Pinus Sylvestris Bud Extract</strong> is the signature botanical of this sunscreen and is declared on the ingredient panel at <strong>10,009 ppm, which is approximately 1%</strong>.</p>

<p>That is a substantial amount for a botanical extract in a sunscreen, and it is listed fourteenth — ahead of most of the formula’s supporting ingredients. The pine content is a real part of the formula rather than a name on the box.</p>

<p>Pine-derived extracts provide antioxidant and skin-conditioning support, which suits skin that feels stressed or uncomfortable after environmental exposure.</p>

<h2 id=”niacinamide”>Niacinamide Care</h2>

<p><strong>Niacinamide</strong>, a form of Vitamin B3, is listed <strong>seventh</strong> — among the formula’s substantial ingredients, ahead of two of the UV filters.</p>

<p>It provides support for the skin barrier, a more even-looking skin tone and general skin conditioning, and it complements the lipid and moisturizing ingredients during daily sunscreen use.</p>

<h2 id=”adenosine”>Adenosine & Wrinkle Care</h2>

<p><strong>Adenosine</strong> is the ingredient behind this sunscreen’s wrinkle-care positioning. In Korea it is the approved active for the 주름개선 (wrinkle improvement) functional claim, and it is the formula’s legitimate anti-aging ingredient rather than a supporting extract.</p>

<p>It supports the appearance of smoother, more elastic-looking skin alongside the product’s primary job of UV protection — which is itself the single most effective daily step against visible photoaging.</p>

<h2 id=”ceramide”>Ceramide & Skin Barrier Care</h2>

<h3>Ceramide NP – 100 ppm</h3>

<p><strong>Ceramide NP</strong> is a skin-identical lipid that supports the protective moisture barrier. Ceramides occur naturally in the outer layer of the skin and help reduce moisture loss.</p>

<p>In this formula it is declared at <strong>100 ppm, which is 0.01%</strong>, and is listed thirty-seventh. It is a supporting touch of barrier-identical lipid rather than a treatment-level ceramide dose — for comparison, the pine extract in the same formula is declared at roughly one hundred times that amount.</p>

<p>The formula’s day-to-day barrier comfort comes mainly from its emollients and humectants, with Ceramide NP, Sunflower Seed Oil Unsaponifiables and Echium Seed Oil rounding out the lipid side.</p>

<h2 id=”peptides”>The Peptide Blend</h2>

<p>The formula contains eight peptide ingredients:</p>

<ul>
<li>Nonapeptide-1</li>
<li>Acetyl Hexapeptide-8</li>
<li>Copper Tripeptide-1</li>
<li>Tripeptide-1</li>
<li>Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7</li>
<li>Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1</li>
<li>Palmitoyl Pentapeptide-4</li>
<li>Hexapeptide-9</li>
</ul>

<p>These peptides provide additional skin-conditioning care and support routines focused on smoothness and elasticity.</p>

<p>All eight sit at the very end of the ingredient list, so they are present in small amounts. They are a supportive finishing touch to a sunscreen, not a substitute for a dedicated peptide serum — and in this formula the wrinkle-care role is carried by Adenosine.</p>

<h2 id=”hydration”>Hydration & Antioxidant Care</h2>

<h3>Propanediol & Glycerin</h3>

<p><strong>Propanediol</strong>, listed second, and <strong>Glycerin</strong> are humectants that attract moisture to the skin and help keep the texture lightweight and comfortable.</p>

<h3>Butylene Glycol & Pentylene Glycol</h3>

<p><strong>Butylene Glycol and Pentylene Glycol</strong> provide additional moisture-supporting and skin-conditioning benefits.</p>

<h3>Tocopherol</h3>

<p><strong>Tocopherol</strong>, a form of Vitamin E, provides antioxidant support and helps condition the skin.</p>

<h3>Echium Plantagineum Seed Oil</h3>

<p><strong>Echium Plantagineum Seed Oil</strong> provides emollient and skin-conditioning care.</p>

<h3>Sunflower Seed Oil Unsaponifiables</h3>

<p><strong>Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil Unsaponifiables</strong> provide lipid-based conditioning support and complement Ceramide NP.</p>

<h3>Cardiospermum Halicacabum Extract</h3>

<p><strong>Cardiospermum Halicacabum Flower/Leaf/Vine Extract</strong> provides botanical soothing and skin-conditioning support.</p>

<h3>Hedychium Coronarium Root Extract</h3>

<p><strong>Hedychium Coronarium Root Extract</strong> provides additional antioxidant and botanical conditioning care.</p>

<h2 id=”texture”>Texture & Finish</h2>

<p>K-Secret Seoul 1988 Sun: Pine Tree + Ceramide is a lightweight daily sunscreen that spreads smoothly across the skin.</p>

<p>Dibutyl Adipate, Butyloctyl Salicylate, Coco-Caprylate/Caprate, Caprylyl Methicone and Polymethylsilsesquioxane work together to keep the powder UV filters dissolved and the finish smooth rather than heavy or gritty.</p>

<p>The formula absorbs comfortably and works as the final skincare step before makeup.</p>

<p>It contains no <strong>Fragrance or Parfum</strong>, and no drying alcohol such as Alcohol Denat. or Ethanol. Behenyl Alcohol is present, but it is a fatty alcohol used for texture and emollient support.</p>

23% Pure L-Ascorbic Acid

L-Ascorbic Acid is a direct and well-studied form of Vitamin C. It provides powerful antioxidant support and helps improve the appearance of dullness, uneven tone and visible signs of aging. However, direct Vitamin C can feel more intense than gentler Vitamin C derivatives.

The 23% concentration makes The Ordinary Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2% a potent treatment. People who have never used Vitamin C or who have highly reactive skin may prefer to begin with a lower-strength Vitamin C derivative before introducing this formula.

What Do HA Spheres 2% Do?

The suspension is supported with spheres of Hyaluronic Acid for added hydration. Hyaluronic Acid helps attract and retain moisture, supporting a softer and more comfortable skin feel while the concentrated Vitamin C targets dullness and uneven-looking tone.

The HA spheres do not completely remove the possibility of irritation from 23% L-Ascorbic Acid. Moisturizer and a gradual introduction are still important, particularly when the skin is dry or new to high-strength active products.

Why Does the Product Feel Granular?

The Ordinary Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2% has a slightly grainy texture because Vitamin C powder is suspended in a water-free, oil-like base rather than dissolved in water. The particles may remain noticeable for several seconds while the product is being spread.

This texture is an expected feature and does not necessarily indicate that the product is damaged. Apply a small amount and allow it to settle before adding moisturizer. Using too much can make the finish feel heavy or increase the likelihood of pilling.

Who Should Use This High-Strength Vitamin C?

The Ordinary Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2% may be suitable for people concerned about:

How to Use The Ordinary Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2%

  1. Cleanse the face and gently pat the skin dry.
  2. Apply any compatible lightweight, water-based hydrating serum first.
  3. Take a small amount of the Vitamin C suspension.
  4. Spread it evenly across the face while avoiding the eye contour and lips.
  5. Allow several seconds for the granular texture to settle.
  6. Follow with a compatible moisturizer when required.
  7. Use once daily, ideally during the evening.

Only use the product on unbroken skin. Avoid applying it immediately after shaving, waxing or any procedure that has left the skin irritated.

Beginner-Friendly Introduction

Although the official directions allow once-daily application, people who are new to high-strength Vitamin C can begin two or three evenings per week. Increase the frequency gradually only when the skin remains comfortable.

If the formula feels too strong, mix a very small amount with a compatible, simple moisturizer immediately before application. Do not dilute the entire tube or mix the products in advance, as this may affect stability and hygiene.

Is Tingling Normal?

A mild and temporary tingling sensation can occur because L-Ascorbic Acid is acidic and this formula contains a high concentration. The sensation should remain manageable and should not develop into persistent burning or pain.

If strong burning, swelling, itching or lasting redness occurs, rinse the product off and stop using it. Seek professional guidance if the reaction is severe or does not improve.

Products to Avoid in the Same Routine

If applied in the morning, allow it to absorb before moisturizer and always finish with a broad-spectrum sunscreen. Vitamin C does not replace sunscreen.

  2. Keep the area dry and avoid applying other products over it.
  3. Monitor the skin for redness, burning, itching or swelling.
  4. If no reaction occurs, rinse the area after 24 hours.
  5. Introduce the product gradually to the face.

A successful patch test cannot guarantee that facial skin will not react, but it can help identify obvious sensitivity before full application.

Close the cap firmly after every application and store the tube in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and excessive heat. Avoid allowing water to enter the tube because this is a water-free formulation.

SPF50+

SPF primarily represents protection against UVB rays, which are strongly associated with sunburn. SPF50+ indicates a high level of UVB protection when the sunscreen is applied evenly and in an adequate amount.

PA++++

PA measures protection against UVA rays, which can contribute to tanning, uneven-looking pigmentation and visible signs of photoaging. PA++++ represents the highest rating within the PA classification system.

Dabo Aloe Cica Mild Peeling To Foam is a transforming cleanser designed to provide mild exfoliation and facial cleansing without requiring two separate rinse-off products. It begins with a soft peeling-gel texture and develops into foam when gently massaged over wet skin.

The peeling stage helps loosen flaky dead skin cells and surface buildup. The foaming stage helps wash away the loosened residue, excess oil and water-based impurities. This can leave rough or dull-looking skin feeling cleaner, smoother and more refreshed.

Nexxen describes the product as slightly acidic, with a pH range of 5.5–6.5. This is closer to the naturally acidic environment of the skin than a strongly alkaline cleanser. However, a mild pH does not guarantee compatibility with every sensitive skin type.

The brand also categorizes the product as a functional cosmetic for relieving acne-prone skin. This refers to cleansing and cosmetic care for acne-prone skin; the product is not a medicine or a treatment for severe, cystic or infected acne.

Soft Peeling Stage

After the product is applied to a wet face, gentle circular massage helps loosen surface debris and accumulated dead skin. Cellulose contributes to the characteristic rolling or pilling effect associated with peeling gels.

The residue produced during massage is not entirely dead skin. It can include cellulose from the formula together with oil, product residue and loosened surface cells.

Bubble-Change Cleansing Stage

As Dabo Aloe Cica Mild Peeling To Foam is massaged with water, its peeling-gel texture changes into cleansing foam. The foam helps distribute the cleanser and rinse away impurities from the face.

This is a rinse-off facial cleanser rather than a leave-on acid peel. It should not be left on the skin for an extended period or used as an overnight exfoliating treatment.

The tube adds that the formula’s active charcoal helps cleanse fine dust particles and other impurities from deep inside the pores. Supporting this are Bentonite, Kaolin and Pumice further down the ingredient list, while Glycerin, Beta-Glucan, Argan Oil and Olive Oil provide moisturizing and conditioning care.

0.7% Charcoal Care

Charcoal Powder – 7,000 ppm

Charcoal Powder is declared at 7,000 ppm, equivalent to approximately 0.7%, and listed thirteenth. It is the formula’s most substantial special ingredient and the one that gives the cleanser its black colour.

Activated charcoal is used in cleansing products for its adsorptive properties. It helps attract excess sebum, surface impurities and dirt so they can be washed away during cleansing.

The tube specifically states that the active charcoal helps cleanse out fine dust particles and other skin impurities from deep inside the pores.

Charcoal does not permanently shrink pores, but removing excess oil and buildup can help pores appear cleaner and less noticeable.

French Mud & Clay Care

BARULAB’s own description credits French mud with drawing impurities out from inside the pores, leaving the skin feeling smoother and more even. This is the basis of the product’s pack-style care.

Bentonite & Kaolin

Bentonite and Kaolin are absorbent mineral clays commonly used in pore- and sebum-focused skincare, and they help bind excess oil and impurities on the skin surface.

Both are declared in the second half of the ingredient list, at positions twenty-six and twenty-seven of forty, so they work as supporting clay components within a formula whose cleansing power comes mainly from its foaming base and whose adsorptive character comes mainly from charcoal.

Pumice

Pumice is a naturally derived exfoliating material, declared twenty-ninth, included to provide light physical surface-smoothing care.

It helps loosen dead skin cells and rough surface buildup during cleansing. Because it is a physical exfoliant, the cleanser should be massaged gently rather than scrubbed over the face.

Citric Acid

Cleansing System

Barulab Black Clay Cleansing Foam creates a rich, dense foam through a classic saponified base supported by milder surfactants.

Nature Skin Jeju Green Tea CICA Hydrating Facial Foam stands out as a versatile and effective cleanser in the crowded skincare market. What to Realistically Expect

Brightening care rewards patience more than intensity, so it helps to know what this serum is and is not.

The clinical data above shows measurable change in two weeks — but small change. Visible improvement in dark spots and post-blemish marks generally builds over two to three months of consistent daily use.

This is a cosmetic product, not a medical one. It is not a treatment for melasma or any other pigmentation disorder, and deeper or hormonal pigmentation needs a dermatologist rather than a serum.

Sunscreen decides the outcome. UV exposure creates new pigment faster than any brightening serum can fade the old, so daily sun protection is not an optional extra alongside this product — it is what makes the serum’s work visible.

Product Overview

COSRX Clear Fit Master Patch is a thin and discreet hydrocolloid spot patch created for targeted care of active breakouts. It helps absorb fluid and impurities from the blemish while covering the affected area to reduce exposure to external contaminants and unnecessary touching.

The patch is particularly designed for daytime wear. Its transparent appearance, matte surface and gradient edge help it blend more naturally with the surrounding skin compared with thicker conventional patches.

Because it adheres directly over the blemish, the patch allows users to care for individual spots without applying a treatment product across the entire face.

Korean Quasi-Drug Classification

In Korea, COSRX Clear Fit Master Patch is not registered as a cosmetic. It is registered as a 의약외품 (quasi-drug), the regulatory category Korea uses for hydrocolloid wound-care dressings and similar products that sit between cosmetics and medicines.

The quasi-drug mark is printed on the pouch, and the patch carries the registered item name Somadermspot-S. That name is the product’s registration under the quasi-drug system — it is the official item name on the packaging, not a brand name for a special hydrocolloid technology.

Practically, the classification means the patch is approved and regulated for its stated function of covering and absorbing exudate from a wound or blemish. It does not mean the patch contains medicine, and it does not make this a treatment for acne as a condition.

Hydrocolloid Technology

Hydrocolloid is the main functional material in COSRX Clear Fit Master Patch. It absorbs fluid and exudate released from a blemish while keeping the covered area protected.

The principle comes from wound care. A hydrocolloid dressing draws fluid out of the affected area and holds it in a gel, while keeping the surface underneath moist rather than letting it dry into a scab. For a breakout, that means the spot is kept covered and the fluid that would otherwise sit on the skin is pulled into the patch.

As the patch absorbs moisture and impurities, the hydrocolloid area turns white and swells slightly. That is the signal that the patch has done its job and should be replaced with a fresh one.

The hydrocolloid cover also removes the temptation to repeatedly touch the breakout, which supports a cleaner and more controlled approach to spot care.

Spot Protection

One of the main functions of COSRX Clear Fit Master Patch is to act as a physical protective barrier over a breakout.

Covering the spot can help limit exposure to hands, external impurities and friction from everyday activities. This can be particularly useful for people who tend to touch or pick at active blemishes.

The patch should be applied directly to clean and completely dry skin so that it can adhere properly and maintain close contact with the affected area. Any leftover moisture, oil or skincare product underneath will stop it sticking.

Patch Materials

Because this is a dressing rather than a cosmetic, it has a material composition rather than a skincare ingredient list. The declared materials are:

  • Hydrocolloid — the absorbent layer that draws in exudate and holds it as a gel
  • Cellulose Gum — part of the hydrocolloid structure, contributing its moisture-absorbing capacity
  • Polyurethane Film — the thin, flexible outer layer that forms the protective cover
  • Polyisobutylene — an adhesive component
  • Styrene Isoprene Styrene Block Copolymer — a flexible adhesive polymer that lets the patch move with the skin
  • Petroleum Resin — a tackifier that strengthens adhesion
  • Liquid Paraffin — softens the adhesive so the patch conforms to the skin surface
  • Tetrakis[methylene(3,5-di-tert-butyl-4-hydroxyhydrocinnamate)]methane — an antioxidant stabiliser that keeps the adhesive from degrading

There is no fragrance, no Salicylic Acid and no Tea Tree Oil in this patch. Everything here is the dressing itself; the patch works by physical absorption and coverage, not by delivering an active ingredient into the skin.

Patch Design & Finish

COSRX Clear Fit Master Patch has an ultra-thin, matte and gradient design. The thinner edge helps the patch transition more naturally into the surrounding skin, making it less visually obvious during daytime wear.

The matte finish helps reduce shine, while the near-transparent appearance makes it suitable for users who prefer a more discreet acne patch than a thick, obviously visible one.

COSRX also recommends the patch for use underneath makeup, where its thin profile and gradient edge help it disappear further once foundation or concealer is applied over it.

The trade-off of the thinner construction is capacity: a thin patch holds less fluid than a thick overnight patch, so on a heavily weeping spot it will need replacing sooner.

162,000 A-Shot™ Technology

AESTURA Atobarrier 365 Hydro Essence is a moisture-focused facial essence created for skin that feels dry, tight, sensitive or dehydrated.

The product focuses on two complementary forms of moisture care: providing water-binding moisturizing factors and supporting the skin barrier structure that helps retain that moisture.

AESTURA combines its BMF™ moisture-nutrient complex with patented DermaON® technology to support hydration and barrier care without relying on an extremely rich or heavy texture.

The essence is particularly relevant for people whose skin feels tight beneath the surface but who find thick moisturizers uncomfortable, including combination skin that experiences both oiliness and dehydration.

BMF™ 30 Moisture Nutrients

AESTURA Atobarrier 365 Hydro Essence features the brand’s proprietary BMF™ or Barrier Moisture Factors.

AESTURA describes BMF™ as a moisture-supporting complex inspired by the composition of the skin’s own Natural Moisturizing Factors, or NMF.

DermaON® is AESTURA’s patented skin-barrier technology used throughout the ATOBARRIER line.

AESTURA describes DermaON® as a skin-lipid-like structure designed to mimic the layered organization of intercellular lipids associated with a healthy skin barrier.

The formula combines lipid-related components such as pseudo-ceramide-type material, cholesterol and fatty-acid-related ingredients within AESTURA’s barrier-focused technology.

This approach is designed to provide comfortable moisturization while supporting the function of a weakened or moisture-depleted skin barrier.

Understanding the Need for a Dark Spot Corrector

Dark spots, often referred to as hyperpigmentation, can result from various factors such as sun exposure, hormonal changes, and aging. The AXIS-Y Dark Spot Correcting Glow Toner was designed with these concerns in mind, aiming to provide a targeted approach to minimize dark spots while promoting overall skin health.

Key Features

  1. Targeted Treatment: The primary function of this toner is to reduce the visibility of dark spots. Its formulation is specifically designed to address uneven skin tone, making it an essential addition to any routine focused on brightening and correcting.

The Science Behind the Ingredients

  • Licorice Root Extract: Renowned for its soothing properties, licorice root extract helps calm irritation while contributing to a brighter complexion. It also assists in reducing redness, making it a well-rounded ingredient for sensitive skin types.

  • Hyaluronic Acid: Known for its incredible hydrating properties, hyaluronic acid helps retain moisture in the skin. This ensures that while you’re treating dark spots, your skin remains plump and hydrated, preventing dryness or irritation.

Application and Routine Integration

Incorporating the AXIS-Y Dark Spot Correcting Glow Toner into your skincare routine is simple. After cleansing your face, apply the toner using a cotton pad or your fingertips, gently patting it into your skin. For best results, follow up with a serum and moisturizer tailored to your skin’s needs.

AXIS-Y is committed to sustainability and ethical practices. Their products are cruelty-free and focus on eco-friendly formulations. This dedication to responsible beauty resonates with consumers who prioritize not just their skin health but also the health of the planet.

The AXIS-Y Dark Spot Correcting Glow Toner is more than just a toner; it’s a powerful ally in the pursuit of clear, radiant skin. The formula combines 0.5% Salicylic Acid and 0.2% Tea Tree Leaf Oil with Centella-derived ingredients, Calamine and a multi-acid blend to help remove excess sebum, daily impurities and accumulated dead skin while supporting a cleaner and smoother-looking complexion.

Salicylic Acid at 5,000 ppm (0.5%) is the formula’s primary exfoliating ingredient, supported by Capryloyl Salicylic Acid (LHA) at 100 ppm, Gluconolactone (PHA) at 10 ppm and Citric Acid (AHA) at 10 ppm. This gives the cleanser the AHA, BHA, PHA and LHA combination shown on the pack, with the BHA doing the substantive work.

For troubled-skin care the cleanser contains Tea Tree Leaf Oil at 2,000 ppm (0.2%) alongside Tea Tree Leaf Water, Centella Asiatica Extract, Madecassoside, Asiaticoside, Madecassic Acid and Asiatic Acid. Calamine, Dipotassium Glycyrrhizate and Chamomile Extract provide additional soothing and skin-conditioning support.

Despite its deep-cleansing focus, the formula includes Glycerin as its second ingredient and eight forms of Hyaluronic Acid to help reduce an excessively dry post-cleansing feel.

  • Key Benefits

Product Overview

Dabo T-Tree Cica Acne Cleansing Foam is a rich foaming cleanser from DABO’s T-Tree Cica line, formulated for skin affected by excess sebum, clogged-looking pores, rough texture and recurring blemish concerns.

The product packaging highlights deep cleansing and gentle exfoliation with AHA, BHA, PHA and LHA, and identifies the cleanser as being for acne-prone and oily skin. Rather than functioning only as a basic cleanser, it combines cleansing surfactants with exfoliating and soothing ingredients to provide pore-, sebum- and texture-focused care during the cleansing step.

The formula also includes Tea Tree, Centella-derived ingredients, Calamine and multiple forms of Hyaluronic Acid, helping balance its deep-cleansing action with soothing and moisture-supporting care.

Key Benefits

  • Helps remove excess sebum, sweat and everyday impurities.
  • Provides deep cleansing for oily and congestion-prone skin.
  • Contains 0.5% Salicylic Acid for BHA-based exfoliating care.
  • Contains AHA, BHA, PHA and LHA ingredients.
  • Helps remove accumulated dead skin from the skin surface.
  • Supports cleaner-looking and less congested pores.
  • Helps improve the feel of rough and uneven skin texture.
  • Tea Tree Leaf Oil at 0.2% provides troubled-skin conditioning care.
  • Calamine and Chamomile help maintain a calm and comfortable skin feel.
  • Glycerin and Hyaluronic Acid provide moisture support during cleansing.
  • Creates a rich cleansing foam for thorough facial cleansing.

0.5% Salicylic Acid Care

Salicylic Acid – 5,000 ppm (0.5%)

Salicylic Acid is declared at 5,000 ppm, equivalent to 0.5%, and listed fifteenth. It is by a wide margin the most substantial targeted ingredient in the formula.

Salicylic Acid is a Beta Hydroxy Acid (BHA) that is oil-soluble, allowing it to provide exfoliating support particularly suited to oily and congestion-prone skin.

In a rinse-off cleanser, Salicylic Acid helps loosen accumulated dead skin and excess surface sebum while supporting smoother-looking skin and cleaner-looking pores. Because the product is rinsed away rather than left on the skin, its effect is gentler than that of a leave-on BHA treatment.

This cleanser should be considered a cosmetic cleansing product rather than a medical treatment for persistent or severe acne.

AHA, BHA, PHA & LHA Complex

The product packaging highlights AHA, BHA, PHA and LHA, and all four are present in the ingredient list at the following declared amounts.

BHA – Salicylic Acid, 0.5%

Salicylic Acid at 5,000 ppm provides the primary exfoliating and sebum-focused action in the formula.

LHA – Capryloyl Salicylic Acid, 0.01%

Capryloyl Salicylic Acid is declared at 100 ppm. Commonly known as LHA, it is a lipophilic derivative of Salicylic Acid that provides additional gentle surface exfoliation.

PHA – Gluconolactone, 0.001%

Gluconolactone is declared at 10 ppm. It is a Polyhydroxy Acid (PHA), included here in a small supporting amount.

AHA – Citric Acid, 0.001%

Citric Acid is declared at 10 ppm and belongs to the Alpha Hydroxy Acid (AHA) family. At this level it mainly serves a supporting and formulation role.

Put together, the exfoliating character of this cleanser comes almost entirely from its 0.5% Salicylic Acid. The LHA, PHA and AHA are present at a fraction of that level, so the product behaves as a BHA cleanser with supporting acids rather than as a high-strength multi-acid peel.

Tea Tree & Cica Care

Tea Tree Leaf Oil – 2,000 ppm (0.2%)

Melaleuca Alternifolia (Tea Tree) Leaf Oil is declared at 2,000 ppm, equivalent to 0.2%, and listed eighteenth. This is a meaningful amount for a cleanser and the main Tea Tree input in the formula.

Tea Tree Oil is widely used in skincare developed for oily and blemish-prone skin and provides refreshing and skin-conditioning support.

Tea Tree Leaf Water – 94,000 ppb (0.0094%)

The formula also contains Tea Tree Leaf Water, declared in parts per billion. At 94,000 ppb this works out to roughly 0.0094%, so it is a small supporting addition rather than a second major Tea Tree source.

Centella Asiatica Extract – 10,000 ppb (0.001%)

Centella Asiatica Extract, commonly known as Cica, is declared at 10,000 ppb, which is 0.001%. It contributes to the Cica concept of the T-Tree Cica line as a small supporting botanical, while the cleansing and exfoliating work is done by the surfactant system and Salicylic Acid.

Madecassoside, Asiaticoside, Madecassic Acid & Asiatic Acid

The formula additionally declares four well-known Centella-derived compounds: Madecassoside at 300 ppb, Asiaticoside at 200 ppb, Madecassic Acid at 20 ppb and Asiatic Acid at 20 ppb.

These are the four actives the Centella plant is best known for, and their presence is openly declared on the ingredient list. They are included at parts-per-billion levels, so they round out the formula’s Cica identity rather than functioning as concentrated treatment ingredients.

Multi Hyaluronic Acid Hydration

Dabo T-Tree Cica Acne Cleansing Foam contains eight forms of Hyaluronic Acid, all declared in the lower part of the ingredient list, to provide moisture-binding support during cleansing.

These are Sodium Hyaluronate, Hyaluronic Acid, Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid, Hydroxypropyltrimonium Hyaluronate, Hydrolyzed Sodium Hyaluronate, Potassium Hyaluronate, Sodium Hyaluronate Crosspolymer and Sodium Acetylated Hyaluronate, which differ in molecular size and in how they bind water at the skin surface.

Because this is a rinse-off cleanser, these Hyaluronic Acid forms help the skin feel less stripped immediately after washing rather than delivering the prolonged moisturizing effect expected from a leave-on serum or moisturizer. The formula’s most substantial humectant is Glycerin, which is the second ingredient.

Glycerin is the second ingredient in the formula and provides the main humectant support, helping reduce an excessively stripped feeling after cleansing.

The formula uses a combination of fatty acids, an alkali and supporting surfactants to create its rich foaming texture.

Palmitic, Stearic, Lauric & Myristic Acids with Potassium Hydroxide

Palmitic Acid, Stearic Acid, Lauric Acid and Myristic Acid occupy positions three to six and react with Potassium Hydroxide to form the cleanser’s classic saponified foaming base. This is what gives the product its dense, creamy, high-volume lather.

Glycerin & Butylene Glycol

Butylene Glycol is second and Glycerin third. Together they form the humectant base that draws and holds water in the upper layers of the skin.

Milk Protein Extract is declared at 175 ppm (0.0175%). Milk proteins are used in skincare as surface-conditioning ingredients. At this level it is a declared trace amount rather than the ingredient driving results.

It is coated with Aluminum Hydroxide and Triethoxycaprylylsilane, the standard treatment that helps pigment disperse evenly in a cream.

Product Overview

Essance Pearl Whitening Toner is a Korean facial toner created for skincare routines focused on hydration, brightness and smoother-looking skin. It refreshes the complexion after cleansing while helping remove residual impurities and preparing the skin for the next skincare steps.

The formula pairs Niacinamide with a layered humectant system and the skin-conditioning ingredients Serine and Allantoin. This gives brightening and moisturizing support without turning the toner into a heavy treatment product.

Its watery texture spreads easily and absorbs quickly, making it convenient for layering underneath essence, serum and moisturizer. The toner can be applied with clean hands or a cotton pad depending on personal preference.

A word on the name: “”Whitening”” here is a product name, not a description of what the toner does to your skin colour. This is a cosmetic toner that works on the appearance of dullness and uneven tone. It does not bleach the skin and will not change your natural skin colour.

About the Alcohol Content

Alcohol Denat. is the third ingredient in this toner, placing it high in the formula. We mention it up front because it genuinely changes who this product suits.

What alcohol does in a toner is not all negative. It gives the quick-drying, weightless, fresh-on-the-skin feel that many people specifically like in a toner, it helps other ingredients spread and sink in fast, and it keeps the formula from feeling tacky in humid weather. For oily and combination skin, that lightness is often exactly the point.

The trade-off is that alcohol at this level can feel drying or stinging on skin that is already dry, dehydrated, sensitive or compromised, and it can sting on freshly exfoliated or broken skin.

So judge this toner on what it is: a light, fresh, fast-absorbing toner with good brightening and humectant support, best suited to normal, combination and oily skin. If your skin is dry or reactive, a toner without alcohol high in the list will likely feel better.

No percentage is declared on the packaging, so treat it as a supporting level rather than a high-dose Niacinamide treatment. With consistent use as part of a balanced routine, it helps improve the appearance of dullness and uneven tone.

The Humectant System

This is the real strength of the formula, and it is built in layers rather than resting on one ingredient:

  • Glycerin (second ingredient) — the workhorse humectant, drawing water into the upper layers of skin
  • Betaine — a gentle, naturally derived humectant that also helps soften the feel of other ingredients
  • Polyglutamic Acid — a fermentation-derived humectant that binds several times more water than hyaluronic acid
  • Sodium Hyaluronate — the salt form of Hyaluronic Acid, widely used for its water-holding capacity
  • Beta-Glucan — a well-regarded soothing and moisture-binding ingredient
  • Dipropylene Glycol, Methylpropanediol, Glycereth-26 and Propylene Glycol — supporting humectants and solvents

Together these counterbalance the drying tendency of the alcohol and are the reason the skin still feels comfortable after the toner dries down.

Panthenol

Panthenol, or Pro-Vitamin B5, sits eleventh on the label, which is reasonably high for a toner. It supports moisture retention and skin comfort, and is a long-standing ingredient for keeping skin calm.

Serine

Serine is an amino acid and part of the skin’s own natural moisturizing factor. It helps keep the skin feeling hydrated, soft and comfortable after cleansing.

Allantoin

Allantoin is a skin-conditioning ingredient known for supporting a calm and comfortable skin feel. It complements the moisturizing ingredients and helps make the toner suitable for everyday use.

Tocopherol

Tocopherol, a form of Vitamin E, provides antioxidant support within the formula.

Pearl Powder

Pearl Powder is the ingredient the Essance Pearl line is named after, and it is genuinely in the formula. No percentage is declared on the packaging.

Where it sits is worth knowing. Pearl Powder is twenty-eighth of the thirty-three ingredients, placing it just above the fragrance components near the end of the list. It is a real part of the declaration, but at that position it is not what makes the toner work. The brightening comes from Niacinamide and the comfortable finish from the humectant system described above.

Phenyl Trimethicone

Phenyl Trimethicone is a lightweight silicone that gives the toner a touch of slip, helping it spread evenly across the face rather than running off.

Texture, Finish & Fragrance

Essance Pearl Whitening Toner has a lightweight, watery and fast-absorbing texture. It spreads easily across the skin and provides hydration without the rich or occlusive feel of a moisturizer. The alcohol content is a large part of why it flashes off so quickly and leaves no residue.

products.name: Nature Republic Good Skin Niacinamide Ampoule 30 ml
products.description:
What is Niacinamide?

Niacinamide, also known as Vitamin B3, is one of the most beloved and scientifically proven skincare ingredients for its wide range of skin benefits. It is known to strengthen the skin’s barrier, improve elasticity, and provide anti-inflammatory properties. One of its most sought-after benefits is its ability to brighten the skin by inhibiting melanin production, which helps reduce the appearance of dark spots and hyperpigmentation. Niacinamide also helps in balancing oil production, making it ideal for those with oily or acne-prone skin. Moreover, it can also improve the skin’s texture, reduce the visibility of pores, and smooth out rough patches.

For those who struggle with skin discoloration or uneven skin tone, niacinamide is a powerhouse ingredient that provides visible results over time. When used consistently, niacinamide can help lighten dark spots caused by sun exposure, acne scars, and other types of pigmentation. This makes the Nature Republic Good Skin Niacinamide Ampoule an excellent choice for individuals looking to even out their skin tone while achieving a brighter, more youthful-looking complexion.

Key Benefits of the Nature Republic Good Skin Niacinamide Ampoule

  1. Brightening and Even Skin Tone: The primary benefit of the Nature Republic Good Skin Niacinamide Ampoule is its ability to brighten and even out skin tone. Niacinamide’s inhibitory effect on melanin production helps lighten dark spots and pigmentation, promoting a more uniform complexion. Whether you’re dealing with post-acne scars, sun spots, or general skin dullness, this ampoule helps to restore a fresh, luminous look to your skin.
  2. Hydration and Skin Barrier Support: Niacinamide not only addresses pigmentation issues but also works to strengthen the skin barrier. A healthy skin barrier is crucial for keeping the skin hydrated, protected from environmental stressors, and balanced. By improving the skin’s ability to retain moisture, this ampoule helps maintain optimal hydration levels, ensuring that the skin feels soft, plump, and nourished.
  3. Anti-Aging Benefits: Another remarkable feature of the Nature Republic Good Skin Niacinamide Ampoule is its anti-aging properties. Niacinamide has been shown to reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles by improving the elasticity of the skin. Over time, regular use of this ampoule can contribute to a firmer, more youthful appearance by increasing the skin’s ability to retain moisture and boosting collagen production.
  4. Soothing and Anti-Inflammatory: Niacinamide is known for its anti-inflammatory properties, which makes it particularly beneficial for sensitive skin types. It helps to calm irritated skin, reducing redness and inflammation. This is especially helpful for individuals with acne-prone skin, as niacinamide can reduce the appearance of active breakouts and prevent future flare-ups by regulating oil production. Additionally, it helps with skin conditions like rosacea or eczema, making the Nature Republic Good Skin Niacinamide Ampoule suitable for a broad range of skin types.
  5. Lightweight and Non-Greasy Formula: The Nature Republic Good Skin Niacinamide Ampoule is designed to be lightweight and non-greasy, making it suitable for all skin types, including oily and combination skin. It absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving a heavy or sticky residue, allowing you to layer it with other skincare products such as moisturizers and sunscreens without feeling overwhelmed by product buildup.
  6. Suitable for All Skin Types: Whether you have dry, oily, sensitive, or combination skin, this ampoule can be incorporated into your skincare routine. Its gentle formulation is suitable for most skin types and can be used by individuals with sensitive or acne-prone skin. It is free from harsh chemicals, fragrances, and artificial colors, which makes it an ideal choice for those with sensitive skin or those who prefer minimalist skincare products.

How to Use the Nature Republic Good Skin Niacinamide Ampoule

Incorporating this ampoule into your skincare routine is simple and effective. To start, cleanse your face with a gentle cleanser to remove dirt, oil, and impurities. Follow up with a toner to balance your skin’s pH and prep it for the next steps in your routine. After toning, apply a few drops of the Nature Republic Good Skin Niacinamide Ampoule to your fingertips and gently massage it into your skin. Focus on areas where you have pigmentation concerns or uneven texture. Be sure to allow the ampoule to fully absorb into your skin before applying your moisturizer and sunscreen.

For best results, it is recommended to use the ampoule both morning and night. However, if you have sensitive skin or are new to niacinamide, it may be beneficial to start with once a day and gradually increase usage to avoid irritation. Additionally, always remember to wear sunscreen during the day, as niacinamide can make your skin more sensitive to UV rays.

Why Choose Nature Republic Good Skin Niacinamide Ampoule?

Nature Republic has built a reputation for offering high-quality, effective skincare products derived from natural ingredients. Their Good Skin Niacinamide Ampoule is no exception. By harnessing the power of niacinamide, Nature Republic provides a solution that not only brightens the skin but also supports overall skin health. The ampoule is free from harmful additives, making it a safe and effective choice for those who are cautious about the ingredients in their skincare products.

Furthermore, the ampoule’s formulation is designed to deliver visible results in a relatively short period of time. With regular use, users can expect to see improvements in skin texture, a reduction in dark spots, and a more radiant complexion. This makes it a great investment for anyone looking to improve their skincare routine and achieve a clearer, brighter, and smoother complexion.

Final Thoughts

Nature Republic Good Skin Niacinamide Ampoule is an excellent choice for anyone looking to address common skin concerns such as uneven skin tone, dullness, and hyperpigmentation. With its powerful combination of niacinamide and other beneficial ingredients, this ampoule helps to brighten, hydrate, and improve skin texture. Its gentle yet effective formula makes it suitable for all skin types, including sensitive and acne-prone skin. Whether you’re looking to target specific skin issues or simply improve the overall health of your skin, this ampoule is a great addition to any skincare regimen.

products.name: Missha Vita C Plus Daily Toning Sheet Mask 30 pcs 350 ml
products.description:
The Missha Vita C Plus Daily Toning Sheet Mask is an innovative skincare product designed to provide a quick and effective solution for achieving brighter, smoother, and more youthful-looking skin. As part of Missha’s Vita C Plus line, this sheet mask leverages the power of Vitamin C, a potent antioxidant known for its skin-brightening properties, alongside other skin-loving ingredients to target dullness, uneven skin tone, and signs of aging. With its unique formula and refreshing application, the mask is ideal for anyone seeking to enhance their skincare routine with an easy, convenient, and highly effective treatment.

Key Ingredients and Benefits

The Missha Vita C Plus Daily Toning Sheet Mask is packed with a variety of active ingredients that work synergistically to improve the health and appearance of your skin. The star ingredient is Vitamin C, specifically in the form of Ascorbic Acid, which is known for its powerful ability to brighten the complexion and reduce the appearance of hyperpigmentation. Vitamin C also helps to combat the effects of free radicals, which are responsible for premature skin aging and skin damage caused by environmental stressors such as pollution and UV exposure. This makes it an essential addition to a skincare routine for anyone looking to combat dark spots, dullness, and uneven skin tone.

In addition to Vitamin C, the mask contains Niacinamide, a form of Vitamin B3 that has become a popular ingredient in skincare due to its ability to brighten the skin, reduce redness, and improve skin texture. Niacinamide is also known for its soothing properties, helping to calm inflammation and redness, which is especially beneficial for those with sensitive or irritated skin. These two ingredients together help create a powerful brightening effect while maintaining the skin’s overall health.

The mask also features Hyaluronic Acid, a well-known ingredient for hydration. Hyaluronic acid is a humectant that attracts moisture to the skin, keeping it plump, smooth, and hydrated. This ensures that the skin not only appears radiant but also feels nourished and moisturized, making it an excellent choice for individuals with dry or dehydrated skin.

To further enhance the skin’s health, the sheet mask is enriched with adenosine, which helps reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles by promoting skin elasticity. It supports the skin’s natural rejuvenation process, making the mask an excellent option for those looking to maintain a youthful and glowing complexion.

How It Works

The Missha Vita C Plus Daily Toning Sheet Mask comes in a single-use sheet mask form, designed for easy application. The mask itself is made of a soft, flexible material that fits comfortably on the face, adhering well to the contours of the skin for maximum absorption of the ingredients. This allows the active ingredients to penetrate deeply into the skin, delivering hydration, brightening effects, and nourishment right where it’s needed.

Once applied, the sheet mask works to deliver its active ingredients while providing a cooling and calming sensation. The Vitamin C helps to brighten the skin, reducing the appearance of dark spots and uneven pigmentation. Meanwhile, the Niacinamide works to soothe and calm the skin, improving its overall texture. The Hyaluronic Acid works in tandem to keep the skin hydrated, ensuring that the skin remains soft and moisturized long after the mask is removed.

Regular use of the Missha Vita C Plus Daily Toning Sheet Mask helps to improve skin tone, enhance radiance, and provide lasting hydration. It’s particularly effective in brightening the complexion and evening out skin tone, especially for those dealing with dark spots or post-acne marks. Additionally, the mask helps to replenish moisture, making it suitable for those with dry or dehydrated skin.

Ideal for All Skin Types

One of the standout features of the Missha Vita C Plus Daily Toning Sheet Mask is its versatility. It’s designed to be gentle and effective for a wide range of skin types, from sensitive to oily skin. The formula is non-irritating and suitable for daily use, which is especially important for those looking to incorporate brightening and hydrating treatments into their routine without causing excess irritation or sensitivity.

For people with sensitive skin, the inclusion of Niacinamide is especially beneficial. Niacinamide is known for its ability to calm redness and irritation, making it an excellent choice for those with conditions like rosacea or skin prone to inflammation. On the other hand, for oily or acne-prone skin, the mask’s brightening and soothing properties help manage the appearance of scars or post-acne spots while preventing excess oil production.

Easy-to-Use Skincare Solution

The sheet mask format of the Missha Vita C Plus Daily Toning Sheet Mask makes it incredibly easy to incorporate into any skincare routine. Unlike traditional serums or creams that may require careful application, the sheet mask provides a no-mess, hassle-free option for those looking for quick results. Simply cleanse and tone the skin, apply the mask, and relax for 10-20 minutes while the ingredients work their magic. After removing the mask, you can massage any remaining essence into the skin for added hydration and nourishment.

Because it’s a single-use product, the sheet mask is perfect for busy individuals or those who want an instant skin-refreshing boost. It’s also ideal for travel, as it takes up minimal space and doesn’t require any extra products or tools to apply. For those looking for a weekly or daily treatment to enhance their skincare routine, the Missha Vita C Plus Daily Toning Sheet Mask offers convenience without sacrificing results.

Suitable for Multiple Skincare Goals

Whether you’re aiming to brighten a dull complexion, fade hyperpigmentation, or hydrate dry skin, the Missha Vita C Plus Daily Toning Sheet Mask is a versatile option that can help you achieve a range of skincare goals. Its combination of Vitamin C and Niacinamide makes it particularly effective for those struggling with uneven skin tone or dark spots, while its hydrating and soothing properties make it an excellent choice for anyone in need of a moisture boost.

For those who want to target specific skin concerns like fine lines or signs of aging, the Adenosine in the formula can provide an additional anti-aging benefit. When used consistently, this sheet mask helps to keep the skin looking fresh, youthful, and glowing.

Final Thoughts

The Missha Vita C Plus Daily Toning Sheet Mask is a highly effective, easy-to-use skincare treatment that brightens, hydrates, and revitalizes the skin. Packed with potent ingredients like Vitamin C, Niacinamide, and Hyaluronic Acid, it provides a variety of benefits for all skin types, helping to improve skin tone, texture, and overall radiance. Whether you’re looking to address dullness, pigmentation, or dehydration, this mask offers a convenient and nourishing solution for all your skincare needs. Incorporating it into your daily routine will leave your skin feeling refreshed, glowing, and rejuvenated, making it a must-have for anyone looking to enhance their complexion.
