products.name: Nature Skin Rice Water Bright Facial Foam 102 ml
products.description:
Introduction

Nature Skin Rice Water Bright Facial Foam is a rich daily facial cleanser designed to remove excess oil, dirt, sweat, sunscreen residue, and everyday impurities while helping the skin look fresh and naturally radiant.

The formula combines Rice Extract and Rice Bran Extract with moisturizing ingredients such as Glycerin, Trehalose, and Butylene Glycol. It also contains Green Tea Leaf Extract, Persimmon Leaf Extract, and marine botanical extracts to provide additional antioxidant and skin-conditioning care.

When mixed with water, the cleanser creates a rich foam that spreads comfortably across the face and helps wash away surface buildup. It is a practical cleansing option for anyone looking for a rice-based Korean face wash for a clean, smooth, and refreshed-looking complexion.

Key Ingredients

Rice Extract

Oryza Sativa Rice Extract is one of the key botanical ingredients in Nature Skin Rice Water Bright Facial Foam.

Rice-derived ingredients are commonly used in Korean skincare to support a smoother, brighter, and more refined-looking complexion. In a rinse-off cleanser, Rice Extract provides skin-conditioning care while complementing the product’s cleansing action.

Rice Bran Extract

Rice Bran Extract provides additional skin-conditioning and antioxidant support.

It complements Rice Extract and helps support the appearance of softer, healthier, and more radiant-looking skin.

Glycerin

Glycerin is a well-known humectant that helps attract and hold moisture.

Including Glycerin in a foaming cleanser helps support a softer and more comfortable skin feel after washing.

Trehalose

Trehalose is another moisture-supporting ingredient that helps condition the skin and maintain hydration during the cleansing process.

Green Tea Leaf Extract

Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract, commonly known as Green Tea, provides antioxidant and skin-conditioning benefits.

It helps support a fresh and healthy-looking complexion while complementing the cleanser’s rice-derived ingredients.

Persimmon Leaf Extract

Diospyros Kaki Leaf Extract provides additional botanical antioxidant and conditioning care to the formula.

Seaweed Extracts

The cleanser contains Fucus Vesiculosus Extract and Laminaria Japonica Extract.

These marine botanical extracts help condition and refresh the skin while contributing to the formula’s overall antioxidant-focused skincare support.

Key Benefits

  • Helps remove daily dirt, sweat, and impurities.
  • Helps cleanse away excess surface oil.
  • Supports removal of light sunscreen and everyday residue.
  • Rice Extract helps support a brighter-looking complexion.
  • Rice Bran Extract provides additional skin-conditioning care.
  • Glycerin helps maintain a softer skin feel after cleansing.
  • Trehalose provides moisture-supporting benefits.
  • Green Tea Extract delivers antioxidant care.
  • Seaweed Extracts help refresh and condition the skin.
  • Rich foam helps cleanse the skin effectively.
  • Helps improve the appearance of dull and tired-looking skin.
  • Leaves the complexion feeling fresh, clean, and smooth.
  • Suitable for a simple morning and evening cleansing routine.

How It Works

Nature Skin Rice Water Bright Facial Foam combines a rich foaming cleansing base with moisturizing and botanical skin-conditioning ingredients.

Fatty acids such as Palmitic Acid, Stearic Acid, Myristic Acid, and Lauric Acid contribute to the cleanser’s creamy foaming action. When mixed with water, the formula produces foam that helps loosen excess sebum, dirt, environmental residue, and other impurities from the skin surface.

Rice Extract and Rice Bran Extract complement the cleansing process with skin-conditioning care, while Glycerin, Trehalose, and Butylene Glycol help support moisture and a smoother post-cleansing feel.

Green Tea Leaf Extract and Persimmon Leaf Extract provide antioxidant care. Seaweed-derived Fucus Vesiculosus and Laminaria Japonica extracts add further conditioning support.

Together, these ingredients help provide a thorough daily cleansing experience while supporting a fresh, smooth, and naturally radiant-looking complexion.

Skin Type

Nature Skin Rice Water Bright Facial Foam may be especially suitable for:

  • Normal skin
  • Combination skin
  • Oily skin
  • Dull-looking skin
  • Skin with excess surface oil
  • Skin exposed to daily dust and environmental impurities
  • Skin concerned with a tired or uneven-looking appearance

Because the formula is a rich foaming cleanser and contains fragrance and alcohol, people with very dry, highly sensitive, or fragrance-reactive skin should monitor how their skin responds and adjust cleansing frequency if necessary.

Patch testing is recommended when introducing a new skincare product to particularly reactive skin.

How to Use

Wet your face and hands with lukewarm water.

Take an appropriate amount of Nature Skin Rice Water Bright Facial Foam into your palm.

Add a small amount of water and rub your hands together until a rich foam develops.

Apply the foam gently over the face and massage using light circular motions. Pay additional attention to areas where excess oil and buildup commonly accumulate, such as the forehead, nose, and chin.

Avoid aggressive rubbing and direct contact with the eyes.

Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water until no cleanser remains.

Gently pat the skin dry with a clean towel.

Follow with toner, serum, moisturizer, and sunscreen according to your skincare routine.

It can be used as part of a morning or evening cleansing routine. If you wear heavy makeup or highly water-resistant sunscreen, use an appropriate first cleanser before following with this facial foam.

Why Choose It?

Nature Skin Rice Water Bright Facial Foam combines effective daily cleansing with several ingredients commonly found in brightening and moisture-supporting skincare routines.

Rice Extract and Rice Bran Extract give the cleanser its rice-focused skincare identity, while Green Tea and botanical extracts provide complementary antioxidant and conditioning benefits.

Glycerin, Trehalose, and Butylene Glycol help prevent the formula from focusing only on cleansing by providing additional moisture support.

Its rich foaming texture can be particularly appealing for people who prefer a cleanser that leaves the face feeling thoroughly refreshed after washing.

For anyone looking for an affordable Korean facial cleanser to target daily oil, dirt, dullness, and surface buildup, it can be a convenient first step in a regular skincare routine.

FAQ

What is Nature Skin Rice Water Bright Facial Foam used for?

It is designed to cleanse excess oil, dirt, sweat, and daily impurities while helping the skin feel fresh, smooth, and clean.

Does it contain Rice Extract?

Yes. The ingredient list contains Oryza Sativa Rice Extract as well as Oryza Sativa Rice Bran Extract.

Does it help brighten the skin?

The formula contains rice-derived and antioxidant ingredients that help support a fresher and more radiant-looking complexion. As a rinse-off cleanser, it should be considered part of a broader brightening routine rather than a treatment for pigmentation.

Does it contain Green Tea?

Yes. The formula contains Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract, commonly known as Green Tea Extract.

Does it contain moisturizing ingredients?

Yes. Glycerin, Trehalose, and Butylene Glycol provide moisture-supporting and skin-conditioning benefits.

Can Nature Skin Rice Water Bright Facial Foam be used every day?

It can be incorporated into a daily cleansing routine. Frequency should be adjusted according to your skin type and how your skin feels after washing.

Is it suitable for oily skin?

Its rich foaming cleansing base can be useful for removing excess oil and daily buildup from oily and combination skin.

Can it remove sunscreen?

It can help remove light everyday sunscreen residue. For heavy, waterproof, or highly water-resistant sunscreen, double cleansing with an oil cleanser or cleansing balm first may provide more thorough removal.

🌿 Introduction to Beauty of Joseon Red Bean Water Gel

Beauty of Joseon Red Bean Water Gel is a Korean skincare product designed to provide hydration without the heaviness of traditional creams. Its formulation focuses on balancing the skin’s oil and moisture levels, making it particularly suitable for those with oily or combination skin.

🧪 Key Ingredients and Their Benefits

1. Haenam Red Bean Extract (44%)

Red beans have a long-standing history in Korean skincare, especially in the coastal region of Haenam. The extract is rich in saponins, compounds known for their sebum-absorbing properties. This helps in controlling excess oil production, leading to a matte finish without stripping the skin of essential moisture .

2. Peptide Complex

The gel contains a blend of peptides, including SH-Oligopeptide-1, SH-Oligopeptide-2, and SH-Polypeptide-1. These peptides are known to stimulate collagen production, improving skin elasticity and reducing the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. They also support skin regeneration, promoting a youthful complexion .

3. Allantoin

Allantoin is a compound that soothes and protects the skin. It promotes wound healing and helps to calm irritated skin, making it beneficial for those with sensitive or acne-prone skin .

4. Beta-Glucan

Beta-Glucan is known for its moisturizing and soothing properties. It helps reduce redness and irritation, promoting overall skin health .

5. Sunflower Seed Oil

Rich in fatty acids like linoleic and oleic acid, sunflower seed oil nourishes and softens the skin. It also has anti-inflammatory properties, making it suitable for calming irritated skin .

💧 Texture and Application

The Red Bean Water Gel boasts a lightweight, gel-like texture that absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving a greasy residue. This makes it ideal for layering under sunscreen or makeup. To use, apply a coin-sized amount to cleansed skin and gently pat until fully absorbed. It can be used both in the morning and at night as the final step in your skincare routine .

🌟 Performance and Results

Users have reported several benefits from incorporating the Red Bean Water Gel into their skincare routines:

  • Hydration Without Heaviness: The gel provides moisture without clogging pores or leaving a sticky feeling.
  • Oil Control: Regular use helps in balancing oil production, leading to a matte finish throughout the day.
  • Improved Skin Texture: The combination of peptides and other ingredients promotes smoother and more elastic skin.
  • Soothing Effect: Allantoin and beta-glucan contribute to calming irritated or sensitive skin.

These results make the Red Bean Water Gel a popular choice for those seeking a lightweight moisturizer that addresses multiple skin concerns.

🧴 Packaging and Design

The product comes in a sleek, pink-tinted tube with a flip-top cap, ensuring easy and hygienic dispensing. The minimalist design reflects the brand’s commitment to simplicity and effectiveness.

🌍 Eco-Friendly Considerations

Beauty of Joseon emphasizes sustainability by using recyclable materials for packaging. The formulation is free from artificial colors, alcohol, and fragrances, making it suitable for sensitive skin types. Additionally, the brand avoids animal testing, aligning with ethical skincare practices.

Priced affordably, Beauty of Joseon Red Bean Water Gel offers a cost-effective solution for those seeking the benefits of traditional Korean herbal ingredients without the premium price tag. Its high-quality formulation and performance make it a standout product in the competitive K-beauty market.

Dermatologists often recommend incorporating lightweight, oil-free moisturizers into skincare routines, especially for those with oily or combination skin. products.description:
COSRX The Alpha-Arbutin 2% Discoloration Care Serum:

Introduction

The COSRX The Alpha-Arbutin 2% Discoloration Care Serum is a high-potency serum specifically formulated to address various forms of hyperpigmentation, including post-acne scars, sun spots, and overall skin dullness. This lightweight, non-comedogenic serum combines a high concentration of alpha-arbutin (2%) with tranexamic acid, niacinamide, and N-Acetylglucosamine (NAG) to brighten and even out skin tone. Infused with synergistic ingredients like ferulic acid and glutathione, it enhances skin clarity and radiance. Suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin, this serum offers a multi-target solution for discoloration concerns.

Key Ingredients and Their Benefits

1. Alpha-Arbutin (2%)

Alpha-arbutin is a naturally occurring compound that inhibits melanin production, effectively reducing the appearance of dark spots and hyperpigmentation. At a 2% concentration, it provides a potent yet gentle solution for achieving a more even skin tone.

2. Tranexamic Acid (3%)

Tranexamic acid is known for its ability to reduce melanin synthesis and improve skin discoloration. It effectively targets stubborn pigmentation, including melasma and post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation, leading to a brighter and more uniform complexion.

3. Niacinamide (5%)

Niacinamide, also known as vitamin B3, is a versatile ingredient that offers multiple skin benefits. It helps to reduce the appearance of enlarged pores, even out skin tone, and strengthen the skin’s barrier function. Niacinamide also possesses anti-inflammatory properties, making it suitable for sensitive and acne-prone skin.

4. N-Acetylglucosamine (NAG)

NAG is a derivative of glucose that supports the skin’s natural exfoliation process. It enhances the effectiveness of other brightening agents and contributes to a smoother, more radiant complexion.

5. Ferulic Acid

Ferulic acid is a plant-based antioxidant that helps to neutralize free radicals and protect the skin from environmental damage. It also stabilizes other antioxidants, enhancing their efficacy in brightening and protecting the skin.

6. Glutathione

Glutathione is a powerful antioxidant that helps to reduce oxidative stress and lighten hyperpigmentation. It works synergistically with other ingredients to promote a more even and luminous skin tone.

Formulation and Texture

The serum has a lightweight, non-sticky texture that absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving a greasy residue. It is free from alcohol, fragrances, and essential oils, making it suitable for sensitive skin. The formula is designed to be layered easily with other skincare products, enhancing its versatility in a daily skincare routine.

Packaging

The serum comes in a sleek, minimalist glass bottle with a dropper for precise application. The packaging is both functional and aesthetically pleasing, reflecting the brand’s commitment to quality and simplicity.

Application and Usage

After cleansing and toning, apply a few drops of the serum to the face, focusing on areas with pigmentation or discoloration. Gently massage into the skin until fully absorbed. For intensive care, layer 2-3 times as needed. Follow with a moisturizer to lock in hydration. For optimal results, use the serum consistently as part of your morning and evening skincare routine.

Performance and Effectiveness

Users have reported noticeable improvements in skin tone and texture with consistent use of the serum. Many have observed a reduction in the appearance of dark spots and an overall brighter complexion. The serum is well-tolerated by most skin types, including sensitive skin, and does not cause irritation when used as directed.

products.name: Jigott Natural Aloe Vera Moisture Soothing Gel 300 ml
products.description:
Jigott Natural Aloe Vera Moisture Soothing Gel is a lightweight Korean soothing gel formulated to provide refreshing hydration and skin-conditioning care. The formula combines Glycerin, Green Tea Extract, Camellia Japonica Seed Extract, Honey Extract, Snail Secretion Filtrate and Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Extract to help keep the skin feeling soft, fresh and comfortably moisturized.

One thing to be clear about before you buy: the “100” on the lid is part of the product’s name, not the aloe content. The packaging declares Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Extract at 0.1%, and the back label states this in both Korean and English. This is not a 92%, 95% or 100% aloe gel of the kind commonly sold in Korea.

What the gel actually runs on is a glycerin-based hydrating gel system — Glycerin and Dipropylene Glycol provide the humectant base, with a set of botanical extracts layered on top for skin-conditioning support.

The gel has a light, refreshing texture that spreads easily and suits anyone who prefers hydration without the richer feel of a cream. The packaging also carries four free-from claims, all of which hold up against the ingredient list: no artificial colouring, no benzophenone, no mineral oil and no parabens.

Table of Contents

  • Product Overview
  • How Much Aloe Is In It
  • Key Benefits
  • Selected Ingredient Highlights
  • The Free-From Claims
  • Texture & Fragrance
  • Suitable Skin Types
  • How to Use
  • Skincare Routine
  • Product Details
  • Precautions
  • Full Ingredients
  • Buy in Bangladesh
  • Official Source
  • FAQ

Product Overview

Jigott Natural Aloe Vera Moisture Soothing Gel is a lightweight moisturizing gel designed to deliver quick hydration and a fresh, soothing skin feel. Its water-based gel format spreads easily and absorbs without the heavy, occlusive texture of a rich moisturizer.

Glycerin is the second ingredient and Dipropylene Glycol the third — together they are the real hydrating engine of this product. Carbomer and Hydroxyethylcellulose give the gel its body, and PEG-60 Hydrogenated Castor Oil carries the fragrance.

Layered on top of that base is a set of botanical extracts: Green Tea, Camellia Japonica Seed, Honey, Snail Secretion Filtrate, Aloe Vera, Witch Hazel and Monarda Didyma Leaf. These provide skin-conditioning support and give the gel its character.

It comes in a 300 ml tub, which is generous for a gel of this kind and makes it easy to use freely across larger areas when the skin feels dry or warm.

How Much Aloe Is In It

The jar carries a “MOISTURE 100 SOOTHING GEL” stamp on the lid and aloe leaf imagery across the front, so it is worth stating the facts plainly.

Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Extract is declared at 0.1%, printed on the back label in both Korean and English. In the ingredient list it sits twelfth of nineteen ingredients.

Four other botanicals are above it:

  • Camellia Sinensis (Green Tea) Leaf Extract — eighth
  • Camellia Japonica Seed Extract — ninth
  • Honey Extract — tenth
  • Snail Secretion Filtrate — eleventh

So there is more green tea, more camellia, more honey and more snail filtrate in this gel than aloe. The “100” on the lid refers to the product’s name, not to an aloe percentage. If you are specifically looking for a high-percentage aloe gel — the 92%, 95% or 99% kind widely sold in Korea — this is not that product.

What it is instead is a well-priced, lightweight glycerin hydrating gel with a mixed botanical blend, which is a perfectly reasonable thing to buy. The cooling, refreshing feel you get from it comes from the gel base evaporating water off the skin, not from the aloe.

Key Benefits

  • Provides lightweight, refreshing hydration.
  • Glycerin as the second ingredient gives the main moisture support.
  • Light gel texture spreads easily and layers well.
  • Green Tea Extract provides antioxidant and skin-conditioning support.
  • Honey Extract and Camellia Japonica Seed Extract add conditioning care.
  • Snail Secretion Filtrate provides additional moisturizing support.
  • Witch Hazel extracts add botanical conditioning.
  • Free from artificial colouring, benzophenone, mineral oil and parabens — all four verified against the ingredient list.
  • Generous 300 ml tub, suitable for regular and liberal use.
  • Suits anyone who prefers lighter hydration over a rich cream.

Selected Ingredient Highlights

Glycerin

Glycerin is the second ingredient and the main humectant in the formula. It attracts and holds water in the upper layers of the skin, and it is what makes this gel hydrate at all. Working alongside Dipropylene Glycol, it forms the base that everything else sits in.

Green Tea Extract

Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract is the highest-placed botanical in the formula at eighth. Green tea is well established in skincare for antioxidant and skin-conditioning support, and it suits the fresh, light character of a gel.

Camellia Japonica Seed Extract

Camellia Japonica Seed Extract comes from the same plant family that produces camellia oil, long used in Korean and Japanese skincare for conditioning and softness.

Honey Extract

Honey Extract is a natural humectant with conditioning properties, complementing the glycerin base.

Snail Secretion Filtrate

Snail Secretion Filtrate sits eleventh, above the aloe. It is widely used in Korean skincare for moisturizing and skin-conditioning support, carrying naturally occurring glycoproteins and hyaluronic acid.

Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Extract — 0.1%

Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Extract is declared at 0.1% and sits twelfth. Aloe is a genuine soothing and moisturizing botanical, and it is genuinely in this formula — just at a declared trace level rather than as the main component.

Witch Hazel Extracts

The formula contains both Hamamelis Virginiana (Witch Hazel) Extract and Hamamelis Virginiana (Witch Hazel) Bark/Twig Extract. Witch hazel is a traditional astringent botanical that suits a light, fresh gel.

Monarda Didyma Leaf Extract

Monarda Didyma Leaf Extract, from the bee balm plant, is included as a further botanical conditioning ingredient.

The Gel System

Carbomer and Hydroxyethylcellulose are the thickeners that turn the water-and-glycerin base into a gel, with Triethanolamine adjusting the pH so the carbomer sets properly. PEG-60 Hydrogenated Castor Oil dissolves the fragrance into the water phase.

The Free-From Claims

The lid carries four free-from claims, and all four hold up when checked against the full ingredient list:

  • Artificial colouring free — there are no CI colourants in the formula
  • Benzophenone free — no benzophenone of any kind
  • Mineral oil free — no mineral oil or paraffinum liquidum
  • Paraben free — no parabens

For transparency, the preservatives actually used are Phenoxyethanol and Chlorphenesin, which are standard, well-established cosmetic preservatives. Every water-based product needs preservation; these are simply not parabens.

Texture & Fragrance

Jigott Natural Aloe Vera Moisture Soothing Gel has a lightweight, cooling gel texture that spreads easily and absorbs without the heaviness of a cream or balm.

That cooling sensation is the water in the gel evaporating off the skin, which is why gels like this feel good in warm weather or when richer moisturizers feel uncomfortable.

It is not fragrance-free. Fragrance is declared as the final ingredient on the label. If you are highly sensitive to fragranced skincare, patch test before using it over larger areas.

Suitable Skin Types

  • Normal skin

Dr. Gilla Hyaluronic Acid Deep Ceramide Collagen Mask Overview

Dr. Gilla Hyaluronic Acid Deep Ceramide Collagen Mask is an essence-soaked facial sheet mask formulated primarily for hydration and moisture-barrier support. Humectants attract and retain water at the skin’s surface, while emollient and lipid-based ingredients help reduce the dry or tight feeling that can occur after cleansing.

The 24 ml packet contains one mask for a single application. It may be used when the complexion feels dehydrated, rough, tight or temporarily dull, including before makeup or as part of an evening skincare routine.

The word “deep” is part of the product name and hydration positioning. It should not be understood as proof that the cosmetic ingredients travel into the deeper living layers of the skin. The practical benefit is improved surface hydration and a temporarily smoother, plumper appearance.

Key Benefits of Dr. Gilla Hyaluronic Acid Mask

  • Provides an intensive boost of surface hydration
  • Helps dry or dehydrated-looking skin feel softer and more comfortable
  • Contains eight identifiable forms of Hyaluronic Acid on the current packet
  • Includes Ceramide NP for moisture-barrier support
  • Contains Hydrolyzed Collagen and Soluble Collagen
  • Helps temporarily smooth the appearance of fine dryness lines
  • Supports a plumper and fresher-looking complexion
  • Includes Glycerin and several moisture-binding glycols
  • Can be used before makeup or during an evening routine
  • Requires approximately 15–20 minutes of application
  • Comes in a convenient single-use 24 ml packet

How the Hydration and Barrier-Care System Works

Multiple Forms of Hyaluronic Acid

The printed ingredient list contains eight identifiable Hyaluronic Acid forms: Sodium Hyaluronate, Sodium Hyaluronate Crosspolymer, Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid, Hyaluronic Acid, Hydroxypropyltrimonium Hyaluronate, Sodium Acetylated Hyaluronate, Hydrolyzed Sodium Hyaluronate and Potassium Hyaluronate.

These related humectants differ in structure and cosmetic behaviour. Together, they help attract and retain moisture at the skin’s surface. Their presence does not guarantee that every form is used at the same percentage, and the individual concentrations are not disclosed on the packet.

Ceramide and Lipid Support

Ceramide NP is a skin-identical lipid commonly used to support the protective moisture barrier. The formula also contains Hydrogenated Lecithin and Phospholipids, which provide additional conditioning and help support the essence’s lipid-delivery system.

Ceramide NP appears in the latter portion of the printed ingredient list, so the product should be described as containing Ceramide NP rather than being presented as a high-percentage ceramide treatment.

Collagen-Based Moisturizing Care

Hydrolyzed Collagen and Soluble Collagen help condition the skin and form a moisture-supporting film on its surface. This can make the complexion feel smoother and temporarily soften the appearance of dehydration lines.

Topically applied collagen does not replace lost structural collagen or permanently lift the skin. Its role in this sheet mask is primarily moisturizing, conditioning and film-forming.

Selected Formula Highlights

Glycerin and Glycereth-26

Glycerin and Glycereth-26 are humectants that help bind water to the skin’s surface. They support the mask’s hydrating feel and can reduce temporary tightness associated with dehydration.

Eight Hyaluronic Acid Forms

The current packet lists eight separately identifiable Hyaluronic Acid forms. This multi-form system provides moisture-binding and surface-conditioning benefits, helping the skin look temporarily plumper and smoother after use.

Ceramide NP, Hydrogenated Lecithin and Phospholipids

These ingredients support conditioning and the maintenance of a comfortable moisture barrier. They are particularly relevant when the skin feels dry, tight or stressed by low humidity and frequent cleansing.

Hydrolyzed Collagen and Soluble Collagen

Both collagen ingredients contribute to the moisturizing and film-forming character of the essence. The animal source is not identified on the packet.

Arginine

Arginine is an amino acid used for skin conditioning and formula adjustment. It supports the overall moisturizing character of the essence but is not presented with a disclosed percentage.

Fragrance

Fragrance is included in the current printed ingredient list. Fragrance-sensitive, allergy-prone or highly reactive skin should consider this before use and perform a patch test where practical.

Alcohol and Colourant Clarification

The printed ingredient list does not show Ethanol, Alcohol Denat. or Isopropyl Alcohol, the common volatile alcohols that may feel drying on some skin. Ingredients such as Dipropylene Glycol, Butylene Glycol, Pentylene Glycol, Caprylyl Glycol and 1,2-Hexanediol are multifunctional glycols and are not equivalent to those volatile drying alcohols.

No added colourant or CI-numbered synthetic dye is identifiable in the ingredient list printed on this packet. Product formulas may change, so the packaging received should always be checked for the latest information.

Understanding the Product Claims

“Deep Hydration”

“Deep” is part of the product name and marketing position. The measurable cosmetic purpose of the mask is to improve moisture at and around the skin’s surface. It should not be interpreted as a medical or anatomical penetration claim.

“All-Day Hydration”

The front packaging describes all-day hydration. This is a manufacturer claim rather than a guaranteed duration for every user. The result can vary according to skin type, climate, cleansing habits and the moisturizer applied afterward.

Fine-Line Care

Hydration can temporarily plump the skin and make fine lines caused or emphasized by dryness appear softer. The mask is not a treatment for permanent wrinkles and does not replace prescription or professional anti-ageing care.

Barrier Strengthening

Ceramide NP, Hydrogenated Lecithin, Phospholipids and humectants can support a more comfortable moisture barrier. This cosmetic support should not be described as healing eczema, dermatitis, wounds or other medical skin conditions.

Texture and Finish

The sheet carries a lightweight, water-based essence containing humectants and conditioning ingredients. After removal, the remaining essence may leave the complexion feeling moist, soft and slightly dewy.

Normal or dry skin may apply moisturizer afterward to help retain the hydration. Oily skin can wait for the essence to settle and use a lighter moisturizer only if required.

If the face feels excessively sticky, the user may have applied too much remaining essence or layered several products too quickly. Pat the essence gently and allow it to absorb before continuing the routine.

Which Skin Types Can Use It?

The mask may be considered for:

  • Normal skin
  • Dry skin
  • Dehydrated-looking skin
  • Combination skin requiring occasional hydration
  • Oily skin experiencing surface dehydration
  • Rough or tight-feeling skin
  • Skin with visible fine dryness lines
  • Dull or tired-looking skin requiring temporary moisture support

Highly sensitive or fragrance-reactive skin should patch-test the essence before placing the full sheet on the face. Do not assume that a hydrating formula will be compatible with every sensitive skin condition.

Acne-prone skin may use the mask if individually compatible, but it is not formulated to treat acne. Stop using it if persistent itching, burning, redness or new irritation develops.

How to Use Dr. Gilla Hyaluronic Acid Deep Ceramide Collagen Mask

  1. Cleanse the face and gently pat away excess water.
  2. Apply toner first if it is part of the regular routine.
  3. Open the packet immediately before use.
  4. Unfold the sheet carefully and place it evenly over the face.
  5. Adjust the openings around the eyes, nose and mouth.
  6. Leave the mask on for approximately 15–20 minutes, following the packet directions.
  7. Remove the sheet before it becomes completely dry.
  8. Gently pat the remaining essence into the face and neck.
  9. Apply moisturizer afterward if additional moisture retention is needed.
  10. Use sunscreen as the final daytime skincare step.

Do not sleep with the sheet on the face unless the product is specifically designed as an overnight mask. Leaving a regular sheet mask on until it becomes dry can feel uncomfortable and does not necessarily provide greater hydration.

Recommended Skincare Routine

Morning: Cleanser → Toner → Dr. Gilla Hyaluronic Acid Deep Ceramide Collagen Mask → Lightweight Moisturizer → Broad-Spectrum Sunscreen

Evening: Cleanser → Toner → Dr. Gilla Hyaluronic Acid Deep Ceramide Collagen Mask → Serum, if required → Moisturizer

Very dry skin may prefer to seal in the remaining essence with a cream. Combination or oily skin may use a lightweight gel moisturizer or skip the additional layer if the mask already feels sufficiently moisturizing.

  • Use immediately after opening the packet.

Dabo Phyto Cica B5 O2 Deep Cleanser: A Comprehensive Overview

In the ever-evolving world of skincare, finding a cleanser that effectively purifies the skin while also addressing sensitivity and irritation can be a daunting task. Enter the Dabo Phyto Cica B5 O2 Deep Cleanser, a standout product designed to meet the needs of various skin types, particularly those that are sensitive or prone to irritation. This cleanser combines the powerful benefits of Centella Asiatica (Cica) with Vitamin B5, creating a formula that not only cleanses but also nourishes and soothes the skin.

Key Ingredients and Their Benefits

Centella Asiatica (Cica): Widely known for its skin-soothing properties, Cica has been a staple in Korean skincare for its ability to calm irritated skin, promote healing, and strengthen the skin barrier. It contains compounds like madecassoside and asiaticoside, which help reduce redness and inflammation while encouraging cell regeneration. This makes it particularly beneficial for those with acne-prone skin or conditions like eczema and rosacea.

Vitamin B5 (Panthenol): Another powerhouse ingredient, Vitamin B5 is renowned for its hydrating properties. It penetrates deeply into the skin, attracting moisture and helping to retain it, which is crucial for maintaining a healthy skin barrier. In addition to its hydrating benefits, Vitamin B5 also aids in the healing of minor wounds and skin irritations, making it an excellent complement to Cica in this formulation.

Oxygen Infusion: The unique aspect of the Dabo Phyto Cica B5 O2 Deep Cleanser is its oxygen-infused formula. Oxygen in skincare products has been shown to help revitalize and energize the skin, improving circulation and promoting a fresh, radiant complexion. This infusion works to lift away impurities and dead skin cells, resulting in a thorough yet gentle cleanse.

How It Works

Dabo Phyto Cica B5 O2 Deep Cleanser operates on multiple levels to ensure your skin feels clean and refreshed. Upon application, the gel-like texture transforms into a rich lather, effectively lifting away dirt, oil, and makeup without harsh scrubbing. Its lightweight formulation allows it to cleanse deeply without clogging pores, which is crucial for those prone to breakouts.

The gentle foaming action ensures that it reaches every nook and cranny of the skin, removing impurities while the soothing properties of Cica and Vitamin B5 work to calm and hydrate. The result is a cleanser that does not just cleanse the surface but also provides a nurturing experience for the skin, making it feel soft and supple after each wash.

Suitable for All Skin Types

One of the standout features of Dabo Phyto Cica B5 O2 Deep Cleanser is its versatility. It is suitable for all skin types, including sensitive, oily, combination, and dry skin. This is particularly important in a market where many cleansers can be overly harsh or drying, especially for sensitive skin types.

For oily or acne-prone skin, the cleanser helps regulate excess oil production while ensuring that the skin remains hydrated and balanced. For dry or sensitive skin, it provides much-needed moisture without the fear of irritation. The calming properties of Cica make it an ideal choice for those experiencing redness or inflammation.

User Experience

When it comes to user experience, the Dabo Phyto Cica B5 O2 Deep Cleanser delivers on all fronts. Its refreshing scent, derived from natural ingredients, enhances the cleansing ritual, making it feel like a spa experience at home. The lightweight texture is easy to apply and rinses off effortlessly, leaving no residue behind.

Many users report a noticeable improvement in their skin’s texture and tone after consistent use. The soothing ingredients help to calm breakouts, reduce redness, and promote an even skin tone. Moreover, the hydration provided by Vitamin B5 ensures that skin feels nourished rather than stripped of moisture, which is often the case with traditional cleansers.

How to Use

For optimal results, it’s recommended to use the Dabo Phyto Cica B5 O2 Deep Cleanser twice a day—once in the morning and once at night. Start by wetting your face with lukewarm water, then apply a small amount of the cleanser to your palms and work it into a lather. Gently massage the product onto your face in circular motions, focusing on areas prone to oil and buildup. Rinse thoroughly with water and pat your skin dry with a clean towel.

Conclusion

In summary, the Dabo Phyto Cica B5 O2 Deep Cleanser is a remarkable product that exemplifies the best of modern skincare. By combining soothing, healing ingredients with an effective cleansing action, it addresses the needs of various skin types, particularly those sensitive or prone to irritation. Its gentle formula ensures that the skin remains hydrated and calm, making it a fantastic addition to any skincare routine.

For anyone searching for a reliable cleanser that not only purifies but also nurtures the skin, Dabo Phyto Cica B5 O2 Deep Cleanser is a top contender. With its unique formulation and proven benefits, it is a must-try for anyone looking to achieve a clean, radiant complexion without compromising skin health.

  1. Hydrating and Soothing: One of the standout features of the Dabo Natural Rich Foam Cleanser Cucumber is its ability to hydrate the skin while cleansing. For individuals with dry or dehydrated skin, this cleanser helps maintain moisture balance, making it a great option for daily use.
  2. Gentle Cleansing: The formula is designed to be mild and non-stripping, meaning it can remove dirt, oil, and impurities without disrupting the skin’s natural barrier.   3. Cooling and Refreshing: The cucumber extract in this product is not only hydrating but also naturally cooling. This makes it a perfect choice for a morning wake-up routine or for calming the skin after a long, tiring day. The refreshing sensation can help revitalize the skin, reduce puffiness, and soothe any signs of inflammation or redness. If you’ve been out in the sun or dealing with skin irritation, this cleanser can offer immediate relief.
  4. Non-Comedogenic Formula: For those prone to acne or breakouts, it’s important to use products that won’t clog the pores. Dabo Natural Rich Foam Cleanser Cucumber is formulated to be non-comedogenic, meaning it won’t block the pores and cause unwanted breakouts. The lightweight foam texture helps cleanse the skin deeply, while the gentle formula keeps the skin clear and free from excess oil buildup.
  5. Natural Ingredients: As the name suggests, the Dabo Natural Rich Foam Cleanser Cucumber focuses on using natural ingredients to benefit the skin. Along with cucumber extract, the cleanser is free from harsh chemicals such as parabens, sulfates, and artificial fragrances, which can irritate the skin. The use of natural ingredients makes it a great option for individuals seeking more eco-conscious and skin-friendly products.
  6. Suitable for All Skin Types: Whether you have oily, dry, combination, or sensitive skin, this product can work for you. The lightweight formula effectively balances the skin’s oil production, which makes it great for oily and acne-prone skin, while still being hydrating enough for dry and sensitive skin. Its gentle nature ensures that it won’t exacerbate skin conditions such as rosacea, eczema, or redness, making it suitable for even the most delicate skin types.

  8. Pleasant Scent: Unlike some skincare products that are overly fragrant or contain synthetic perfumes, Dabo’s Natural Rich Foam Cleanser Cucumber has a light, refreshing, and natural scent. How to Use Dabo Natural Rich Foam Cleanser Cucumber

Using the Dabo Natural Rich Foam Cleanser Cucumber is simple and straightforward. Follow these steps for the best results:

products.description:
Introduction

Forest Phyton Hydra Cica Foam Cleanser is a moisture-focused facial cleanser designed to remove everyday dirt, excess sebum, sunscreen residue, and surface impurities while helping the skin feel soft and comfortable after cleansing.

The formula creates a soft and rich foam that gently surrounds the skin during washing. Unlike cleansers that can leave the face feeling excessively dry or tight, this cleanser combines effective cleansing ingredients with Cica, Panthenol, Cypress Water, and multiple forms of Hyaluronic Acid to support a hydrated and refreshed finish.

It is a practical daily cleanser for anyone who wants thorough cleansing while maintaining a comfortable moisture balance.

Key Ingredients

Centella Asiatica Extract

Centella Asiatica, commonly known as Cica, is widely used in Korean skincare for its soothing and skin-conditioning properties. It helps calm the feel of stressed skin and supports a more comfortable complexion after cleansing.

The formula also contains Cica-related components including Asiaticoside, Asiatic Acid, and Madecassic Acid for additional skin-conditioning care.

8 Types of Hyaluronic Acid

Forest Phyton Hydra Cica Foam Cleanser contains multiple forms of Hyaluronic Acid with different molecular characteristics.

These include Sodium Hyaluronate, Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid, Hyaluronic Acid, Potassium Hyaluronate, Acetylated Hyaluronic Acid, and additional Hyaluronic Acid derivatives.

Together, they help attract and retain moisture on the skin, supporting a softer and more hydrated feeling after cleansing.

Panthenol

Panthenol is a moisturizing and soothing ingredient that helps support skin comfort. It can help reduce the dry or tight feeling that sometimes occurs after washing the face.

Hinoki Cypress Water

Hinoki Cypress Water provides refreshing botanical care and contributes to the product’s forest-inspired cleansing experience.

Glycerin

Glycerin is a well-known humectant that helps attract water to the skin. It supports hydration while helping the skin feel smoother and less dry after rinsing.

Bentonite

Bentonite helps absorb excess surface oil and impurities, making the cleanser useful for areas that tend to become oily or congested.

Key Benefits

  • Helps remove dirt, excess oil, and everyday impurities.
  • Creates a soft and rich cleansing foam.
  • Helps cleanse sunscreen residue and surface buildup.
  • Contains Cica ingredients for soothing and conditioning care.
  • Provides moisture support with multiple types of Hyaluronic Acid.
  • Panthenol helps maintain a comfortable skin feel.
  • Glycerin supports hydration during cleansing.
  • Helps leave skin feeling fresh, clean, and smooth.
  • Bentonite helps absorb excess surface sebum.
  • Suitable for everyday facial cleansing.

How It Works

Forest Phyton Hydra Cica Foam Cleanser combines cleansing agents with hydrating and skin-conditioning ingredients to provide a balanced cleansing experience.

When mixed with water, the formula develops into a dense and creamy foam. This foam spreads easily across the face and helps loosen dirt, excess sebum, sunscreen residue, and other impurities from the skin surface.

The cleanser contains fatty-acid-based cleansing ingredients such as Myristic Acid and Stearic Acid, which contribute to its rich foaming action.

At the same time, Glycerin, Panthenol, and multiple forms of Hyaluronic Acid help support the skin’s moisture level during cleansing.

Cica components, including Centella Asiatica Extract, Asiaticoside, Asiatic Acid, and Madecassic Acid, provide complementary soothing and skin-conditioning care.

Bentonite helps absorb excess oil and surface impurities, while Cypress Water and botanical extracts add refreshing care.

This combination allows Forest Phyton Hydra Cica Foam Cleanser to cleanse effectively while helping skin feel more comfortable and hydrated after rinsing.

Skin Type

Forest Phyton Hydra Cica Foam Cleanser can fit a variety of skincare routines and may be especially suitable for:

  • Normal skin
  • Combination skin
  • Oily skin
  • Dehydrated skin
  • Skin that feels tight after cleansing
  • Skin concerned with excess sebum
  • Dull or tired-looking skin

People with very dry or highly sensitive skin should always adjust cleansing frequency according to their individual skin response.

How to Use

Begin by wetting your face and hands with lukewarm water.

Take an appropriate amount of Forest Phyton Hydra Cica Foam Cleanser into your palm.

Add a small amount of water and rub your hands together until a soft and rich foam develops.

Apply the foam gently over the entire face and massage using light circular motions. Focus particularly on areas where excess oil and buildup commonly collect, such as the forehead, nose, and chin.

Avoid rubbing the skin aggressively and avoid direct contact with the eyes.

Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water until no cleanser remains.

Gently pat the face dry using a clean towel.

Follow with toner, serum, moisturizer, and sunscreen according to your skincare routine.

It can be used in the morning or evening depending on your skin type and cleansing needs.

If you wear heavy makeup or highly water-resistant sunscreen, use an oil cleanser or cleansing balm first and follow with this foam cleanser as the second cleansing step.

Why Choose It?

Many foam cleansers are designed mainly to remove oil and impurities, but Forest Phyton Hydra Cica Foam Cleanser combines cleansing with moisture-focused skincare ingredients.

Its formula contains several forms of Hyaluronic Acid to help support hydration, while Glycerin and Panthenol further contribute to a softer and more comfortable skin feel.

Cica-derived ingredients provide soothing and conditioning care, making the cleanser particularly appealing for people who want their cleansing routine to feel refreshing rather than overly harsh.

The rich foam also helps distribute the cleanser evenly across the face, allowing impurities to be removed without excessive rubbing.

For people who experience both excess oil and dehydration, this combination of cleansing and moisture-supporting ingredients can make it a useful daily option.

FAQ

Can Forest Phyton Hydra Cica Foam Cleanser be used daily?

Yes. It is designed as a facial cleansing foam and can be used regularly. Adjust the frequency depending on your skin type and how your skin feels after cleansing.

Does it contain Cica?

Yes. The formula contains Centella Asiatica Extract along with Cica-related components such as Asiaticoside, Asiatic Acid, and Madecassic Acid.

Does it contain Hyaluronic Acid?

Yes. The formula includes eight types or derivatives of Hyaluronic Acid to provide moisture-supporting care during cleansing.

Is it suitable for oily skin?

Yes. The cleansing base and Bentonite help remove excess surface oil and impurities, while moisturizing ingredients help maintain skin comfort.

Is it suitable for dehydrated skin?

The formula includes Hyaluronic Acid, Glycerin, and Panthenol, which help support hydration. However, people with very dry skin should monitor how their skin responds to any foaming cleanser.

Can it remove makeup?

It can help remove light daily residue and sunscreen. For heavy or waterproof makeup, use a dedicated cleansing oil or balm first and follow with this cleanser.

The skin barrier is what keeps moisture in and irritants out. When it is compromised, skin loses water faster than it can replace it, and the dryness becomes self-sustaining.

Centella Light Cleansing Oil

A lightweight cleansing oil that helps dissolve makeup, sunscreen, excess sebum, and oil-based impurities.

Centella Ampoule Foam

It helps remove remaining dirt, impurities, and residue after oil cleansing. Coconut-derived cleansing ingredients provide effective cleansing, while Centella Asiatica Extract and Sodium Hyaluronate help support a more comfortable post-cleansing feel.

Centella Toning Toner

This lightweight toner combines Centella Asiatica Extract with Gluconolactone, a PHA ingredient that provides gentle exfoliating care.

It helps remove accumulated dead surface cells and excess sebum while preparing the skin for the following skincare steps.

The formula also contains Niacinamide, Betaine, Hyaluronic Acid, and Adenosine for additional skin-conditioning care.

Centella Ampoule

The signature Centella Ampoule provides simple, lightweight soothing and hydration-focused care.

Its watery formula spreads easily and absorbs quickly without a heavy or sticky finish. Centella Asiatica Extract helps soothe and condition stressed or sensitive-looking skin while supporting a healthier-looking complexion.

Centella Soothing Cream

The final step is a lightweight gel-type soothing cream formulated to hydrate and support skin comfort.

It contains Centella Asiatica Extract together with ingredients such as Trehalose, Sodium Hyaluronate, Beta-Glucan, Ceramides, and Cholesterol.

These ingredients help provide moisture and support the skin barrier while leaving the complexion feeling smooth and hydrated.

Key Ingredients

Centella Asiatica Extract

Centella Asiatica is the signature ingredient throughout the SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Travel Kit. It is commonly used in Korean skincare for its soothing and skin-conditioning properties.

It helps calm stressed-looking skin while supporting a balanced and comfortable complexion.

Gluconolactone

Hyaluronic Acid & Sodium Hyaluronate

Moisture-binding ingredients such as Hyaluronic Acid and Sodium Hyaluronate help attract and maintain moisture, supporting a hydrated and supple skin feel.

Betaine

Ceramides & Cholesterol

How It Works

SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Travel Kit provides a complete skincare routine through five complementary steps.

The cleansing oil first helps dissolve oil-soluble impurities such as sunscreen, makeup, sebum, and everyday grime.

The Ampoule Foam follows as the second cleansing step to remove remaining water-soluble impurities and residue from the skin.

After cleansing, the Centella Toning Toner prepares the skin while Gluconolactone provides mild exfoliating care to help improve the feel of rough surface texture.

The Centella Ampoule then delivers concentrated soothing and hydration-focused care with a lightweight watery texture.

Finally, the Centella Soothing Cream helps lock in hydration while Ceramides, Cholesterol, Hyaluronic Acid derivatives, and other moisturizing ingredients support skin comfort and barrier care.

7 Key Benefits of SKIN1004 Probio-Cica Essence Toner

What Is Probio-Cica?

Probio-Cica refers to SKIN1004’s combination of fermented Centella Asiatica and skin-barrier-supporting ingredients. The formula contains Lactobacillus and Centella Asiatica ferment filtrate to provide soothing, moisturizing and conditioning care.

The “Probio” name describes the fermented skincare complex. This toner is a topical cosmetic product and should not be confused with an oral probiotic supplement or medical treatment.

Key Ingredients and Their Benefits

Fermented Madagascan Centella

Centella Asiatica Extract

Five Types of Hyaluronic Acid

Ceramide NP

TECA Components

Panthenol

In the context of Illiyoon Red Itch Care Cream, Centella Asiatica helps calm irritated skin by reducing redness and inflammation. Panthenol also helps to reduce the feeling of tightness or discomfort in the skin, making it a crucial element in soothing the itching and dryness commonly associated with skin conditions like eczema or psoriasis.

Shea butter also has anti-inflammatory and healing properties, making it a great addition to products designed for irritated or damaged skin.
  5. Ceramides Ceramides are lipid molecules naturally found in the skin that play a crucial role in maintaining the skin’s barrier function. The presence of ceramides in Illiyoon Red Itch Care Cream ensures that the skin is protected from environmental stressors and helps to prevent moisture loss. For those with eczema, atopic dermatitis, or other skin conditions, ceramide-rich formulations can significantly improve the integrity of the skin’s barrier, reducing the frequency and severity of flare-ups.

Illiyoon Red Itch Care Cream is designed to address the root causes of skin discomfort, providing both short-term relief and long-term benefits. The cream’s formulation works in several key ways:

  1. Calming Irritation and Itchiness The anti-inflammatory ingredients in the cream, particularly Centella Asiatica and Madecassoside, target the root causes of irritation and itchiness. They help reduce inflammation, which is often responsible for the discomfort associated with conditions like eczema, allergic reactions, and skin sensitivities. By calming the inflammation, the cream provides almost immediate relief from itching and discomfort.
  2. Hydration and Moisture Retention One of the primary benefits of Illiyoon Red Itch Care Cream is its ability to deeply hydrate the skin. The combination of ingredients like Panthenol, Shea Butter, and Ceramides ensures that the skin stays moisturized and retains its natural hydration. This helps restore the skin’s balance, keeping it supple and smooth while reducing the dryness that often exacerbates itching.
  3. Barrier Repair A compromised skin barrier is often the underlying cause of chronic dryness, irritation, and itching. Illiyoon Red Itch Care Cream helps to rebuild the skin’s protective barrier with the help of Ceramides and other nourishing ingredients. A healthy skin barrier is essential for preventing environmental pollutants, allergens, and microbes from penetrating the skin and causing further irritation.
  4. Non-Greasy and Gentle Formula The formula is designed to be lightweight and non-greasy, making it suitable for both day and night use. Despite its potent ingredients, the cream has a smooth, silky texture that absorbs quickly without leaving a heavy or sticky residue. This makes it easy to incorporate into any skincare routine, even for individuals who are sensitive to more occlusive or heavy creams.
  5. Hypoallergenic and Dermatologist-Tested Illiyoon Red Itch Care Cream is dermatologist-tested and free from common irritants like artificial fragrances, parabens, and alcohol, making it a safe option for individuals with highly sensitive skin or those prone to allergic reactions. The hypoallergenic nature of the product means that it can be used by a wide range of people, including those with delicate skin conditions.

Ideal Users and Applications

Shea butter also has anti-inflammatory and healing properties, making it a great addition to products designed for irritated or damaged skin.
  5. Ceramides Ceramides are lipid molecules naturally found in the skin that play a crucial role in maintaining the skin’s barrier function. The presence of ceramides in Illiyoon Red Itch Care Cream ensures that the skin is protected from environmental stressors and helps to prevent moisture loss. For those with eczema, atopic dermatitis, or other skin conditions, ceramide-rich formulations can significantly improve the integrity of the skin’s barrier, reducing the frequency and severity of flare-ups.

Illiyoon Red Itch Care Cream is designed to address the root causes of skin discomfort, providing both short-term relief and long-term benefits. The cream’s formulation works in several key ways:

Product Overview

Isntree Hyaluronic Acid Moist Cream is a rich facial moisturizer developed for skin that needs deeper and longer-lasting hydration. It combines ten forms of Hyaluronic Acid with a substantial humectant and emollient base to prevent the tight, uncomfortable feeling that comes with dehydration.

Rather than relying on a single form of Hyaluronic Acid, the formula uses ten derivatives with different molecular sizes and properties. Smaller fragments sit more readily on the skin surface, larger ones hold more water, and the silanol and crosspolymer forms behave differently again — which is the thinking behind the multi-type approach.

The moisturizing system is reinforced by Glycerin, Betaine, Glycereth-26, Beta-Glucan and Polyquaternium-51, while Shea Butter, Apricot Kernel Oil, Argan Kernel Oil and Safflower Seed Oil supply the lipids that stop that water escaping again.

The result is a richer moisturizing cream particularly relevant for normal, dry and dehydrated skin, or anyone who prefers a nourishing final step in their routine.

Key Benefits

  • Contains 10 different forms of Hyaluronic Acid, all declared on the label.
  • Glycerin as the second ingredient provides the main humectant base.
  • Polyquaternium-51 adds strong moisture-retention support.
  • Helps reduce the feeling of dryness and tightness.

  • Suitable as the final moisturizing step of morning and evening routines.

The 10 Types of Hyaluronic Acid

The claim is accurate, and all ten are on the label:

  • Sodium Hyaluronate
  • Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid
  • Hydroxypropyltrimonium Hyaluronate
  • Dimethylsilanol Hyaluronate
  • Hydrolyzed Sodium Hyaluronate
  • Potassium Hyaluronate
  • Hyaluronic Acid
  • Sodium Hyaluronate Crosspolymer
  • Sodium Acetylated Hyaluronate
  • Sodium Hyaluronate Dimethylsilanol

Each works slightly differently. Hydrolyzed forms are broken into smaller fragments that sit more easily on the skin surface; the crosspolymer holds water in a gel network; the silanol forms pair hyaluronic acid with silicon; the acetylated form is designed to stay on the skin longer.

It is worth knowing where they sit. Sodium Hyaluronate is twenty-third on the ingredient list, and the other nine all appear between positions thirty-six and forty-seven — the last five are the final five ingredients in the formula. Each is present in a small amount, which is normal: hyaluronic acid is used at fractions of a percent in almost every product that contains it, because more than that turns a cream sticky.

So read “10 types” as what it is — a well-rounded hyaluronic acid blend rather than a high-dose one. The weight of the moisturizing in this cream comes from Glycerin at second place, backed by Hydrogenated Polydecene, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride and Shea Butter in the top seven. That is a sound, well-built moisturizer, and it is a fair reason to buy this cream; the hyaluronic acid blend is the refinement on top rather than the engine.

Selected Ingredient Highlights

Glycerin

Glycerin is the second ingredient and the workhorse humectant of the formula. It draws water into the upper layers of the skin and is the single most reliable moisturizing ingredient in skincare. Its position here tells you this cream was built to moisturize properly.

Polyquaternium-51

Polyquaternium-51 is a polymer designed to mimic the structure of cell membranes. It is well regarded for moisture retention — it holds water tightly and keeps the skin feeling hydrated for longer — and it is one of the quieter strengths of this formula.

Shea Butter

Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter is the seventh ingredient and provides rich emollient care. It softens dry or rough-feeling skin and helps seal in the water that the humectants have drawn in.

Betaine, Glycereth-26 & Beta-Glucan

Betaine and Glycereth-26 sit in the top twelve and provide further humectant support, while Beta-Glucan adds both moisture-binding and soothing benefits.

Fructooligosaccharides

Fructooligosaccharides are prebiotic sugars that also act as humectants, supporting the skin’s own moisture environment.

Apricot, Argan & Safflower Oils

Three plant oils sit together in the formula. Prunus Armeniaca (Apricot) Kernel Oil is a light, easily absorbed oil, Argania Spinosa (Argan) Kernel Oil is rich in vitamin E and oleic acid, and Carthamus Tinctorius (Safflower) Seed Oil is high in linoleic acid, which suits a barrier-support formula.

Botanical Extract Complex

Four botanical extracts appear together in the upper-middle of the list: Laminaria Japonica Extract (kombu seaweed, a traditional moisture-binding marine extract), Eclipta Prostrata Leaf Extract, Avena Sativa (Oat) Kernel Extract (long established for soothing dry, uncomfortable skin) and Cynara Scolymus (Artichoke) Leaf Extract, which contributes antioxidant support.

Green Tea Leaf Water & Tocopherol

Camellia Sinensis Leaf Water and Tocopherol (vitamin E) provide antioxidant and skin-conditioning support within the moisturizing base.

Hydrogenated Lecithin

Hydrogenated Lecithin is a phospholipid emulsifier that is also skin-compatible, helping the oil and water phases stay together while supporting the skin’s own lipid environment.

The texture comes from the fatty alcohols Cetyl Alcohol and Behenyl Alcohol, the ester Pentaerythrityl Distearate and the silicones Cyclohexasiloxane and Vinyl Dimethicone, which together give the cream its slip and smooth finish. Cyclohexasiloxane sits sixth, so if you prefer to avoid silicones, this is worth knowing before you buy.

The formula contains no added fragrance and no essential oil. There is no Fragrance, Parfum or declared fragrance allergen anywhere in the ingredient list — a genuine advantage for sensitive or reactive skin, and increasingly uncommon in a cream this rich.

products.description:
What is BHA and How Does It Benefit the Skin?

Before diving into  the details of this product, it’s important to understand the role of salicylic acid and BHA (beta-hydroxy acid) in skincare. Salicylic acid is a type of BHA, which is an oil-soluble acid known for its deep cleansing properties. Unlike AHAs (alpha-hydroxy acids), which work on the surface of the skin, BHAs can penetrate deeper into the pores to clear out debris, excess oil, and dead skin cells. This makes salicylic acid especially effective for those with oily or acne-prone skin.

Salicylic acid also has anti-inflammatory properties that can help reduce redness, irritation, and swelling often associated with acne. For individuals dealing with breakouts, clogged pores, or dull skin, salicylic acid is a highly beneficial ingredient due to its ability to exfoliate, reduce acne-causing bacteria, and refine the skin’s surface.

Key Benefits of Cos De Baha S2 Salicylic Acid BHA 2% Liquid

  1. Deep Pore Cleansing and Exfoliation
    One of the standout features of Cos De Baha S2 Salicylic Acid BHA 2% Liquid is its ability to penetrate deep into the skin and pores. The 2% concentration of salicylic acid works effectively to exfoliate the skin, breaking down dead skin cells that can contribute to clogged pores and breakouts. Regular use of this product helps to keep pores clear, preventing the formation of blackheads, whiteheads, and acne.
  2. Reduces Acne and Blemishes
    Acne is one of the most common skin concerns that many individuals face, whether it’s on the face, back, or shoulders. Salicylic acid has long been considered one of the most effective ingredients for treating acne. The Cos De Baha S2 Salicylic Acid BHA 2% Liquid works by not only clearing the pores but also reducing inflammation and redness associated with acne breakouts. The gentle exfoliation it provides encourages skin turnover, leading to fewer breakouts and a more even skin tone over time.
  3. Improves Skin Texture
    Consistent use of this salicylic acid treatment can lead to smoother skin. By removing dead skin cells and promoting new cell growth, it helps to improve skin texture. Those who suffer from rough, uneven skin or post-acne scarring can see noticeable improvements in skin texture with regular application.
  4. Controls Excess Oil Production
    Salicylic acid is particularly beneficial for those with oily skin, as it helps to regulate sebum production. By exfoliating the skin and clearing out excess oil in the pores, this product helps to prevent the build-up of oils that can lead to acne formation. Reducing excess oil also contributes to a matte, shine-free appearance.
  5. Helps to Minimize Pore Appearance
    Clogged pores are one of the main causes of enlarged pores, and salicylic acid can effectively treat both. By preventing pore blockages and promoting the removal of debris, it helps pores appear smaller and less noticeable. Over time, this can contribute to a more refined, even skin surface.
  6. Gentle Yet Effective
    Although salicylic acid is a powerful ingredient, the Cos De Baha S2 Salicylic Acid BHA 2% Liquid is formulated to be gentle enough for daily use (for those with less sensitive skin). The liquid formula is easy to apply and absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving behind any greasy residue. It’s also free from parabens, sulfates, and alcohol, which can sometimes irritate or dry out the skin.
  7. Boosts Overall Skin Health
    In addition to addressing acne, clogged pores, and excess oil, salicylic acid is known for its ability to promote overall skin health. By removing the top layer of dead skin cells, it allows for better absorption of other skincare products, like moisturizers or serums. This can help to enhance the effectiveness of the rest of your skincare routine.

How to Use Cos De Baha S2 Salicylic Acid BHA 2% Liquid

To make the most out of the Cos De Baha S2 Salicylic Acid BHA 2% Liquid, follow these simple steps:

  1. Cleanse Your Face: Begin by cleansing your skin with a gentle, non-stripping cleanser to remove dirt, makeup, and impurities. It’s important to start with a clean canvas so that the salicylic acid can work effectively.
  2. Apply the Liquid: After cleansing, apply a few drops of the Cos De Baha S2 Salicylic Acid BHA 2% Liquid onto a cotton pad or directly to your fingertips. Gently swipe it over the areas of your face that require treatment, focusing on areas with congestion, blemishes, or excess oil. Avoid the eye area.
  3. Allow to Absorb: Let the liquid absorb into your skin for a few minutes. There’s no need to rinse it off. You’ll want to allow the salicylic acid to fully penetrate the pores and start its exfoliating and clarifying work.
  4. Follow with Moisturizer: Since exfoliating products like salicylic acid can sometimes cause dryness, it’s important to follow up with a hydrating moisturizer to keep the skin balanced and nourished.
  5. Sun Protection: As with any exfoliating product, it’s essential to wear sunscreen during the day when using this product. Salicylic acid can make your skin more sensitive to the sun, increasing the risk of sunburn and sun damage.

Who Should Use Cos De Baha S2 Salicylic Acid BHA 2% Liquid?

Cos De Baha S2 Salicylic Acid BHA 2% Liquid is best suited for individuals with oily, acne-prone, or congested skin. If you struggle with clogged pores, blackheads, whiteheads, or breakouts, this product can be an excellent addition to your skincare regimen. Those who are also looking to smooth rough skin texture or minimize the appearance of pores will also benefit from its regular use.

It’s important to note that individuals with sensitive skin may want to start slowly, as salicylic acid can sometimes cause irritation, redness, or dryness. It’s recommended to patch-test the product on a small area before applying it to the entire face. If irritation occurs, reduce usage or discontinue until skin tolerance improves.

This sun cream is ideal for individuals with dry to combination skin types looking for a product that offers sun protection, hydration, and a brightening effect. 🛍️ Packaging and Value

The 3W Clinic Crystal White Milky Sun Cream comes in a 50ml tube, making it convenient for daily use and travel. The packaging is simple yet functional, with a flip-top cap that dispenses the product hygienically. Priced competitively, it offers a balance between quality and affordability, making it accessible for those seeking a multi-functional sunscreen.

✅ Final Verdict

The 3W Clinic Crystal White Milky Sun Cream SPF50+ PA+++ is a versatile product that combines sun protection with skincare benefits. While it offers hydration, a subtle tone-up effect, and antioxidant-rich ingredients, potential drawbacks include its alcohol content, fragrance components, and the possibility of pilling. As with any skincare product, it’s important to consider your individual skin type and sensitivities before incorporating it into your routine.

products.name: Isntree Hyaluronic Acid Watery Sun Gel Spf 50+ PA++++ UVA/UVB 50ml
products.description:
Isntree Hyaluronic Acid Watery Sun Gel SPF50+ PA++++ is a standout product in the realm of Korean skincare, offering a harmonious blend of advanced sun protection and intensive hydration. This sunscreen has garnered acclaim for its lightweight, non-greasy texture and its ability to deliver a dewy, glass-skin finish without leaving a white cast. It’s particularly favored by those with dry, sensitive, or combination skin types seeking a sunscreen that not only shields against harmful UV rays but also nourishes the skin.

☀️ Broad-Spectrum Protection

With an SPF of 50+ and a PA rating of PA++++, the Isntree Hyaluronic Acid Watery Sun Gel offers robust protection against both UVA and UVB rays. UVA rays are primarily responsible for premature skin aging, while UVB rays cause sunburn. This dual protection helps in preventing sun-induced skin damage, pigmentation, and the acceleration of aging signs.

💧 Hydration Through 8 Types of Hyaluronic Acid

A distinguishing feature of this sunscreen is its incorporation of eight different types of hyaluronic acid, each varying in molecular size. This multi-layered approach ensures that hydration penetrates various skin layers, providing deep moisture and enhancing the skin’s elasticity. The inclusion of sodium hyaluronate crosspolymer, a cross-linked form of hyaluronic acid, further amplifies moisture retention, forming a protective barrier that reduces water loss and keeps the skin plump and hydrated throughout the day.

🌿 Skin-Calming and Barrier-Strengthening Ingredients

Beyond hydration, this sun gel is enriched with several skin-loving ingredients:

  • Centella Asiatica Extract: Known for its soothing properties, it helps calm irritated skin and promotes healing.
  • Ceramide NP: Plays a crucial role in reinforcing the skin’s natural barrier, preventing moisture loss and protecting against environmental aggressors.
  • Astaxanthin: A potent antioxidant that aids in reducing oxidative stress, thereby protecting the skin from premature aging.
  • Niacinamide (Vitamin B3): Offers multiple benefits, including brightening the skin tone, reducing the appearance of pores, and enhancing the skin’s barrier function.
  • Purslane and Heart Leaf Extracts: These botanicals provide additional antioxidant and anti-inflammatory benefits, further soothing and protecting the skin.

🧴 Lightweight, Non-Greasy Texture

The gel-based formulation ensures a lightweight application, absorbing quickly into the skin without leaving a sticky or greasy residue. This makes it an excellent base for makeup or suitable for those who prefer a matte finish. Its non-comedogenic nature ensures that it won’t clog pores, making it suitable for acne-prone skin as well.

🌍 Eco-Friendly and Reef-Safe

In line with growing environmental consciousness, the Isntree Hyaluronic Acid Watery Sun Gel is formulated to be reef-safe. It avoids the use of harmful chemicals that can damage marine ecosystems, aligning with the brand’s commitment to sustainability.

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Suitable for All Skin Types

Whether you have oily, dry, combination, or sensitive skin, this sunscreen caters to all. Its gentle formulation, free from artificial fragrances, alcohol, and colorants, ensures minimal irritation, making it ideal for those with sensitive skin concerns. The added hydration benefits make it particularly beneficial for dry skin types, while its lightweight nature suits oily and combination skin.

🛍️ Packaging and Application

The sunscreen comes in a sleek, travel-friendly 50ml tube, making it convenient for daily use and on-the-go application. To use, apply a generous amount to the face and neck at the final step of your skincare routine, at least 30 minutes before sun exposure. Reapply every two hours, especially if you’re sweating or after swimming, to maintain optimal protection.

✅ Final Thoughts

The Isntree Hyaluronic Acid Watery Sun Gel SPF50+ PA++++ stands out as a multifunctional sunscreen that not only provides superior sun protection but also delivers essential hydration and skin barrier support. Its lightweight, non-greasy texture ensures comfortable wear throughout the day, while its eco-friendly formulation aligns with sustainable skincare practices. For those seeking a reliable, hydrating sunscreen that caters to various skin types and concerns, this product is a commendable choice.

products.description:
Dr.Althea Gentle Vitamin C Serum 30 ml is a lightweight Korean brightening serum developed for dullness, uneven-looking skin tone, and the appearance of dark spots. Its gentle formula combines 20% Sea Buckthorn Fruit Water, 5% Niacinamide, 2% Green Tea Leaf Water and the Vitamin C derivative 3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid.

The watery serum spreads easily and absorbs without an excessively heavy or sticky finish. It is particularly relevant for first-time Vitamin C users and sensitive-looking skin that requires gradual brightening care alongside hydration and soothing support.

Important: The 20% claim refers to Hippophae Rhamnoides or Sea Buckthorn Fruit Water—not 20% pure Vitamin C. The manufacturer does not disclose the percentage of 3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid in the current official formula.

Table of Contents

  • Product Overview
  • Key Benefits
  • Key Ingredients
  • Texture and Formula Features
  • Brand-Published Test Results
  • Suitable Skin Types
  • How to Use
  • Recommended Routine

Dr.Althea Gentle Vitamin C Serum Overview

Dr.Althea Gentle Vitamin C Serum is designed to provide brightening care without relying on a high disclosed concentration of pure Ascorbic Acid. Instead, the formula uses Sea Buckthorn Fruit Water alongside 3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid, Niacinamide and supportive soothing ingredients.

This combination helps improve the appearance of dullness, uneven tone and post-blemish marks while supporting a hydrated and comfortable skin feel. The brand particularly recommends the Gentle version for beginners, sensitive-looking skin and people who prefer gradual daily Vitamin C care.

Dr.Althea also sells a separate Vitamin C Boosting Serum. The product described here is the green-bottle Gentle Vitamin C Serum with 20% Sea Buckthorn Fruit Water; it should not be confused with the higher-intensity Boosting Serum.

Key Benefits of Dr.Althea Gentle Vitamin C Serum

  • Helps brighten dull and tired-looking skin
  • Helps improve the appearance of uneven skin tone
  • Supports care for visible dark spots and post-blemish marks
  • Contains 20% Sea Buckthorn Fruit Water
  • Contains 5% Niacinamide and a Vitamin C derivative
  • Provides lightweight hydration without an excessively sticky finish
  • Includes Green Tea Leaf Water and Allantoin for soothing support
  • Suitable for gradual daily Vitamin C care
  • Designed with beginners and sensitive-looking skin in mind
  • Can be used in morning or evening skincare routines

Key Ingredients and Their Functions

20% Sea Buckthorn Fruit Water

Hippophae Rhamnoides Fruit Water, commonly known as Sea Buckthorn or Vitamin Tree Fruit Water, makes up 200,000 ppm or 20% of the current formula. It provides antioxidant and moisture-supporting care and contributes to a brighter, healthier-looking complexion.

This percentage must not be interpreted as 20% pure Vitamin C. Sea Buckthorn Fruit Water is a botanical ingredient, while the formula’s separately listed Vitamin C derivative is 3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid.

5% Niacinamide

Niacinamide is present at 50,000 ppm or 5%. It helps improve the appearance of dullness and uneven tone while supporting the skin barrier and overall skin texture.

3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid

3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid is a Vitamin C derivative used to support antioxidant and brightening care. Its exact concentration is not disclosed in the current official product information, so the serum should not be described as containing 20% Vitamin C.

2% Green Tea Leaf Water

Camellia Sinensis Leaf Water is included at 20,000 ppm or 2%. It supplies antioxidant and skin-comforting support, helping balance a routine focused on pigmentation and dullness.

Allantoin, Bifida Ferment Filtrate and Adenosine

Allantoin helps soothe and comfort the skin. Bifida Ferment Filtrate supports conditioning and hydration, while Adenosine contributes to smoother and healthier-looking skin.

The current official ingredient list also contains Tea Tree Leaf Extract. This is a botanical extract and should not be confused with Tea Tree Essential Oil. Added fragrance, parfum and essential oils do not appear in the current official ingredient list.

Formulations can be updated. Always check the ingredient list printed on the product received before using Dr.Althea Gentle Vitamin C Serum.

Texture and Formula Features
